FILE: website/Dockerfile
====================================================================================================
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# deepalgorithms.io as a container: build and prerender with Node, serve with nginx.
#   docker build -t deepalgorithms-website .
#   docker run -p 8080:8080 deepalgorithms-website      -> http://localhost:8080
# Or: docker compose up --build

# ---------- build: install, compile and prerender all 41 pages to static HTML ----------
FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

# No build settings: the site address and form endpoint live in src/data/site.js.
COPY . .
RUN npm run build && node scripts/csp.mjs /app/csp.conf

# ---------- serve: nginx as a non-root user, static files only ----------
FROM nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine

COPY nginx/default.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY nginx/security-headers.conf /etc/nginx/snippets/security-headers.conf
COPY --from=build /app/csp.conf /etc/nginx/snippets/csp.conf
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz || exit 1

====================================================================================================
FILE: website/README.md
====================================================================================================
# deepalgorithms.io

React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind 4, prerendered to static HTML (41 pages, a 404, sitemap.xml and robots.txt).

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5173
npm run build        # dist/, static, deploy anywhere
npm run preview      # serves dist/ the way Vercel or Netlify do
npm run test:e2e     # Playwright checks against the build (npx playwright install chromium once)
```

Deploy `dist/` to any host that serves `about-us/index.html` for `/about-us` (Vercel and Netlify do; `vercel.json` and `public/_redirects` are included). Do not use a single-page-app fallback that answers every URL with the home page: React would hydrate the wrong page.

## Docker

```bash
docker compose up --build -d      # http://localhost:8080
# or
docker build -t deepalgorithms-website . && docker run -p 8080:8080 deepalgorithms-website
```

Two stages: Node 22 installs, builds and prerenders every page; nginx then serves the static files as a non-root user (port 8080, `/healthz` for health checks). `docker-compose.yml` also runs it read-only, with every Linux capability dropped. Put TLS in front (a load balancer, Cloudflare or a reverse proxy).

`nginx/default.conf` serves clean URLs (`/about-us`), sends `/about-us/` to `/about-us`, answers unknown paths with `404.html` and a real 404, caches fingerprinted assets for a year and pages not at all, gzips text and supports byte ranges for the film. `nginx/security-headers.conf` adds HSTS, `nosniff`, frame denial, a referrer and permissions policy, and a Content-Security-Policy that `scripts/csp.mjs` writes from the built pages: inline scripts run only by hash, forms post only to `SITE.formEndpoint`, and the only outside scripts allowed are Google's page translator, loaded when a visitor picks a language. The e2e suite passes against the container: `BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080 npm run test:e2e`.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `src/styles.css` | Design tokens and base styles. One type family (Inter 4 with its optical-size axis); JetBrains Mono only for machine values inside product pictures. Each product line keeps one accent. |
| Themes | The default mixes tones: each page's top-level bands are light **sheets** unless marked `stage` (heroes, the film, the logo moment, one showcase band per product page, calls to action). Light sheets only redefine the colour tokens; product pictures (`.vz`) and anything marked `tone-d` stay dark inside them. `html[data-theme=dark]` turns every band dark. The switch is in the header (`src/lib/theme.js`); the choice is stored in `localStorage` and applied by an inline script before the first paint, so there is no flash. |
| `src/components/FlowRibbons.jsx` | Fine silver ribbons behind the heroes only (canvas, pauses off screen, static under reduced motion). The film draws the same ribbons in full colour. |
| `src/components/Backdrop.jsx` | A still, neutral graphite surface behind the dark bands. Colour lives in the product pictures and the accents, not the background; brand blue is the one accent for actions. Dense reading sits on `.calm`. |
| `src/components/LogoOrbit.jsx` | The home page logo moment: the mark rises into a brand-blue plate with the line, then pops out and lands at the centre of the identity orbit, with the four products under it. |
| `src/components/HeroPhoto.jsx`, `public/img/photos/` | The home hero: a real photograph (Pexels, free licence) of a person confirmed as himself, then an impostor with his password stopped. The industry cards and industry page heroes use the same photo set; team pages use only our own photos. |
| `src/components/Stage3D.jsx` | 3D frame for key pictures; `<Pop>` lifts the important part out of the frame. |
| `src/components/ProductMark.jsx`, `public/brand/products/` | The official product logos (Zenstra AI, adapID AI, BotShield AI, ICMS), taken from the products' own artwork on deepalgorithms.io and used in the menus, heroes, cards, the company page, research and the film. |
| `src/components/viz/` | Every product picture, as code with sample data, one file per product line, using the real tools involved (Okta, Microsoft 365, AWS services, GitHub, Claude, Salesforce, UPI…) from `kit.jsx`. Steps play while on screen; server HTML shows the final step. |
| `src/components/Header.jsx`, `src/data/nav.js` | Products and Solutions open plain enterprise menus (group labels, a name and one line per item; Products adds the tools we work with). Why Deep Algorithms, Research and Trust center are links. The bar above carries the phone number, search and the language menu. |
| `src/lib/translate.js` | The language menu: English is the source; other languages are translated in the browser by Google's page translator, loaded only when a visitor picks one. |
| `src/components/Command.jsx` | Loaded on demand. Site search (Ctrl/⌘ K, `/` or the header button) over every product, solution, report and page; and a small toy terminal behind the `` ` `` key (try `help`), hinted at by a puzzle in the browser console. |
| `src/pages/products/` | One page per product, each with its own structure; the six Zenstra capabilities share `Capability.jsx`. |
| `src/data/` | Products, solutions, company, legal, posts and site facts. Article bodies are in `src/content/posts/`. |
| `tools/film/` | The one-minute product film: script, voice, music, captions, frame renderer. See its README. |
| `tools/walkthrough/` | The site walkthrough video, recorded frame by frame on a virtual clock (`clock.js`), so every scroll and animation is smooth whatever the machine: `record.mjs <url> <dir> <segment>` for each segment in `script.mjs`, `cards.mjs`, then `make-video.sh <dir> walkthrough.mp4`. |
| `tests/` | Playwright end-to-end checks: every page, menus, film, interactions, search and terminal, phone layouts. |
| `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `nginx/`, `scripts/csp.mjs` | Container build and serving (see Docker above). |

Dev-only pages (not part of the build): `gallery.html` shows every product picture side by side; `film.html` renders the film frame by frame.

Product figures are attributed to Deep Algorithms; third-party figures carry their source. All product UI in the pictures is illustrative.

FILE: website/docker-compose.yml
====================================================================================================
# docker compose up --build -d     -> http://localhost:8080
services:
  web:
    build:
      context: .
    image: deepalgorithms-website:latest
    container_name: deepalgorithms-website
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    restart: unless-stopped
    # hardened: read-only filesystem, no Linux capabilities, no privilege escalation
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O", "/dev/null", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 5s

FILE: website/playwright.config.js
====================================================================================================
// End-to-end tests against the production build (npm run build first).
//   npm run test:e2e
import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';

const PORT = 4173;
// BASE_URL tests an already running server instead.
const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL || `http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`;
export default defineConfig({
  testDir: 'tests',
  timeout: 90_000,
  expect: { timeout: 10_000 },
  fullyParallel: true,
  workers: process.env.CI ? 2 : 3,
  reporter: [['list']],
  retries: 1,
  use: {
    baseURL: BASE,
    trace: 'retain-on-failure',
    launchOptions: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {},
  },
  projects: [
    { name: 'desktop', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'], viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } } },
    { name: 'phone', use: { ...devices['Pixel 7'], viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }, testMatch: /responsive|navigation|film|mobile/ },
  ],
  webServer: process.env.BASE_URL ? undefined : { command: `node scripts/serve.mjs ${PORT}`, url: `http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/healthz`, reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI },
});

FILE: website/nginx/default.conf
====================================================================================================
# deepalgorithms.io: the prerendered site, served the way Vercel/Netlify serve it.
#   /trust -> trust/index.html, unknown paths -> 404.html with status 404,
#   hashed assets cached for a year, pages always revalidated, film streams with ranges.
# Runs unprivileged on 8080; put TLS in front (load balancer, Cloudflare or a proxy).

server {
    listen 8080;   # IPv4; add 'listen [::]:8080;' where the host has IPv6
    server_name _;

    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    index index.html;
    charset utf-8;

    server_tokens off;
    absolute_redirect off;          # redirects keep the host and port the visitor used
    port_in_redirect off;

    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_types text/css text/plain text/vtt text/javascript application/javascript application/json
               application/ld+json application/manifest+json application/xml image/svg+xml;

    include /etc/nginx/snippets/security-headers.conf;

    error_page 404 /404.html;

    location = /healthz {
        access_log off;
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 "ok\n";
    }

    # pages removed in the redesign
    location = /svg-export { return 301 /; }
    location = /verify     { return 301 /; }
    # the company page and the old Why page became one page
    location = /about-us   { return 301 /why-deep-algorithms$is_args$args; }
    location = /platform   { return 301 /why-deep-algorithms$is_args$args; }

    # one address per page: /trust/ -> /trust
    location ~ ^(.+)/$ {
        return 301 $1$is_args$args;
    }

    # fingerprinted JS and CSS never change: cache for a year
    location ^~ /assets/ {
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/security-headers.conf;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" always;
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    # images, icons, the film and captions: cache for a week
    location ~* ^/(img|brand|og|video)/|\.(?:ico|png|webp|svg|woff2|webmanifest)$ {
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/security-headers.conf;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=604800" always;
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    # pages: always revalidate, so a deploy shows at once
    location / {
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/security-headers.conf;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache" always;
        try_files $uri $uri/index.html $uri.html =404;
    }

    location = /404.html {
        include /etc/nginx/snippets/security-headers.conf;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache" always;
        internal;
    }
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: website/nginx/security-headers.conf
====================================================================================================
# Sent with every response. nginx drops server-level add_header lines in any
# location that sets its own, so each such location includes this file again.
add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()" always;
add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin" always;
# Browsers apply HSTS only over HTTPS, so this is safe behind a TLS terminator.
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
# Content-Security-Policy, generated from the built pages by scripts/csp.mjs
include /etc/nginx/snippets/csp.conf;

FILE: website/scripts/csp.mjs

// Writes the Content-Security-Policy that nginx sends (see nginx/), from the built site:
// - inline <script>s run only if their exact SHA-256 hash is listed (every one in dist/ is);
// - the lead forms may post only to their endpoint (SITE.formEndpoint in src/data/site.js);
// - the language menu may load Google's page translator and nothing else from outside.
//   node scripts/csp.mjs [out-file]      (default: csp.conf, after `npm run build`)
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const out = process.argv[2] || join(root, 'csp.conf');

const pages = [];
const walk = (dir) => readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).forEach((e) => {
  const p = join(dir, e.name);
  if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if (e.name.endsWith('.html')) pages.push(p);
});
walk(join(root, 'dist'));
if (!pages.length) throw new Error('dist/ has no pages: run npm run build first');

const hashes = new Set();
for (const page of pages) {
  for (const [, attrs, body] of readFileSync(page, 'utf8').matchAll(/<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)) {
    if (/type=["']?application\/ld\+json/.test(attrs)) continue; // data, never executed
    hashes.add(`'sha256-${createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('base64')}'`);
  }
}

const { SITE } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, 'src/data/site.js')).href);
const endpoint = new URL(SITE.formEndpoint).origin;
// Google's page translator, loaded only when a visitor picks a language other than English
const GT = 'https://translate.google.com https://translate.googleapis.com https://translate-pa.googleapis.com https://www.gstatic.com https://www.google.com';

const policy = [
  "default-src 'self'",
  `script-src 'self' ${[...hashes].join(' ')} ${GT}`,
  `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' ${GT}`, // React writes style attributes for layout and animation
  `img-src 'self' data: ${GT}`,
  "font-src 'self' data:", // Vite inlines the smallest font subsets as data: URIs
  "media-src 'self'",
  `connect-src 'self' ${endpoint} ${GT}`,
  "manifest-src 'self'",
  "frame-src 'none'",
  "object-src 'none'",
  "base-uri 'self'",
  "form-action 'self'",
  "frame-ancestors 'none'",
].join('; ');

writeFileSync(out, `# Generated by scripts/csp.mjs from the built pages. Do not edit by hand.\nadd_header Content-Security-Policy "${policy}" always;\n`);
console.log(`CSP: ${hashes.size} inline script hash(es), forms -> ${endpoint} -> ${out}`);

FILE: website/scripts/prerender.mjs

// Renders every route in PATHS to static HTML, plus 404.html, sitemap.xml and
// robots.txt. Fails the build if a page has no H1 or more than one, or if any
// page would still stream content in after its loading placeholder.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const dist = join(root, 'dist');
const { render, PATHS } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, 'dist-ssr/entry-server.js')).href);
const { SITE } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(root, 'src/data/site.js')).href);
const template = readFileSync(join(dist, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const site = SITE.url;

const errors = [];
async function page(url, file) {
  // The first render loads the page's lazy module and data; the second is
  // complete and inline, so the HTML never shows a placeholder first.
  await render(url);
  const { html, head } = await render(url);
  if (html.includes('<template id="B:')) errors.push(`${url}: content deferred behind a Suspense placeholder`);
  const h1 = (html.match(/<h1[\s>]/g) || []).length;
  if (h1 !== 1) errors.push(`${url}: ${h1} <h1>`);
  const out = join(dist, file);
  mkdirSync(dirname(out), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(out, template.replace('<!--app-head-->', head).replace('<!--app-html-->', html));
}

for (const url of PATHS) await page(url, url === '/' ? 'index.html' : `${url.slice(1)}/index.html`);
await page('/404', '404.html');
if (errors.length) { console.error('Prerender failed:\n' + errors.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }

const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
writeFileSync(join(dist, 'sitemap.xml'), `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
${PATHS.map((p) => `  <url><loc>${site}${p === '/' ? '/' : p}</loc><lastmod>${today}</lastmod></url>`).join('\n')}
</urlset>
`);
writeFileSync(join(dist, 'robots.txt'), `User-agent: *\nAllow: /\n\nSitemap: ${site}/sitemap.xml\n`);
console.log(`Prerendered ${PATHS.length} pages + 404.html, sitemap.xml, robots.txt`);

FILE: website/scripts/serve.mjs
====================================================================================================
/* Serve dist/ the way Vercel or Netlify do: /trust -> trust/index.html,
   the 301s in _redirects, unknown paths -> 404.html with status 404, and byte
   ranges for the film (Safari needs them to play video). For local preview
   and the e2e tests.
     node scripts/serve.mjs [port]            (default 4173) */
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { createReadStream, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { extname, join, normalize } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../dist/', import.meta.url));
const port = +(process.argv[2] || 4173);
let REDIRECTS = [];
try {
  REDIRECTS = readFileSync(join(root, '_redirects'), 'utf8').split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith('#')).map((l) => l.split(/\s+/));
} catch { /* no redirects file */ }
const TYPES = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.png': 'image/png', '.webp': 'image/webp', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.xml': 'application/xml', '.txt': 'text/plain', '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm', '.vtt': 'text/vtt', '.json': 'application/json', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json' };

async function file(p) {
  try { const s = await stat(p); return s.isFile() ? { p, size: s.size } : null; } catch { return null; }
}

createServer(async (req, res) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
  const path = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname);
  if (path === '/healthz') { res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' }); res.end('ok'); return; }
  const moved = REDIRECTS.find(([from]) => from === path);
  if (moved) { res.writeHead(+moved[2] || 301, { Location: moved[1] + url.search }); res.end(); return; }
  const base = join(root, normalize(path).replace(/^(\.\.[/\\])+/, ''));
  const hit = await file(join(base, 'index.html')) || await file(base) || await file(base + '.html');
  const f = hit || await file(join(root, '404.html'));
  const type = TYPES[extname(f.p)] || 'application/octet-stream';
  const range = hit && req.headers.range && /bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(req.headers.range);
  if (range) {
    const start = range[1] ? +range[1] : 0, end = range[2] ? Math.min(+range[2], f.size - 1) : f.size - 1;
    res.writeHead(206, { 'Content-Type': type, 'Content-Range': `bytes ${start}-${end}/${f.size}`, 'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes', 'Content-Length': end - start + 1 });
    if (req.method === 'HEAD') return res.end();
    return createReadStream(f.p, { start, end }).pipe(res);
  }
  res.writeHead(hit ? 200 : 404, { 'Content-Type': type, 'Content-Length': f.size, 'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes' });
  if (req.method === 'HEAD') return res.end();
  createReadStream(f.p).pipe(res);
}).listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log('serving dist on http://127.0.0.1:' + port));

import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

/* Scroll to top on navigation, or to the #hash target. */
function PageEffects() {
  const { pathname, hash } = useLocation();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hash) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(hash.slice(1)))?.scrollIntoView(), 60);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
    return undefined;
  }, [pathname, hash]);
  // anything that scrolls sideways (the swipe rails on a phone, wide code) can
  // be reached and scrolled with the keyboard too
  useEffect(() => {
    const mark = () => document.querySelectorAll('main .m-rail, main pre, main .overflow-x-auto, main .vz-exact').forEach((el) => {
      const scrolls = el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1;
      if (scrolls && el.classList.contains('vz-exact') && !el.dataset.kb) el.scrollLeft = (el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth) / 2; // wide diagrams open on their centre
      if (scrolls && !el.hasAttribute('tabindex')) { el.tabIndex = 0; el.dataset.kb = '1'; if (!el.getAttribute('aria-label')) { if (!/^(UL|OL)$/.test(el.tagName) && !el.getAttribute('role')) el.setAttribute('role', 'region'); el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scrolls sideways'); } }
      else if (!scrolls && el.dataset.kb) { el.removeAttribute('tabindex'); delete el.dataset.kb; }
    });
    const t = setTimeout(mark, 900);
    window.addEventListener('resize', mark);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t); window.removeEventListener('resize', mark); };
  }, [pathname]);
  return null;
}

/* Each page is keyed by its path, so a new page fades up once; the first
   page (prerendered) shows at once. Children are the page's bands: .stage
   bands stay dark, the rest are the light sheets of the mixed theme. */
function Page({ children }) {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const seen = useRef({ path: pathname, moved: false });
  if (seen.current.path !== pathname) seen.current = { path: pathname, moved: true };
  return <div key={pathname} className={seen.current.moved ? 'page page-in' : 'page'}>{children}</div>;
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <>
      <Backdrop />
      <Header />
      <CommandLauncher />
      <main id="main" className="pt-[var(--hdr)]">
        <PageEffects />
        <Suspense fallback={<div className="page"><div className="stage min-h-screen" /></div>}>
          <Page>
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
            {/* the company page and the old Why page are now one page */}
            <Route path="/platform" element={<Navigate to="/why-deep-algorithms" replace />} />
            <Route path="/about-us" element={<Navigate to="/why-deep-algorithms" replace />} />
            <Route path="/products" element={<Products />} />
            {Object.entries(PRODUCT_PAGES).map(([k, P]) => <Route key={k} path={PRODUCTS[k].path} element={<P />} />)}
            {Object.entries(ZCAPS).map(([k, c]) => <Route key={k} path={c.path} element={<Capability id={k} />} />)}
            <Route path="/solutions/:slug" element={<Solution />} />
            <Route path="/why-deep-algorithms" element={<Why />} />
            <Route path="/blogs" element={<Blog />} />
            <Route path="/blogs/:slug" element={<Article />} />
            <Route path="/product-tour" element={<Tour />} />
            <Route path="/request-demo" element={<Demo />} />
            <Route path="/contact" element={<Contact />} />
            <Route path="/sitemap" element={<Sitemap />} />
            {Object.keys(LEGAL).map((k) => <Route key={k} path={`/${k}`} element={<Legal id={k} />} />)}
            <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
          </Routes>
          </Page>
        </Suspense>
      </main>
      <Footer />
      <JumpBar />
      <MobileBar />
    </>
  );
}

import { prerender } from 'react-dom/static';
import { StaticRouter } from 'react-router';
import App, { PATHS } from './App.jsx';
import { HeadContext, headToHtml } from './lib/head.jsx';

export { PATHS };

export async function render(url) {
  const head = {};
  // Static pages: keep every boundary inline. Without this, React outlines large
  // boundaries into a later segment and the page shows its placeholder first.
  const { prelude } = await prerender(
    <HeadContext.Provider value={head}><StaticRouter location={url}><App /></StaticRouter></HeadContext.Provider>,
    { progressiveChunkSize: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER },
  );
  const html = await new Response(prelude).text();
  return { html, head: headToHtml(head) };
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Deep Algorithms design system, 2026.
   - One type family: Inter 4 with its optical-size axis. Large sizes get the
     Display cut automatically; body text gets the Text cut. JetBrains Mono is
     used only for machine values inside product UI (IDs, hashes, timestamps).
   - One theme, mixing tones: dark `stage` bands (heroes, the film,
     the logo moment, calls to action, the footer) and light `sheets` for
     everything people read, which slide over the dark canvas with rounded
     edges.
     Colours are tokens, so a light sheet only redefines them; product
     pictures (.vz) and anything marked .tone-d stay dark inside a sheet.
   - Dark bands are neutral graphite, light sheets near-white; brand blue is
     the one accent for actions. Backgrounds have three moods: `flow` (fine
     silver ribbons, heroes only), the still backdrop behind dark bands, and
     `calm` (a solid surface behind dense reading: articles, forms, tables).

   ========================================================================== */

import { cx } from './ui.jsx';

/* Certification seals, drawn the way the Zenstra AI site draws them (the same
   company's artwork): a round seal with a rule for the ISO standards, a
   rounded square for the SOC 2 Type II audit report. Colours come from CSS
   (.seal) so they read on light, dark and the deep-blue bands. */

export const SEAL_KIND = { 'ISO 27001': 'Certified', 'SOC 2': 'Audit report', 'ISO 42001': 'Certified', 'ISO 27701': 'Certified' };

export default function CertSeal({ code, size = 56, className, title }) {
  const soc = code.startsWith('SOC');
  const num = code.replace(/^ISO\s*/, '');
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width={size} height={size} className={cx('seal shrink-0', className)} role={title ? 'img' : undefined} aria-label={title} aria-hidden={title ? undefined : true}>
      {soc ? (
        <>
          <rect className="o" x="3" y="3" width="58" height="58" rx="17" />
          <rect className="d" x="7.5" y="7.5" width="49" height="49" rx="13" />
          <rect className="i" x="12" y="12" width="40" height="40" rx="10" />
          <text className="t" x="32" y="31" textAnchor="middle">SOC 2</text>
          <text className="s" x="32" y="41" textAnchor="middle">TYPE II</text>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <circle className="o" cx="32" cy="32" r="30" />
          <circle className="d" cx="32" cy="32" r="25.5" />
          <circle className="i" cx="32" cy="32" r="21" />
          <text className="t" x="32" y="29.5" textAnchor="middle">ISO</text>
          <line className="ln" x1="19" y1="34" x2="45" y2="34" />
          <text className="s" x="32" y="42.5" textAnchor="middle">{num}</text>
        </>
      )}
    </svg>
  );
}

import { Icon, Reveal, cx } from './ui.jsx';

/* "What changes with …": one comparison per product, each in the form that suits
   its story. Zenstra sets an agent's five moments side by side, before and
   after; adapID races two timelines of the same stolen password; ICMS answers
   the auditor's questions. (BotShield's queue is a scene: scenes/proof.jsx.) */

/* ---------- Zenstra: five moments, before and after ---------- */
const ZEN = [
  ['Discover', 'Agents found after an incident, one platform at a time', 'One inventory of every agent, each with a named owner'],
  ['Access', 'Standing keys and service accounts with broad scope', 'Grants scoped to the task that expire on their own'],
  ['Act', 'Logs that show what happened, after it happened', 'Every action decided inline, before it runs'],
  ['Stop', 'A separate switch in every vendor to stop one agent', 'One revocation stops an agent everywhere, in seconds'],
  ['Prove', 'Evidence pulled together by hand for every exam', 'A tamper-evident record, exported as evidence'],
];

/* Before and after, side by side, the way enterprise pages show a change:
   the old way muted, the new way lit, the same five moments in each. */
export function ZenCompare() {
  const acc = 'var(--color-zen)';
  const Col = ({ on }) => (
    <div className={on ? 'chg-with' : 'chg-without'} style={{ '--acc': acc }}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-6 pb-4 pt-6 md:px-7">
        <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.1em]" style={{ color: on ? acc : 'var(--color-crit)' }}>{on ? 'With Zenstra' : 'Without Zenstra'}</p>
        <span className="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold" style={on ? { background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ok) 14%, transparent)', color: 'var(--color-ok)' } : { background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-crit) 12%, transparent)', color: 'var(--color-crit)' }}>{on ? 'Decided before it runs' : 'Found after the incident'}</span>
      </div>
      <ol className="px-3 pb-3 md:px-4 md:pb-4">
        {ZEN.map(([moment, off, onText], i) => (
          <Reveal as="li" key={moment} delay={(on ? 300 : 0) + i * 90} className="flex gap-3.5 rounded-[14px] px-3 py-3.5 md:px-3.5">
            <span className="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full" style={on ? { background: acc, color: '#fff' } : { background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-crit) 12%, transparent)', color: 'var(--color-crit)' }}>
              <Icon name={on ? 'Check' : 'X'} size={15} weight="bold" />
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.1em] text-ink-3"><span className="num mr-1.5">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>{moment}</span>
              <span className={on ? 'mt-0.5 block text-[16px] font-medium leading-snug text-ink' : 'mt-0.5 block text-[15.5px] leading-snug text-ink-3'}>{on ? onText : off}</span>
            </span>
          </Reveal>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
      <Col on={false} />
      <Col on />
    </div>
  );
}

          </p>
        </Reveal>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { PRODUCTS } from '../data/products.js';
import { ZCAPS } from '../data/zenstra.js';
import { SOLUTIONS } from '../data/site.js';
import { POSTS } from '../data/posts.js';
import { LEGAL } from '../data/legal.js';
import { Icon, cx } from './ui.jsx';

/* Two overlays, loaded only when asked for:
   - search: Ctrl/⌘ K, "/" or the header button. Every page, product and report.
   - terminal: the ` key. A small, clearly fictional shell for the curious. */

/* ---------- shared: lock the page, trap focus, give it back on close ---------- */
function useOverlay(onClose) {
  const close = useRef(onClose);
  close.current = onClose;
  useEffect(() => {
    const back = document.activeElement;
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const prev = html.style.overflow;
    html.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    const esc = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); close.current(); } };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', esc);
    return () => { html.style.overflow = prev; window.removeEventListener('keydown', esc); back?.focus?.({ preventScroll: true }); };
  }, []);
}

/* ---------- search ---------- */
const INDEX = [
  ...Object.values(PRODUCTS).map((p) => ({ group: 'Products', title: p.name, sub: p.line === p.name ? p.description : `${p.line} · ${p.description}`, path: p.path })),
  ...Object.values(ZCAPS).map((c) => ({ group: 'Zenstra AI capabilities', title: c.name, sub: c.short, path: c.path })),
  ...SOLUTIONS.map((s) => ({ group: 'Solutions', title: s.name, sub: s.desc, path: `/solutions/${s.slug}` })),
  ...POSTS.map((p) => ({ group: 'Blogs', title: p.title, sub: `${p.category} · ${p.read} min read`, path: `/blogs/${p.slug}`, more: p.excerpt })),
  { group: 'Company', title: 'Why Deep Algorithms', sub: 'The company, the team and how the products work', path: '/why-deep-algorithms' },
  { group: 'Company', title: 'All products', sub: 'Filter by what you need to protect', path: '/products' },
  { group: 'Company', title: 'All blogs', sub: 'Reports, field notes and analysis', path: '/blogs' },
  ...[
    ['Leadership', 'The team and our advisors', '/why-deep-algorithms#leadership'],
    ['Recognition', 'Awards, programmes and certifications', '/why-deep-algorithms#recognition'],
    ['Careers', 'Work on hard security problems', '/why-deep-algorithms#careers'],
    ['Contact', 'Offices, phone and email', '/contact'],
  ].map(([title, sub, path]) => ({ group: 'Company', title, sub, path })),
  { group: 'Company', title: 'Book a demo', sub: '30 minutes with an engineer, on your environment', path: '/request-demo' },
  ...Object.entries(LEGAL).map(([k, l]) => ({ group: 'Legal', title: l.title, sub: '', path: `/${k}` })),
];
const SUGGESTED = ['/agentic-ai/agentic-identity', '/adapid-ai', '/botshield-ai', '/dpdpa-compliance', '/request-demo', `/blogs/${POSTS[0].slug}`];
const norm = (s) => s.toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, ' ');

function search(q) {
  const words = norm(q).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!words.length) return SUGGESTED.map((p) => ({ ...INDEX.find((i) => i.path === p), group: 'Suggested' }));
  return INDEX.map((it) => {
    const t = norm(it.title), all = `${t} ${norm(it.sub)} ${norm(it.more || '')} ${norm(it.group)}`;
    if (!words.every((w) => all.includes(w))) return null;
    const score = (t.startsWith(words[0]) ? 4 : 0) + words.filter((w) => t.includes(w)).length * 2 + (it.group === 'Products' ? 1 : 0);
    return { ...it, score };
  }).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, 12);
}

function Search({ onClose }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [at, setAt] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef(null);
  const list = useRef(null);
  const go = useNavigate();
  const hits = useMemo(() => search(q), [q]);
  useOverlay(onClose);
  useEffect(() => { input.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { setAt(0); }, [q]);
  useEffect(() => { list.current?.querySelector(`[data-i="${at}"]`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); }, [at]);
  const open = (h) => { if (!h) return; onClose(); go(h.path); };
  const key = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((i) => Math.min(hits.length - 1, i + 1)); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((i) => Math.max(0, i - 1)); }
    else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); open(hits[at]); }
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') e.preventDefault();
  };
  let last = '';
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex items-start justify-center bg-black/55 px-4 pt-[10vh] fadein" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Search the site" className="tone-l w-full max-w-[640px] overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] border border-line-2 bg-bg-1 text-ink shadow-[0_40px_120px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,.7)]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-line px-5">
          <Icon name="MagnifyingGlass" size={19} className="shrink-0 text-ink-3" />
          <input ref={input} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={key} placeholder="Search products, solutions and blogs"
            className="h-[60px] w-full bg-transparent text-[17px] text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-3" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="cmd-list" aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-activedescendant={hits[at] ? `cmd-${at}` : undefined} autoComplete="off" spellCheck="false" />
          <kbd className="hidden shrink-0 rounded-md border border-line-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-sans text-[12px] text-ink-3 sm:block">Esc</kbd>
        </div>
        <ul ref={list} id="cmd-list" role="listbox" aria-label="Results" className="max-h-[min(60vh,460px)] overflow-y-auto p-2">
          {hits.length === 0 && <li className="px-4 py-10 text-center text-[15px] text-ink-3">Nothing matches “{q}”. Try a product name, an attack or a regulation.</li>}
          {hits.map((h, i) => {
            const head = h.group !== last ? (last = h.group) : null;
            return (
              <li key={h.path + i} role="presentation">
                {head && <p className="px-3 pb-1.5 pt-3 text-[11.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.1em] text-ink-3">{head}</p>}
                <div id={`cmd-${i}`} data-i={i} role="option" aria-selected={i === at} onMouseMove={() => setAt(i)} onClick={() => open(h)}
                  className={cx('flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-[11px] px-3 py-2.5', i === at && 'bg-bg-2')}>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block truncate text-[15px] font-medium">{h.title}</span>
                    {h.sub && <span className="block truncate text-[13px] text-ink-3">{h.sub}</span>}
                  </span>
                  <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={15} className={cx('shrink-0 text-ink-3 transition-opacity', i === at ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')} />
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 border-t border-line px-5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-3">
          <span><kbd className="font-sans">↑</kbd> <kbd className="font-sans">↓</kbd> to move</span><span><kbd className="font-sans">↵</kbd> to open</span>
          <span className="ml-auto hidden sm:inline">Ctrl K or ⌘ K, anywhere</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- terminal ---------- */
const DIRS = {
  zenstra: '/agentic-ai/agentic-identity', adapid: '/adapid-ai', botshield: '/botshield-ai', icms: '/dpdpa-compliance',
  nhi: '/adapid-ai/nhi-security', fraud: '/adapid-ai/fraud-prevention', ad: '/ad-security', ddos: '/botshield-ai/ddos-protection',
  blogs: '/blogs', research: '/blogs', company: '/why-deep-algorithms', platform: '/why-deep-algorithms', products: '/products', demo: '/request-demo', contact: '/contact', home: '/',
};
const HELP = [
  ['help', 'this list'], ['ls', 'what is here'], ['open <name>', 'go to a page, e.g. open zenstra'], ['whoami', 'who the site thinks you are'],
  ['cat mission', 'why we exist'], ['date', 'the time at headquarters'], ['history', 'what you typed'],
  ['clear', 'clear the screen'], ['exit', 'close the terminal'],
];
const hydTime = () => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IN', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata', weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(new Date());

function run(raw, { go, history }) {
  const line = raw.trim();
  const [cmd = '', ...args] = line.split(/\s+/);
  const arg = args.join(' ');
  switch (cmd.toLowerCase()) {
    case '': return [];
    case 'help': case '?': return [...HELP.map(([c, d]) => ({ k: 'out', t: `  ${c.padEnd(14)}${d}` })), { k: 'dim', t: '  There may be one or two others.' }];
    case 'ls': case 'dir': return [{ k: 'out', t: Object.keys(DIRS).map((d) => `${d}/`).join('  ') }];
    case 'open': case 'cd': case 'go': {
      const d = arg.toLowerCase().replace(/[/~.]/g, '');
      if (!d) return [{ k: 'out', t: 'open what? Try: open zenstra' }];
      if (!DIRS[d]) return [{ k: 'err', t: `no such page: ${arg}. Try ls.` }];
      go(DIRS[d]); return [{ k: 'ok', t: `opening ${d}…` }];
    }
    case 'whoami': return [{ k: 'out', t: 'guest · not signed in · nothing about you is stored' }, { k: 'out', t: 'risk score 12/100 · normal. Carry on.' }];
    case 'cat':
      if (/^(mission|readme)/i.test(arg)) return [{ k: 'out', t: 'Identity security for the AI era.' }, { k: 'out', t: 'People, machine identities and AI agents hold the keys now. We learn how each one behaves, and stop the one that is misused before it becomes a breach.' }];
      return [{ k: 'err', t: arg ? `cat: ${arg}: no such file` : 'cat what? Try: cat mission' }];
    case 'date': case 'time': return [{ k: 'out', t: `Hyderabad · ${hydTime()} IST` }];
    case 'history': return history.map((h, i) => ({ k: 'out', t: `  ${String(i + 1).padStart(3)}  ${h}` }));
    case 'echo': return [{ k: 'out', t: arg }];
    case 'pwd': return [{ k: 'out', t: `/home/guest${location.pathname === '/' ? '' : location.pathname}` }];
    case 'sudo': case 'su': return [{ k: 'err', t: 'Permission denied. Checked against your task: not part of it.' }, { k: 'dim', t: 'Blocked · 4 ms' }];
    case 'rm': return [{ k: 'err', t: 'Blocked before it ran.' }, { k: 'dim', t: 'Deleting things is not part of your task either.' }];
    case 'nmap': case 'hack': case 'exploit': case 'scan':
      return [{ k: 'out', t: 'We only scan what we are allowed to, with the owner’s permission.' }, { k: 'dim', t: 'See how it works properly: open botshield' }];
    case 'decrypt': return [{ k: 'ok', t: 'Access granted. Well, to this message.' }, { k: 'out', t: 'You read the console, decoded the note and found the terminal. Curiosity like that is exactly what security needs. Thank you for looking under the hood.' }];
    case 'coffee': case 'chai': return [{ k: 'out', t: 'Brewing… Hyderabad runs on filter coffee and Irani chai. Both are allowed by policy.' }];
    case 'ping': return [{ k: 'out', t: 'pong · 4 ms' }];
    case 'exit': case 'quit': case 'q': return null;
    default: return [{ k: 'err', t: `command not found: ${cmd}. Type help.` }];
  }
}
const NAMES = ['help', 'ls', 'open', 'whoami', 'cat', 'date', 'history', 'clear', 'exit', 'echo', 'pwd', ...Object.keys(DIRS).map((d) => `open ${d}`), 'cat mission'];
const TONE = { in: 'text-[#f2f3f5]', out: 'text-[#c9cdd3]', dim: 'text-[#7d838d]', err: 'text-[#ff8a7e]', ok: 'text-[#6be3a4]' };

function Terminal({ onClose }) {
  const go = useNavigate();
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(() => [
    { k: 'dim', t: `Last login: ${hydTime()} on ttys001` },
    { k: 'out', t: 'Deep Algorithms terminal. You found it.' },
    { k: 'dim', t: 'This is a toy shell on our website. Type help to begin, exit to leave.' },
  ]);
  const [v, setV] = useState('');
  const [hist, setHist] = useState([]);
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(-1);
  const input = useRef(null);
  const end = useRef(null);
  useOverlay(onClose);
  useEffect(() => { input.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { end.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'end' }); }, [lines]);
  const submit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const nextHist = v.trim() ? [...hist, v.trim()] : hist;
    const prompt = { k: 'in', t: `guest@deepalgorithms:~$ ${v}` };
    if (/^\s*clear\s*$/i.test(v)) { setLines([]); setHist(nextHist); setV(''); setHi(-1); return; }
    const out = run(v, { go: (p) => { setTimeout(() => { onClose(); go(p); }, 350); }, history: nextHist });
    if (out === null) { onClose(); return; }
    setLines((l) => [...l, prompt, ...out].slice(-200));
    setHist(nextHist); setV(''); setHi(-1);
  };
  const key = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && hist.length) { e.preventDefault(); const i = hi < 0 ? hist.length - 1 : Math.max(0, hi - 1); setHi(i); setV(hist[i]); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && hi >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); const i = hi + 1; if (i >= hist.length) { setHi(-1); setV(''); } else { setHi(i); setV(hist[i]); } }
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
      // complete to the longest shared prefix; list the choices when it is ambiguous
      e.preventDefault();
      const m = v ? NAMES.filter((n) => n.startsWith(v.toLowerCase())) : [];
      if (m.length === 1) setV(`${m[0]} `);
      else if (m.length > 1) {
        let pre = m[0];
        for (const n of m) while (!n.startsWith(pre)) pre = pre.slice(0, -1);
        if (pre.length > v.length) setV(pre); else setLines((l) => [...l, { k: 'dim', t: m.join('  ') }]);
      }
    }
    else if (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey) { e.preventDefault(); setLines([]); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex items-start justify-center bg-black/55 px-4 pt-[12vh] fadein" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Deep Algorithms terminal" className="w-full max-w-[720px] overflow-hidden rounded-[14px] border border-white/15 bg-[#0c0d10] shadow-[0_40px_120px_-30px_rgba(0,0,0,.85)]">
        <div className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/10 bg-white/[.03] px-4">
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close the terminal" className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-[#ff5f57]" />
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-[#febc2e]" /><span aria-hidden="true" className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-[#28c840]" />
          <span className="mx-auto flex items-center gap-2 pr-12 text-[12.5px] text-[#9aa0a9]"><Icon name="TerminalWindow" size={14} />guest@deepalgorithms · Deep Algorithms terminal</span>
        </div>
        <div className="mono h-[min(56vh,420px)] overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4 text-[13.5px] leading-[1.65]" onMouseUp={() => { if (!getSelection()?.toString()) input.current?.focus(); }} aria-live="polite">
          {lines.map((l, i) => <p key={i} className={cx('whitespace-pre-wrap break-words', TONE[l.k])}>{l.t}</p>)}
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <label htmlFor="term-in" className="shrink-0 text-[#6be3a4]">guest@deepalgorithms:~$</label>
            <input id="term-in" ref={input} value={v} onChange={(e) => setV(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={key} autoComplete="off" autoCapitalize="off" spellCheck="false"
              className="mono min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-[#f2f3f5] caret-[#6be3a4] outline-none" aria-label="Command" />
          </form>
          <div ref={end} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Command({ mode, onClose }) {
  return mode === 'terminal' ? <Terminal onClose={onClose} /> : <Search onClose={onClose} />;
}

import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const Command = lazy(() => import('./Command.jsx'));

/* Opens the site search (Ctrl/⌘ K, "/", or a `da:command` event from the
   header button) and the hidden terminal (the ` key). Nothing loads until asked. */
export default function CommandLauncher() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(null);
  const close = useCallback(() => setMode(null), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const key = (e) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); setMode((m) => (m === 'search' ? null : 'search')); return; }
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.defaultPrevented) return;
      if (e.target.closest?.('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=""], [contenteditable="true"]')) return;
      if (e.key === '/') { e.preventDefault(); setMode('search'); }
      else if (e.key === '`') { e.preventDefault(); setMode((m) => (m === 'terminal' ? null : 'terminal')); }
    };
    const ask = (e) => setMode(e.detail === 'terminal' ? 'terminal' : 'search');
    window.addEventListener('keydown', key);
    window.addEventListener('da:command', ask);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('keydown', key); window.removeEventListener('da:command', ask); };
  }, []);
  if (!mode) return null;
  return <Suspense fallback={null}><Command key={mode} mode={mode} onClose={close} /></Suspense>;
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { cx } from '../lib/motion.js';

/* Glowing fibre ribbons, after the light strands in the reference film:
   hundreds of fine strands gather into one bright knot and fan out again.
   `drawRibbons` is pure (time in, picture out) so the product film can render
   the same light frame by frame. Shapes are in 0..1 page units. */

// Catmull-Rom through points -> sample at s in [0,1]
function spline(pts, s) {
  const n = pts.length - 1;
  const x = Math.min(n - 1e-6, Math.max(0, s * n));
  const i = Math.floor(x), t = x - i;
  const p0 = pts[Math.max(0, i - 1)], p1 = pts[i], p2 = pts[i + 1], p3 = pts[Math.min(n, i + 2)];
  const t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
  const f = (a, b, c, d) => 0.5 * (2 * b + (-a + c) * t + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * c - d) * t2 + (-a + 3 * b - 3 * c + d) * t3);
  return [f(p0[0], p1[0], p2[0], p3[0]), f(p0[1], p1[1], p2[1], p3[1])];
}

const rnd = (seed) => { let s = seed; return () => { s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647; return (s - 1) / 2147483646; }; };

/* hue pairs: brand blues by default; product accents tint the far ends */
const ACCENTS = { brand: [198, 208], zen: [228, 238], adap: [194, 200], bot: [168, 178], icms: [40, 48] };

export function buildScene(preset, accent = 'brand', seed = 7) {
  const r = rnd(seed);
  const hue = ACCENTS[accent] || ACCENTS.brand;
  return preset.bundles.map((b) => ({
    ...b,
    hue: accent === 'brand' ? (b.hue || hue) : hue,
    strands: Array.from({ length: b.n }, () => ({
      o: (r() * 2 - 1) * (0.35 + 0.65 * r()),
      rr: 0.25 + 0.75 * Math.sqrt(r()),
      th: r() * Math.PI * 2,
      w: 0.45 + r() * 1.1,
      a: 0.08 + Math.pow(r(), 2) * 0.42,
      f: 0.12 + r() * 0.3,
      k: 2 + r() * 5,
      ph: r() * Math.PI * 2,
      amp: 0.18 + r() * 0.55,
    })),
    sparks: Array.from({ length: Math.round(b.n / 6) }, () => ({ j: Math.floor(r() * b.n), v: 0.03 + r() * 0.06, s0: r() })),
  }));
}

const M = 64; // samples per strand
export function drawRibbons(ctx, W, H, t, scene, { intensity = 1, pointer = [0, 0], sat = 100 } = {}) {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  const S = Math.min(W, H) * 0.9 + Math.max(W, H) * 0.1;
  for (const b of scene) {
    const pts = b.pts.map(([x, y]) => [(x + pointer[0] * 0.015) * W, (y + pointer[1] * 0.02) * H]);
    // centre line, normals and width envelope
    const C = [], N = [], Wd = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= M; i++) {
      const s = i / M;
      const p = spline(pts, s), q = spline(pts, Math.min(1, s + 0.004));
      let dx = q[0] - p[0], dy = q[1] - p[1];
      const l = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1; dx /= l; dy /= l;
      C.push(p); N.push([-dy, dx]);
      const d = Math.abs(s - b.pinch) / Math.max(b.pinch, 1 - b.pinch);
      Wd.push((b.spread[0] + (b.spread[1] - b.spread[0]) * Math.pow(d, 1.25)) * S);
    }
    const [h0, h1] = b.hue;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(C[0][0], C[0][1], C[M][0], C[M][1]);
    grad.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${h1}, ${sat}%, 45%, 0)`);
    grad.addColorStop(Math.max(0.05, b.pinch - 0.32), `hsla(${h1}, ${sat}%, 52%, 1)`);
    grad.addColorStop(b.pinch, `hsla(${h0}, ${sat}%, 88%, 1)`);
    grad.addColorStop(Math.min(0.95, b.pinch + 0.32), `hsla(${h0}, ${sat}%, 55%, 1)`);
    grad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${h1}, ${sat}%, 45%, 0)`);
    ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    const amul = (b.alpha ?? 1) * intensity;

    // soft glow under the bundle
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05 * amul;
    for (const lw of [Wd[0] * 0.5, Wd[0] * 0.25]) {
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(6, lw);
      ctx.beginPath();
      C.forEach((p, i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : ctx.moveTo(p[0], p[1])));
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // strands
    const pos = (st, i) => {
      const s = i / M;
      const wob = Math.sin(t * st.f + s * st.k + st.ph) * st.amp;
      const twist = st.rr * Math.cos(st.th + s * 7.5 + t * 0.22);
      const off = (st.o * 0.45 + twist * 0.55 + wob * 0.3) * Wd[i];
      return [C[i][0] + N[i][0] * off, C[i][1] + N[i][1] * off];
    };
    for (const st of b.strands) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = st.a * amul;
      ctx.lineWidth = st.w * (W > 900 ? 1 : 0.8);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= M; i++) { const p = pos(st, i); if (i) ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]); else ctx.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); }
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // light running along the fibres
    for (const sp of b.sparks) {
      const st = b.strands[sp.j];
      const u = (sp.s0 + t * sp.v) % 1;
      const i = Math.min(M, Math.round(u * M));
      const p = pos(st, i);
      const fade = Math.sin(u * Math.PI);
      // a short bright trail behind the spark
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 * fade * amul;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let q = Math.max(0, i - 4); q <= i; q++) { const pq = pos(st, q); if (q === Math.max(0, i - 4)) ctx.moveTo(pq[0], pq[1]); else ctx.lineTo(pq[0], pq[1]); }
      ctx.stroke();
      const rr = 1.4 + 2.6 * fade;
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p[0], p[1], 0, p[0], p[1], rr * 2.6);
      g.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${h0}, ${sat}%, 95%, ${0.95 * fade * amul})`);
      g.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${h0}, ${sat}%, 70%, 0)`);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0], p[1], rr * 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // the bright knot
    const k = C[Math.round(b.pinch * M)];
    const kr = S * 0.16;
    const kg = ctx.createRadialGradient(k[0], k[1], 0, k[0], k[1], kr);
    kg.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${h0}, ${sat}%, 90%, ${0.42 * amul})`);
    kg.addColorStop(0.25, `hsla(${h0}, ${sat}%, 65%, ${0.16 * amul})`);
    kg.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${h1}, ${sat}%, 50%, 0)`);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = kg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(k[0], k[1], kr, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
}

/* On the site the ribbons are fine silver strands with only a trace of the
   brand blue, at a fraction of their strength: texture, not decoration.
   (The product film draws them in full colour.) */
const DIM = 0.5;
const SAT = 28;

export default function FlowRibbons({ preset = 'hero', mobilePreset, accent = 'brand', intensity: level = 1, className, fade = true }) {
  const intensity = level * DIM;
  const host = useRef(null);
  const cv = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = host.current, c = cv.current;
    if (!el || !c) return undefined;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
    let W = 0, H = 0, scene = null, raf = 0, visible = true, last = 0, t = 0;
    const pointer = [0, 0], target = [0, 0];
    const size = () => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, r.width < 700 ? 1.25 : 1.5);
      W = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width * dpr)); H = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height * dpr));
      c.width = W; c.height = H;
      const p = r.width < 760 && mobilePreset ? mobilePreset : preset;
      scene = buildScene(PRESETS[p], accent);
      drawRibbons(ctx, W, H, t, scene, { intensity, sat: SAT });
    };
    const frame = (now) => {
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      if (!visible || document.hidden) { last = now; return; }
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000 || 0);
      if (now - last < 1000 / 48) return; // ~48 fps is plenty for slow light
      last = now; t += dt * 1.0;
      pointer[0] += (target[0] - pointer[0]) * 0.04; pointer[1] += (target[1] - pointer[1]) * 0.04;
      drawRibbons(ctx, W, H, t, scene, { intensity, pointer, sat: SAT });
    };
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(size); ro.observe(el);
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { visible = e.isIntersecting; }); io.observe(el);
    const move = (e) => { target[0] = e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5; target[1] = e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5; };
    size();
    if (!reduce) {
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      if (fine) window.addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: true });
    }
    c.style.opacity = '1';
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); ro.disconnect(); io.disconnect(); window.removeEventListener('pointermove', move); };
  }, [preset, mobilePreset, accent, intensity]);
  return (
    <div ref={host} aria-hidden="true" className={cx('flow', fade && 'flow-fade', className)}>
      <canvas ref={cv} style={{ opacity: 0, transition: 'opacity 1.2s ease' }} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { SITE } from '../data/site.js';
import { Button, Icon, cx } from './ui.jsx';

export const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

export function Field({ label, name, error, as = 'input', children, className, ...rest }) {
  const id = useId();
  const As = as;
  const cls = cx('mt-2 w-full rounded-[12px] border bg-bg-1 px-4 text-[16px] text-ink outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-ink-3 focus:border-cyan focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan/25',
    error ? 'border-crit' : 'border-line-2', as === 'textarea' ? 'min-h-[140px] py-3' : 'h-12', as === 'select' && 'appearance-none pr-11');
  const control = <As id={id} name={name} className={cls} aria-invalid={!!error} aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-e` : undefined} {...rest}>{children}</As>;
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-2">{label}</label>
      {as === 'select' ? <div className="relative">{control}<Icon name="CaretDown" size={14} className="pointer-events-none absolute right-4 top-[calc(50%+4px)] -translate-y-1/2 text-ink-3" /></div> : control}
      {error && <p id={`${id}-e`} className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] text-crit">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* Posts JSON to the lead endpoint. `website` is a honeypot: people never see
   it, simple bots fill it, and those submissions are dropped silently. */
export function useLeadForm(initial, validate, toPayload) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState(initial);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('idle'); // idle | sending | sent | error
  const bind = (k) => ({ value: values[k], onChange: (e) => setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [k]: e.target.value })) });

  const onSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const errs = validate(values);
    setErrors(errs);
    if (Object.keys(errs).length) {
      e.currentTarget.elements[Object.keys(errs)[0]]?.focus(); // error keys are field names
      return;
    }
    if (e.currentTarget.website.value) { setStatus('sent'); return; }
    setStatus('sending');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(SITE.formEndpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(toPayload(values)) });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      setStatus('sent');
      if (window.gtag) window.gtag('event', 'generate_lead', { form: toPayload(values).request_type });
    } catch {
      setStatus('error');
    }
  };
  return { values, errors, status, bind, onSubmit };
}

export function Honeypot() {
  return (
    <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -left-[9999px] h-px w-px overflow-hidden">
      <label>Website<input name="website" tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" /></label>
    </div>
  );
}

          <span>We could not send this. Please try again, or email us at <a href={`mailto:${SITE.email}`} className="underline">{SITE.email}</a>.</span>
        </p>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" size="lg" className="w-full" disabled={status === 'sending'} aria-busy={status === 'sending'}>
        {status === 'sending' ? 'Sending…' : label}
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}

/* The language menu (src/lib/translate.js): English is the source. */
function LanguageMenu({ away, className, up }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lang, setL] = useState('en');
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => { setL(getLang()); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined;
    const out = (e) => { if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false); };
    const key = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false); };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', out);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', key);
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', out); document.removeEventListener('keydown', key); };
  }, [open]);
  const cur = LANGS.find(([c]) => c === lang);
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cx('relative notranslate', className)} translate="no">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} aria-expanded={open} aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-label={`Language: ${cur[2]}`} tabIndex={away ? -1 : undefined}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-ink">
        <Icon name="Globe" size={14} />{cur[1]}<Icon name="CaretDown" size={10} weight="bold" className={cx('transition-transform', open && 'rotate-180')} />
      </button>
      {open && (
        <ul role="listbox" aria-label="Language" className={cx('absolute right-0 z-10 max-h-[340px] w-[210px] overflow-y-auto rounded-[12px] border border-line-2 bg-bg p-1.5 shadow-[0_24px_60px_-20px_rgba(6,25,55,.45)]', up ? 'bottom-full mb-2' : 'top-full mt-2')}>
          {LANGS.map(([c, n, en]) => (
            <li key={c}>
              <button type="button" role="option" aria-selected={c === lang} onClick={() => { setOpen(false); setLang(c); }}
                className={cx('flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-[8px] px-3 py-2 text-left text-[14px] hover:bg-fg/[.05]', c === lang ? 'font-semibold text-ink' : 'text-ink-2')}>
                <span>{n}</span>{c !== 'en' && <span className="text-[12.5px] text-ink-3">{en}</span>}{c === lang && c === 'en' && <Icon name="Check" size={14} />}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="mb-2 mt-7 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.1em] text-ink-3">Solutions</p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {SOLUTIONS.map((x) => <Link key={x.slug} to={`/solutions/${x.slug}`} onClick={onNav} className="rounded-full border border-line-2 px-3.5 py-2 text-[14px] text-ink-2">{x.name}</Link>)}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-5">
        {[['Blogs', '/blogs'], ['Why Deep Algorithms', '/why-deep-algorithms'], ['Careers', '/why-deep-algorithms#careers'], ['Contact', '/contact']].map(([n, to]) => (
          <Link key={to} to={to} onClick={onNav} className={row}>{n}<Icon name="CaretRight" size={15} className="text-ink-3" /></Link>
        ))}

        <LanguageMenu up className="rounded-full border border-line-2 px-3.5 py-2" />

export default function Header() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(null);
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState(false);
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [overLight, setOverLight] = useState(false);
  const [tucked, setTucked] = useState(false);
  const lastY = useRef(0);
  const timer = useRef();
  const { pathname, search, hash } = useLocation();

  useEffect(() => { setOpen(null); setMobile(false); }, [pathname, search, hash]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const on = () => setMobile(true);
    window.addEventListener('da:menu', on);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('da:menu', on);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { setOpen(null); setMobile(false); } };
    // Light when a light sheet sits under the bar (mixed theme only; CSS ignores it in dark).
    let raf = 0;
    const measure = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const y = window.scrollY;
      setScrolled(y > 8);
      if (y < 140 || y < lastY.current - 2) setTucked(false);
      else if (y > lastY.current + 2) setTucked(true);
      lastY.current = y;
      let light = false;
      for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.page > :not(.stage, .fixed)')) {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.top <= 40 && r.bottom >= 32) { light = true; break; }
      }
      setOverLight(light);
    };
    const onScroll = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(measure); };
    measure();
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll); window.removeEventListener('resize', onScroll); };
  }, []);
  // re-measure once the next page has rendered
  useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')), 120); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [pathname]);
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = mobile ? 'hidden' : '';
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('da:menu-state', { detail: mobile }));
  }, [mobile]);

  const enter = (l) => { clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = setTimeout(() => setOpen(l), open ? 0 : 90); };
  const leave = () => { clearTimeout(timer.current); timer.current = setTimeout(() => setOpen(null), 200); };
  const Menu = NAV.find((n) => n.label === open)?.menu;
  const solid = scrolled || open || mobile;
  const light = overLight || open || mobile;

  return (
    <header className={cx('noprint fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 transition-transform duration-300', light && 'tone-l', tucked && !mobile && 'max-md:-translate-y-full')} onMouseLeave={leave}>
      <a href="#main" className="sr-only-focusable absolute left-4 top-3 z-50 rounded-full bg-white px-4 py-2 text-[#081c39]">Skip to content</a>
      <div aria-hidden="true" className={cx('hdr-bg absolute inset-0 -z-10 border-b', solid ? 'solid border-line bg-[#04122a]/80 backdrop-blur-xl' : 'border-transparent bg-transparent')} />
      <UtilityBar away={scrolled || !!open} />
      <div className="wrap flex h-[72px] items-center gap-6">
        <Link to="/" aria-label="Deep Algorithms home" className="shrink-0"><Logo dual /></Link>
        <nav aria-label="Primary" className="hidden flex-1 lg:block">
          <ul className="flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 xl:gap-1.5">
            {NAV.map((n) => (
              <li key={n.label}>
                {n.menu ? (
                  <button type="button" aria-expanded={open === n.label} aria-controls="mega" onMouseEnter={() => enter(n.label)} onClick={() => setOpen(open === n.label ? null : n.label)}
                    className={cx('inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-full px-3.5 text-[15px] font-medium transition-colors', open === n.label ? 'bg-fg/[.07] text-ink' : 'text-ink-2 hover:text-ink')}>
                    {n.label}
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <Link to={n.to} onMouseEnter={() => { clearTimeout(timer.current); setOpen(null); }} aria-current={pathname === n.to ? 'page' : undefined}
                    className={cx('inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-full px-3.5 text-[15px] font-medium transition-colors hover:text-ink', pathname === n.to ? 'text-ink' : 'text-ink-2')}>{n.label}</Link>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </nav>
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 lg:ml-0">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('da:command', { detail: 'search' }))} aria-label="Search the site" title="Search (Ctrl K or ⌘ K)"
            className={cx('inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-2 text-ink-2 transition-colors hover:border-fg/30 hover:text-ink max-md:hidden', !scrolled && 'lg:hidden')}>
            <Icon name="MagnifyingGlass" size={17} />
          </button>
          <Button to="/request-demo" size="sm" className="max-md:hidden">Book a demo</Button>
          <button type="button" className="inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-ink max-md:hidden lg:hidden" aria-label={mobile ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'} aria-expanded={mobile} aria-controls="mobile-menu" onClick={() => setMobile(!mobile)}>
            <Icon name={mobile ? 'X' : 'List'} size={26} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {Menu && (
        <>
          <div aria-hidden="true" className="mega-scrim fixed inset-0 -z-20 hidden bg-[#04122a]/30 lg:block" onMouseEnter={leave} onClick={() => setOpen(null)} />
          <div id="mega" onMouseEnter={() => clearTimeout(timer.current)} className="mega absolute inset-x-0 top-full hidden lg:block">
            <div className="wrap pt-2">
              <div key={open} className="fadein overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] border border-line bg-bg-1 shadow-[0_32px_80px_-28px_rgba(6,25,55,.45)]"><Menu /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {mobile && (
        <div className="lg:hidden">
          <button type="button" aria-label="Close menu" className="sheet-scrim fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/55 backdrop-blur-[2px]" onClick={() => setMobile(false)} />
          <div id="mobile-menu" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Menu" className="sheet fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-[61] max-h-[88svh] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-[26px] border-t border-line-2 bg-bg shadow-[0_-30px_80px_-20px_rgba(0,0,0,.7)]">
            <div className="sticky top-0 z-[1] flex items-center justify-between bg-bg px-5 pb-2 pt-3">
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute left-1/2 top-2 h-1 w-10 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-fg/20" />
              <span className="pt-3 text-[15px] font-semibold">Menu</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setMobile(false)} aria-label="Close menu" className="mt-2 inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-2"><Icon name="X" size={18} /></button>
            </div>
            <MobileMenu onNav={() => setMobile(false)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

FILE: website/src/components/JumpBar.jsx
====================================================================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router';
import { cx } from './ui.jsx';

/* Long pages get a bar of their sections once the reader is past the hero,
   the way enterprise product pages carry one: what is on the page, where you
   are, one click to any part.
   Desktop: under the header, with the page's name.
   Phones: at the top, as swipeable chips (the header tucks away on scroll).
   Sections are read from the page itself (each h2 with an id), named by their
   eyebrow. */
const LONG = /^\/(adapid-ai|agentic-ai|botshield-ai|dpdpa-compliance|ad-security|solutions|platform|about-us|trust)/;

export default function JumpBar() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [active, setActive] = useState(-1);
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  const bar = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setItems([]); setActive(-1); setOn(false);
    if (!LONG.test(pathname)) return undefined;
    let io, onScroll;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      const hs = [...document.querySelectorAll('main h2[id]')].filter((h) => !h.closest('[role=dialog], [data-cta]'));
      const list = hs.map((h) => {
        const eb = h.previousElementSibling?.classList.contains('eyebrow') ? h.previousElementSibling.textContent.trim() : '';
        const label = (eb || h.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 3).join(' ')).replace(/[.,:]$/, '');
        return { id: h.id, label: label.length > 34 ? `${label.slice(0, 32)}…` : label, el: h };
      });
      if (list.length < 4) return;
      setName(document.querySelector('[data-page-name]')?.dataset.pageName || document.title.split(/[:|·]/)[0].trim());
      setItems(list.map(({ id, label }) => ({ id, label })));
      io = new IntersectionObserver((es) => {
        for (const e of es) if (e.isIntersecting) setActive(list.findIndex((x) => x.el === e.target));
      }, { rootMargin: '-30% 0px -60% 0px' });
      list.forEach((x) => io.observe(x.el));
      const first = list[0].el;
      onScroll = () => {
        setOn(first.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight * 0.6);
      };
      onScroll();
      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    }, 450);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t); io?.disconnect(); if (onScroll) window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll); };
  }, [pathname]);

  // keep the current item in view
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = bar.current?.querySelector(`[data-i="${active}"]`);
    if (!el) return;
    // scroll the strip only when the item is out of view, measured against the strip itself
    const box = el.parentElement, r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), b = box.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.left < b.left || r.right > b.right) box.scrollTo({ left: box.scrollLeft + r.left - b.left - 20, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [active]);

  if (!items.length) return null;
  const go = (id) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    const off = window.innerWidth >= 768 ? 140 : 70;
    window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - off, behavior: window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
  };
  return (
    <nav ref={bar} aria-label="On this page" className={cx('jumpbar tone-l noprint', on && 'on')}>
      <div className="jb-inner border-b border-line bg-[color-mix(in_oklab,var(--color-bg-1)_92%,transparent)] backdrop-blur-xl">
        <div className="wrap flex items-center max-md:px-0 md:gap-8">
          <span className="hidden shrink-0 text-[15px] font-semibold md:block">{name}</span>
          <div className="no-scrollbar flex flex-1 gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto px-4 py-2.5 md:gap-1 md:px-0 md:py-0">
            {items.map((x, i) => (
              <button key={x.id} type="button" data-i={i} onClick={() => go(x.id)} aria-current={i === active ? 'true' : undefined}
                className={cx('jb-item shrink-0 text-[13.5px] font-medium transition-colors', i === active ? 'is-on' : 'text-ink-2 hover:text-ink')}>
                {x.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

FILE: website/src/components/MobileBar.jsx
====================================================================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router';
import { SITE } from '../data/site.js';
import { Icon, cx } from './ui.jsx';

/* Phones get their controls where the thumb is: menu, search and the one
   "Book a demo" of the page, in a bar at the bottom. The demo button steps
   aside while the page's own closing invitation (or the demo page itself) is
   on screen, so it is never offered twice at once. */
export default function MobileBar() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [quiet, setQuiet] = useState(false);
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);

  // the menu sheet carries its own controls; the bar steps down while it is open
  useEffect(() => {
    const on = (e) => setMenu(!!e.detail);
    window.addEventListener('da:menu-state', on);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('da:menu-state', on);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setQuiet(false);
    const seen = new Set();
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((es) => {
      for (const e of es) (e.isIntersecting ? seen.add(e.target) : seen.delete(e.target));
      setQuiet(seen.size > 0);
    }, { threshold: 0.15 });
    // the page renders after navigation; look for the closing band once it has
    const t = setTimeout(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-cta], footer').forEach((el) => io.observe(el)), 300);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t); io.disconnect(); };
  }, [pathname]);

  const onDemo = pathname === '/request-demo';
  const btn = 'flex h-12 flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 rounded-[14px] text-[11.5px] font-medium text-ink-2 active:bg-fg/[.06]';
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Quick actions" aria-hidden={menu || undefined} className={cx('mbar noprint md:hidden', menu && 'is-down')}>
      <button type="button" className={btn} onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('da:menu'))}><Icon name="List" size={21} />Menu</button>
      <button type="button" className={btn} onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('da:command', { detail: 'search' }))}><Icon name="MagnifyingGlass" size={21} />Search</button>
      <a href={SITE.phoneHref} className={btn}><Icon name="Phone" size={21} />Call</a>
      <Link to="/request-demo" aria-hidden={quiet || onDemo} tabIndex={quiet || onDemo ? -1 : undefined}
        className={cx('mbar-cta inline-flex h-12 items-center justify-center rounded-[14px] bg-[#0a6dbb] px-5 text-[15px] font-semibold text-white transition-all duration-300', (quiet || onDemo) && 'is-away')}>
        Book a demo
      </Link>
    </nav>
  );
}

import { useId, useState } from 'react';
