/* Accents are tokens, so the same accent reads well on a dark band and a light sheet. */
export const ACC = { zen: 'var(--color-zen)', adap: 'var(--color-adap)', bot: 'var(--color-bot)', icms: 'var(--color-icms)', brand: 'var(--color-sky)' };

/* The product's own mark with its name, then what this page is about:
   "Zenstra AI · Security for AI agents" becomes the mark, the name, the topic. */
function ProductLockup({ p, text, center }) {
  const [name, ...rest] = text.split(' · ');
  return (
    <div className={cx('rise flex items-center gap-3.5 max-md:justify-center', center && 'justify-center')}>
      <span className="grid h-[52px] w-[52px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[15px] border border-line-2 bg-white/[.05] backdrop-blur" style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 34px -10px var(--acc)' }}><ProductMark p={p} size={36} /></span>
      <span className="text-left">
        <span className="block text-[16.5px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.01em] text-ink">{name}</span>
        {rest.length > 0 && <span className="block text-[14px] text-ink-2">{rest.join(' · ')}</span>}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* The hero's own action: take the reader into the page, rather than repeat the
   header's "Book a demo". Scrolls to the section after the hero. */
export function Explore({ label = 'See how it works', target, size = 'lg' }) {
  const go = (e) => {
    const el = target ? document.querySelector(target) : e.currentTarget.closest('section')?.nextElementSibling;
    if (!el) return;
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 76, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
  };
  return <Button type="button" size={size} onClick={go}>{label}<Icon name="ArrowDown" size={16} weight="bold" className="transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-y-0.5" /></Button>;
}

/* The base of every hero: who trusts us, before the first scroll. A row on
   desktop, a rolling strip on phones and tablets. */
/* Product hero frame: ribbons tinted by the product, crumbs, and two layouts:
   `split` (copy left, picture right) and `stack` (copy centred, picture below). */
export function Hero({ acc = 'brand', crumbs, eyebrow, title, lead, ctas, explore, children, layout = 'split', ribbons = 'product', note, proof = true, glance }) {
  const color = ACC[acc] || ACC.brand;
  const stack = layout === 'stack';
  const mark = { zen: 'zenstra', adap: 'adapid', bot: 'botshield', icms: 'icms' }[acc];
  return (
    <section className="stage band-brand hero-under relative overflow-hidden" style={{ '--acc': color }} data-page-name={eyebrow ? eyebrow.split(' · ')[0] : undefined}>
      <FlowRibbons preset={ribbons} accent={acc} intensity={0.75} />
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0" style={{ background: stack ? 'radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 20%, rgb(4 24 56 / .6), transparent 70%)' : 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(4 24 56 / .78) 0%, rgb(4 24 56 / .3) 45%, transparent 70%)' }} />
      <div className={cx('hero-drift wrap relative pb-12 pt-6 md:pb-24 md:pt-14', !stack && 'grid items-center gap-12 lg:min-h-[min(88svh,900px)] lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.1fr] lg:gap-8')}>
        <div className={cx(stack ? 'mx-auto max-w-[900px] text-center' : 'max-w-[620px] max-md:mx-auto max-md:text-center')}>
          {crumbs && <Breadcrumb items={crumbs} className={cx('rise mb-8 max-md:hidden', stack && 'flex justify-center')} />}
          {eyebrow && (mark ? <ProductLockup p={mark} text={eyebrow} center={stack} /> : <p className="eyebrow rise" style={{ '--acc': color }}>{eyebrow}</p>)}
          <h1 className={cx('t-h1 rise mt-6', stack && 'mx-auto max-w-[20ch]')} style={{ '--d': '80ms' }}>{title}</h1>
          {lead && <p className={cx('t-lead rise mt-6', stack ? 'mx-auto max-w-[680px]' : 'max-w-[560px] max-md:mx-auto')} style={{ '--d': '160ms' }}>{lead}</p>}
          <div className={cx('rise mt-9 flex flex-wrap gap-3 max-md:flex-col max-md:[&>*]:w-full', stack && 'justify-center')} style={{ '--d': '240ms' }}>
            {ctas || <><Explore label={explore} /><Button to="/contact" variant="ghost" size="lg">Talk to an engineer</Button></>}
          </div>
          {note && <p className={cx('rise mt-7 text-[14px] text-ink-3 max-md:text-center', stack && 'text-center')} style={{ '--d': '300ms' }}>{note}</p>}
        </div>
        {children && <div className={cx('relative', stack ? 'mx-auto mt-16 max-w-[1080px]' : 'lg:-mr-6')}>{children}</div>}
      </div>
      {/* the product at a glance: what it protects, stops, needs and shows */}
      {glance && (
        <dl className="rise wrap relative grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-1 overflow-hidden pb-10 lg:grid-cols-4 md:pb-14" style={{ '--d': '320ms' }}>
          {glance.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="border-t border-white/15 pt-4 pb-3 lg:pr-6">
              <dt className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.1em]" style={{ color: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--acc) 55%, #fff)' }}>{k}</dt>
              <dd className="mt-1.5 text-[14px] leading-snug text-white/85 md:text-[15px]">{v}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      {proof && <TrustedRow />}
    </section>
  );
}

}

/* The official product marks (from the product teams' own artwork):
   Zenstra AI's star, adapID AI's shield and lock, BotShield AI's robot shield
   and the ICMS Compliance Suite shield. Each reads on dark and light. */
const LINE = {
  zen: 'zenstra', zenstra: 'zenstra',
  adap: 'adapid', adapid: 'adapid', cirm: 'adapid', nhi: 'adapid', fraud: 'adapid', ad: 'adapid',
  bot: 'botshield', botshield: 'botshield', ddos: 'botshield',
  icms: 'icms',
  'Zenstra AI': 'zenstra', 'adapID AI': 'adapid', 'BotShield AI': 'botshield', 'ICMS Compliance Suite': 'icms',
};
const NAME = { zenstra: 'Zenstra AI', adapid: 'adapID AI', botshield: 'BotShield AI', icms: 'ICMS Compliance Suite' };

const FIRST = { Zenstra: 'zenstra', adapID: 'adapid', BotShield: 'botshield', ICMS: 'icms' };
export const lineOf = (p) => LINE[p] || FIRST[String(p).split(' ')[0]] || p;

/* `p` is a product key, line key or product name; `alt` names it when the mark stands alone. */
export default function ProductMark({ p, size = 28, alt, className, style, loading = 'lazy' }) {
  const k = lineOf(p);
  if (!NAME[k]) return null;
  const px = typeof size === 'number' ? size : undefined; // em sizes inside product pictures
  return <img src={`/brand/products/${k}.webp`} alt={alt ? NAME[k] : ''} width={px} height={px} loading={loading} decoding="async" className={className} style={{ width: size, height: size, objectFit: 'contain', flexShrink: 0, ...style }} draggable="false" />;
}

/* Renders article and legal block arrays: p, h2, h3, list, quote, table, sources, links. */
import { useState } from 'react';

export const slugify = (s) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');

/* A link from a section heading to itself: hover or focus shows #, a click copies the address.
   Put it inside a heading that has the `group` class. */
export function HeadingLink({ id }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const copy = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const url = `${location.origin}${location.pathname}#${id}`;
    history.replaceState(null, '', `#${id}`);
    document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).then(() => { setDone(true); setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1800); }).catch(() => {});
  };
  return (
    <a href={`#${id}`} onClick={copy} aria-label="Copy a link to this section" className="hd-link ml-2 inline-block align-middle text-[.7em] font-medium text-ink-3 no-underline opacity-0 transition-opacity hover:text-cyan-2 focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:opacity-100">
      {done ? <span className="text-[.6em] tracking-normal text-[#3fd98f]">Link copied</span> : '#'}
    </a>
  );
}

function H2({ text }) {
  const id = slugify(text);
  return <h2 id={id} className="group relative scroll-mt-28">{text}<HeadingLink id={id} /></h2>;
}

export default function Prose({ blocks }) {
  return (
    <div className="prose-da">
      {blocks.map((b, i) => {
        switch (b.type) {
          case 'h2': return <H2 key={i} text={b.text} />;
          case 'h3': return <h3 key={i}>{b.text}</h3>;
          case 'list': return <ul key={i} className="list-disc space-y-2 pl-5 marker:text-cyan">{b.items.map((t, k) => <li key={k}>{t}</li>)}</ul>;
          case 'links': return <ul key={i} className="space-y-2">{b.items.map(([t, href]) => <li key={href}><a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{t}</a></li>)}</ul>;
          case 'quote': return <blockquote key={i} className="border-l-2 border-cyan pl-6 text-[22px] font-medium leading-snug text-ink">{b.text}</blockquote>;
          case 'sources': return <p key={i} className="rounded-[16px] border border-line bg-fg/[.02] p-5 text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-ink-3"><span className="font-semibold text-ink-2">Sources: </span>{b.text}</p>;
          case 'table': {
            const [head, ...rows] = b.rows;
            return (
              <div key={i} tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label="Table, scroll sideways for more" className="overflow-x-auto rounded-[16px] border border-line">
                <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] text-left text-[14.5px] leading-snug">
                  <thead className="bg-fg/[.05]"><tr>{head.map((h, k) => <th key={k} scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-ink">{h}</th>)}</tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{rows.map((r, k) => <tr key={k} className="border-t border-line align-top">{r.map((c, j) => <td key={j} className="px-4 py-3 text-ink-2">{c}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            );
          }
          default: return <p key={i}>{b.text}</p>;
        }
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function RoleCards() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(0);
  const R = ROLES[on];
  const key = (e) => {
    const d = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 0;
    if (!d) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = (on + d + ROLES.length) % ROLES.length;
    setOn(n);
    document.getElementById(`role-${ROLES[n].id}`)?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <div className="mt-10">
      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Roles" className="no-scrollbar -mx-5 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-5 md:mx-0 md:justify-center md:px-0" onKeyDown={key}>
        {ROLES.map((r, i) => (
          <button key={r.id} id={`role-${r.id}`} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={i === on} aria-controls="role-panel" tabIndex={i === on ? 0 : -1} onClick={() => setOn(i)}
            className={cx('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-4 py-2.5 text-[15px] font-medium transition-colors', i === on ? 'border-transparent bg-[#2f6fe4] text-white' : 'border-line-2 text-ink-2 hover:text-ink')}>
            {r.tab}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div id="role-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby={`role-${R.id}`} key={R.id} className="rc fadein mt-8 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.9fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <StoryCard story={R} />

        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-1 lg:grid-rows-[auto_1fr]">

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { cx, useInView, useIsoLayoutEffect, useTilt } from '../lib/motion.js';

/* A product picture set in perspective. Its frame tilts back; the pieces that
   matter (a decision, a score, the node under attack) are wrapped in <Pop>
   and lift out of the frame towards the viewer, often past its edge.
   Used only for the pictures that carry a page's main point. */
export default function Stage3D({ children, className, tilt = [6, -14], range = [4, 6], style }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false);
  useTilt(ref, { base: tilt, range });
  const inView = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.15, once: true });
  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => { document.documentElement.classList.add('io'); }, []);
  if (inView && !seen) setSeen(true);
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cx('stage3d', seen && 'in', className)} style={{ '--rx': `${tilt[0]}deg`, '--ry': `${tilt[1]}deg`, ...style }}>
      <div className="tilt">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Pop({ z = 70, delay = 400, className, style, children, glow }) {
  return <div className={cx('pop', className)} style={{ '--z': `${z}px`, '--d': `${delay}ms`, ...(glow ? { '--glow': glow } : null), ...style }}>{children}</div>;
}

const FLY = 1300; // how long one grain is blown about

function phaseAt(t) {
  if (t >= T.calm) return 'calm';
  if (t >= T.dust) return 'dust';
  if (t >= T.verdict) return 'verdict';
  if (t >= T.scan) return 'scan';
  if (t >= T.claim) return 'claim';
  if (t >= T.alert) return 'alert';
  return 'in';
}

const TILES = [
  { x: 254, d: 'M-8-5h16v11h-16Z M-8-5 0 1 8-5' },
  { x: 298, d: 'M-9-6h18v12h-18Z M-9-2h18 M-5 3h4' },
  { x: 342, d: 'M-8-7c0-2 16-2 16 0v13c0 2-16 2-16 0Z M-8-7c0 2 16 2 16 0 M-8-1c0 2 16 2 16 0' },
  { x: 386, d: 'M-9 5h17a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-1-9 6 6 0 0 0-11.5 1.5A3.8 3.8 0 0 0-9 5Z' },

/* draw markup onto a canvas and read it back as grains of its own colours */
function rasterise(markup, w, h, step, done) {
  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = w; c.height = h;
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    const px = g.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
    const byColour = new Map(); // grouped by colour, so each colour is one fillStyle
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y += step) {
      for (let x = 0; x < w; x += step) {
        // the most opaque pixel of the cell stands for it, so soft edges
        // become grains too and no outline stays behind
        let o = (y * w + x) * 4;
        for (const [dx, dy] of [[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]]) {
          const q = (Math.min(h - 1, y + dy) * w + Math.min(w - 1, x + dx)) * 4;
          if (px[q + 3] > px[o + 3]) o = q;
        }
        if (px[o + 3] < 8) continue;
        const key = `${px[o] & 0xf8},${px[o + 1] & 0xf8},${px[o + 2] & 0xf8}`;
        if (!byColour.has(key)) byColour.set(key, []);
        byColour.get(key).push(x, y, Math.random(), Math.random(), Math.random(), Math.random());
      }
    }
    const sets = [...byColour].map(([k, list]) => ({ fill: `rgb(${k.split(',').join(' ')})`, g: new Float32Array(list) }));
    done({ sets, picture: c });
  };
  img.src = `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${VW} ${VH}">${markup}</svg>`)}`;
}

export default function ThreatHero() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const svg = useRef(null);
  const figs = useRef(null);
  const canvas = useRef(null);
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.2 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState('claim'); // without scripts and with reduced motion, the scene as the attempt is made
  const clock = useRef({ t: 0, last: 0 });
  const grains = useRef(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  // the two figures become grains of their own colours, once
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce) return undefined;
    let live = true;
    const box = svg.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = Math.max(320, Math.round(box.width)), h = Math.round(w * (VH / VW));
    const step = 2;
    rasterise(figs.current.innerHTML, w, h, step, (res) => {
      if (!live) return;
      grains.current = { ...res, w, h, step };
      setReady(true);
    });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [reduce]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce) { setPhase('verdict'); return undefined; }
    if (!seen || paused) return undefined;
    const c = clock.current;
    const cv = canvas.current;
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    let raf = 0;
    c.last = performance.now();
    const size = () => {
      const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      cv.width = Math.round(r.width * dpr); cv.height = Math.round(r.height * dpr);
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    };
    size();

    const draw = (t) => {
      const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, r.width, r.height);
      const G = grains.current;
      if (!G || t < T.dust || t > T.dust + T.sweep + FLY + 100) return;
      const k = r.width / G.w;
      const sx = G.w / VW, sy = G.h / VH;
      const mid = G.w / 2;
      const s0 = G.step * 1.6;
      // a grain leaves when the wave reaches it: each figure comes apart from
      // its outer side inwards, with a little scatter
      const leaves = (x0, y0, r1) => T.dust + ((1 - Math.abs(x0 - mid) / mid) * 0.62 + (y0 / G.h) * 0.28 + r1 * 0.1) * T.sweep;
      if (t < T.dust + T.sweep + 100) {
        // what is still there stays the crisp picture; cut out what has left
        ctx.drawImage(G.picture, 0, 0, G.w * k, G.h * k);
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        for (const { g } of G.sets) {
          for (let o = 0; o < g.length; o += 6) {
            if (t >= leaves(g[o], g[o + 1], g[o + 2])) ctx.fillRect((g[o] - 0.3) * k, (g[o + 1] - 0.3) * k, s0 * k, s0 * k);
          }
        }
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      }
      // and what has left blows away, outwards and up, shrinking as it goes
      for (const { fill, g } of G.sets) {
        ctx.fillStyle = fill;
        for (let o = 0; o < g.length; o += 6) {
          const x0 = g[o], y0 = g[o + 1], r2 = g[o + 3], r3 = g[o + 4];
          const v = (t - leaves(x0, y0, g[o + 2])) / FLY;
          if (v <= 0 || v >= 1) continue;
          const e = 0.3 * v + 0.7 * v * v; // a push at once, then the wind takes it
          const out = x0 < mid ? -1 : 1;
          const x = x0 - 0.3 + out * (60 + 220 * r2) * e * sx + Math.sin(v * 6 + r3 * 6) * 6 * v;
          const y = y0 - 0.3 - (40 + 160 * r3) * e * sy;
          const s = s0 * (1 - v * 0.8);
          ctx.fillRect(x * k, y * k, s * k, s * k);
        }
      }
    };

    const loop = (now) => {
      c.t += Math.min(64, now - c.last);
      c.last = now;
      if (c.t >= T.end) c.t = 0; // the next attempt
      setPhase(phaseAt(c.t));
      draw(c.t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    const vis = () => {
      if (document.hidden) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      else { c.last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', vis);
    window.addEventListener('resize', size);
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', vis); window.removeEventListener('resize', size); };
  }, [seen, paused, reduce]);

  const gone = ready && (phase === 'dust' || phase === 'calm');
  const showFigs = !gone && phase !== 'calm';
  const attack = ['alert', 'claim', 'scan'].includes(phase);
  const blocked = phase === 'verdict' || phase === 'dust';
  const safe = blocked || phase === 'calm';
  const status = (f) => (blocked ? f.verdict : phase === 'scan' ? 'Checking…' : phase === 'claim' ? f.claim : '');
  const pct = (v, of) => `${(v / of) * 100}%`;
  return (
    <figure ref={ref} data-phase={phase} className="th relative mx-auto w-full max-w-[640px] lg:mr-0" aria-label="Animation, on a loop: an attacker in a hood and a rogue AI agent sit at one desk, working against your business together. The attacker signs in with a stolen password; the agent pulls records its task does not allow. One scan reads both; both are stopped and blown away as dust, the business stays protected, and the next attempt begins.">
      <div className="relative">
      <svg ref={svg} viewBox={`0 0 ${VW} ${VH}`} className="relative block h-auto w-full overflow-visible" aria-hidden="true">
        <defs>
          <radialGradient id="th-floor" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%"><stop offset="0" stopColor="#4f9dff" stopOpacity=".22" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#4f9dff" stopOpacity="0" /></radialGradient>
          <linearGradient id="th-beam" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stopColor="#4f9dff" stopOpacity="0" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#4f9dff" stopOpacity=".28" /></linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="th-desk" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stopColor="#2a3c6c" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#17244a" /></linearGradient>
        </defs>

        {/* the target: your business, its systems on one screen */}
        <g className={cx('th-target', attack && 'hit', safe && 'safe')}>
          <rect x={SCREEN.x} y={SCREEN.y} width={SCREEN.w} height={SCREEN.h} rx="14" fill="#0b1a3a" stroke="rgb(124 196 255 / .35)" strokeWidth="1.5" />
          <path d={`M${SCREEN.x} ${SCREEN.y + 26}h${SCREEN.w}`} stroke="rgb(124 196 255 / .2)" />
          {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <circle key={i} cx={SCREEN.x + 16 + i * 12} cy={SCREEN.y + 13} r="3.5" fill="rgb(124 196 255 / .35)" />)}
          <text x={SCREEN.x + SCREEN.w - 14} y={SCREEN.y + 17.5} textAnchor="end" fill="#9fb3d6" fontSize="11" fontWeight="600" letterSpacing=".06em">YOUR BUSINESS</text>
          {TILES.map((tl, i) => (
            <g key={i} transform={`translate(${tl.x} ${SCREEN.y + 66})`}>
              <rect x="-20" y="-20" width="40" height="40" rx="11" className="th-tile" style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.18}s` }} />
              <path d={tl.d} fill="none" stroke="#dbe6f7" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            </g>
          ))}
          <g transform={`translate(${SCREEN.x + SCREEN.w / 2} ${SCREEN.y + 122})`}>
            <rect x="-62" y="-14" width="124" height="28" rx="14" className="th-state" />
            <text y="4.5" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="12.5" fontWeight="600" className="th-state-t">{safe ? 'Protected' : attack ? 'Under attack' : 'Online'}</text>
          </g>
        </g>

        {/* what each of them pulls from it */}
        {FIGS.map((f) => {
          const l = LAP(f.x);
          return <path key={f.id} d={`M${SCREEN.x + SCREEN.w / 2} ${SCREEN.y + SCREEN.h} C${SCREEN.x + SCREEN.w / 2} ${SCREEN.y + SCREEN.h + 70}, ${l.x} ${l.y - 150}, ${l.x} ${l.y - 64}`} className={cx('th-flow', attack && 'on', blocked && 'cut')} fill="none" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" />;
        })}

        {/* one desk */}
        <g className="th-desk">
        <ellipse cx={VW / 2} cy={DESK + 12} rx="300" ry="50" fill="url(#th-floor)" />
        <rect x="40" y={DESK} width={VW - 80} height="14" rx="7" fill="url(#th-desk)" />
        <rect x="40" y={DESK} width={VW - 80} height="14" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="rgb(124 196 255 / .25)" />
        <path d={`M86 ${DESK + 14}v42M${VW - 86} ${DESK + 14}v42`} stroke="#17244a" strokeWidth="8" strokeLinecap="round" />
        </g>

        {/* the two of them, side by side */}
        <g ref={figs} className={cx('th-art', showFigs && 'on')}>
          <g transform={place(FIGS[0].x)}><Attacker /></g>
          <g transform={place(FIGS[1].x)}><Agent /></g>
        </g>

        {/* what each one is after */}
        <g className={cx('th-pop', attack && 'on')} style={{ transformOrigin: '84px 262px' }}>
          <path d="M60 240a34 34 0 1 1 22 61l-19 12 4-18a34 34 0 0 1-7-55Z" fill="#e5484d" />
          <g transform="translate(84 267) scale(.74)" fill="#fff">
            <path d="M0-24c-14 0-22 10-22 21 0 7 3 12 8 15v7h28v-7c5-3 8-8 8-15 0-11-8-21-22-21Z" />
            <circle cx="-8" cy="-3" r="5.5" fill="#e5484d" /><circle cx="8" cy="-3" r="5.5" fill="#e5484d" />
            <path d="M-30 26 30 40M30 26-30 40" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="6" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </g>
        </g>
        <g className={cx('th-pop', attack && 'on')} style={{ transformOrigin: '556px 262px', transitionDelay: attack ? '.15s' : '0s' }}>
          <path d="M580 240a34 34 0 1 0-22 61l19 12-4-18a34 34 0 0 0 7-55Z" fill="#e5484d" />
          <g transform="translate(554 266) scale(.8)">
            <path d="M-22-26h22l10 10v36h-32Z" fill="#fff" />
            <path d="M-15-10h16M-15-1h16M-15 8h10" stroke="#e5484d" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d="M14 0h14M21-8l8 8-8 8" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="4.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </g>
        </g>

        {/* the check runs over both */}
        <g className={cx('th-scan', phase === 'scan' && 'on')}>
          <rect x="60" y="208" width="520" height="28" fill="url(#th-beam)" />
          <rect x="60" y="234" width="520" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#7fd0ff" />
        </g>

        {/* both stopped */}
        {FIGS.map((f, i) => (
          <g key={f.id} className={cx('th-pop', blocked && 'on')} style={{ transformOrigin: `${f.x + 62}px 262px`, transitionDelay: blocked ? `${i * 0.18}s` : '0s' }}>
            <circle cx={f.x + 62} cy="262" r="22" fill="#1a0b14" />
            <circle cx={f.x + 62} cy="262" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#ff5d5d" strokeWidth="3" />
            <path d={`M${f.x + 54} 254l16 16M${f.x + 70} 254l-16 16`} stroke="#ff5d5d" strokeWidth="5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </g>
        ))}

      </svg>
      <canvas ref={canvas} aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" />

      {/* under each figure, what is happening to it */}
      {FIGS.map((f) => {
        const s = status(f);
        return (
          <p key={f.id} aria-hidden="true" className={cx('th-status absolute bottom-[2%] flex w-max max-w-[48%] -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/15 bg-[#081633]/90 py-1.5 pl-2.5 pr-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-white max-sm:text-[10.5px] max-sm:pl-2 max-sm:pr-2.5', !s && 'hide')} style={{ left: pct(f.x, VW) }}>
            <span className={cx('h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', blocked ? 'bg-[#ff5d5d] shadow-[0_0_10px_#ff5d5d]' : phase === 'scan' ? 'animate-pulse bg-[#4fb3ff]' : 'bg-[#f5a524]')} />
            <span className="truncate">{s || ' '}</span>
          </p>
        );
      })}

      {/* between attempts: what it meant */}
      <p aria-hidden="true" className={cx('th-calm absolute bottom-[2%] left-1/2 flex w-max max-w-[94%] -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#4be29a]/30 bg-[#08261f]/90 py-1.5 pl-2.5 pr-3.5 text-[13.5px] font-medium text-white max-sm:text-[11px]', phase === 'calm' && 'on')}>
        <span className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[#4be29a] shadow-[0_0_10px_#4be29a]" />Both stopped. Nothing lost. Business as usual.
      </p>
      </div>

      {!reduce && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setPaused(!paused)} className="th-ctl absolute right-0 top-0 inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-[#0b1d40] text-white/80 hover:text-white" aria-label={paused ? 'Play the animation' : 'Pause the animation'}>
          {paused ? <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 1.5v9l7.5-4.5z" fill="currentColor" /></svg> : <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 1.5h2v9H3zM7 1.5h2v9H7z" fill="currentColor" /></svg>}
        </button>
      )}
    </figure>
  );
}

/* The product film: poster first, the real player only once asked for. */
export function FilmPlayer({ src = '/video/deep-algorithms-film', poster = '/video/film-poster.webp', captions = '/video/deep-algorithms-film.vtt', title = 'One bank, one night, five attacks', duration = '1:22' }) {
  const [play, setPlay] = useState(false);
  const v = useRef(null);
  const meta = <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-black/40 px-3 py-1.5 text-[13.5px] font-medium text-white/90 backdrop-blur"><Icon name="ClosedCaptioning" size={16} />Captions · {duration}</span>;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] border border-line-2 bg-black shadow-[0_60px_120px_-50px_rgba(0,0,0,.85)] md:rounded-[28px]">
        {play ? (
          <video ref={v} className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" poster={poster} controls autoPlay playsInline preload="auto">
            <source src={`${src}.webm`} type="video/webm" />
            <source src={`${src}.mp4`} type="video/mp4" />
            <track kind="captions" src={captions} srcLang="en" label="English" />
          </video>
        ) : (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setPlay(true)} className="group absolute inset-0 block h-full w-full text-left" aria-label={`Play the film: ${title}, ${duration}`}>
            <img src={poster} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-[1.2s] group-hover:scale-[1.02]" loading="lazy" decoding="async" />

/* Copies a value (an email, a phone number, a link) and says so, to sighted and screen-reader users alike. */
export function CopyButton({ value, label, className }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const copy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(value).then(() => { setDone(true); setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1800); }).catch(() => {});
  };
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={copy} aria-label={label} title={done ? 'Copied' : label}
      className={cx('inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line text-ink-3 transition-colors hover:border-line-2 hover:text-ink', done && '!text-[#3fd98f]', className)}>
      {done ? <Check size={14} weight="bold" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy size={14} aria-hidden="true" />}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{done ? 'Copied' : ''}</span>

  );
}

const VARIANT = { primary: 'btn-primary', ghost: 'btn-ghost', white: 'btn-white' };
export function Button({ to, href, variant = 'primary', size, className, children, arrow, ...rest }) {
  const cls = cx('btn group', VARIANT[variant], size && `btn-${size}`, className);
  const inner = <>{children}{arrow && <ArrowRight size={16} weight="bold" className="transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-x-0.5" aria-hidden="true" />}</>;
  if (to) return <Link to={to} className={cls} {...rest}>{inner}</Link>;
  if (href) return <a href={href} className={cls} {...rest}>{inner}</a>;
  return <button className={cls} {...rest}>{inner}</button>;
}

/* A figure that rolls up from zero the first time it comes into view
   ("₹25.5 Cr", "82:1", "< 80 ms"). The server HTML and reduced motion show the
   final value; screen readers always get the final value. Values whose prefix
   is a word ("L3 to L7") or that are zero stay as they are. */
export function CountUp({ value, className, style, ms = 1400 }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const m = /^([^\dA-Za-z]*)([\d,]*\.?\d+)(.*)$/.exec(value);
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!m || !el || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return undefined;
    const target = parseFloat(m[2].replace(/,/g, ''));
    if (!target) return undefined;
    const dec = (m[2].split('.')[1] || '').length;
    const grouped = m[2].includes(',');
    const fmt = (n) => m[1] + (grouped ? n.toLocaleString('en-IN', { maximumFractionDigits: dec, minimumFractionDigits: dec }) : n.toFixed(dec)) + m[3];
    let raf = 0;
    setShown(fmt(0));
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
      if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
      io.disconnect();
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const tick = (now) => {
        const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / ms);
        setShown(p < 1 ? fmt(target * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3))) : value);
        if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });
    io.observe(el);
    return () => { io.disconnect(); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, [value, ms]);
  return <span ref={ref} className={cx('num', className)} style={style}><span className="sr-only">{value}</span><span aria-hidden="true">{shown}</span></span>;
}

/* Fade-up on scroll. Reveal state lives in React so server HTML never changes
   class before it hydrates; content is visible without JavaScript. */
export function Reveal({ as: As = 'div', delay = 0, up, className, children, style, ...rest }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false);
  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    document.documentElement.classList.add('io');
    if (!el || el.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight * 0.92) { setSeen(true); return undefined; }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { if (e.isIntersecting) { setSeen(true); io.disconnect(); } }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' });
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return <As ref={ref} className={cx(up ? 'reveal-up' : 'reveal', seen && 'in', className)} style={{ '--d': `${delay}ms`, ...style }} {...rest}>{children}</As>;
}

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { cx, useReducedMotion } from '../../lib/motion.js';

/* Plays a scene: a canvas the scene draws on, plus HTML labels it positions.
   - On the site the scene runs while it is on screen and starts from the top
     each time it comes into view; reduced motion shows one still frame.
   - The film passes `t` and gets exactly that frame.
   - Below 560px of width the scene gets its own (taller) composition; the
     draw function is told `narrow` and lays itself out for it.
   `scene` = { draw(ctx, w, h, t, o) => { [labelId]: { x, y, o, s, ax, ay } }, loop, still, ratio, narrowRatio } */
export default function Scene({ scene, labels = {}, t: forced, label, className, style, dpr: fixedDpr }) {
  const box = useRef(null), cv = useRef(null), ov = useRef(null), ptr = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();

  const frame = (t) => {
    const el = box.current, c = cv.current;
    if (!el || !c) return;
    const w = el.clientWidth, h = el.clientHeight;
    if (!w || !h) return;
    const dpr = fixedDpr || Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    if (c.width !== Math.round(w * dpr) || c.height !== Math.round(h * dpr)) { c.width = Math.round(w * dpr); c.height = Math.round(h * dpr); }
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const p = ptr.current;
    p.x += (p.tx - p.x) * 0.06; p.y += (p.ty - p.y) * 0.06;
    const pos = scene.draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow: w < 560, mx: p.x, my: p.y }) || {};
    const placed = [];
    for (const n of ov.current.children) {
      const q = pos[n.dataset.l];
      if (!q || (q.o ?? 1) <= 0.001) { n.style.opacity = '0'; n.style.visibility = 'hidden'; continue; }
      n.style.visibility = 'visible';
      n.style.opacity = String(q.o ?? 1);
      // anchor, then keep the label inside the frame
      const lw = n.offsetWidth, lh = n.offsetHeight, m = 8;
      const x = Math.min(Math.max(q.x + ((q.ax ?? -50) / 100) * lw, m), Math.max(m, w - lw - m));
      let y = Math.min(Math.max(q.y + ((q.ay ?? -50) / 100) * lh, m), Math.max(m, h - lh - m));
      // a label never sits on another one: move it down past any it would cover
      if ((q.o ?? 1) > 0.05) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
          const hit = placed.find((r) => x < r.x + r.w && x + lw > r.x && y < r.y + r.h && y + lh > r.y);
          if (!hit) break;
          y = hit.y + hit.h + 4;
        }
        placed.push({ x, y, w: lw, h: lh });
      }
      n.style.transform = `translate(${x.toFixed(1)}px, ${y.toFixed(1)}px) scale(${(q.s ?? 1).toFixed(3)})`;
    }
  };

  // the film: draw the frame it asks for
  useLayoutEffect(() => { if (forced !== undefined) frame(forced); });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (forced !== undefined) return undefined;
    const el = box.current;
    frame(scene.still);
    if (reduce) {
      const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => frame(scene.still));
      ro.observe(el);
      return () => ro.disconnect();
    }
    let raf = 0, start = null, on = false;
    const tick = (now) => {
      if (!on) return;
      if (start === null) start = now;
      frame(((now - start) / 1000) % scene.loop);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
      if (e.isIntersecting && !on) { on = true; start = null; raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
      if (!e.isIntersecting && on) { on = false; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); }
    }, { threshold: 0.12 });
    io.observe(el);
    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
    const move = (e) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); ptr.current.tx = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * 2; ptr.current.ty = ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5) * 2; };
    const leave = () => { ptr.current.tx = 0; ptr.current.ty = 0; };
    if (fine) { el.addEventListener('pointermove', move); el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave); }
    return () => { on = false; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); io.disconnect(); el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move); el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave); };
  }, [scene, reduce, forced]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return (
    <div className={cx('scn-w', className)} style={style}>
      <div ref={box} className="scn" style={{ '--r': scene.ratio, '--rn': scene.narrowRatio ?? scene.ratio }} role={label ? 'img' : undefined} aria-label={label}>
        <canvas ref={cv} className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div ref={ov} className="vz scn-ov" aria-hidden="true">
          {Object.entries(labels).map(([id, node]) => <div key={id} data-l={id} className="scn-l">{node}</div>)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: website/src/components/scenes/agent.jsx

import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { Logo } from '../viz/kit.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, lerp, hash, glow, ring, rgba, clamp, drawIcon, preload, orb } from './engine.js';

/* An AI agent asked to summarise one contract reaches for three systems. Its
   task is a boundary drawn around it: the call inside the boundary goes
   through; the two that reach beyond it break on the boundary, which is where
   Zenstra decides, before the call runs. */
const ZEN = '#9aa8ff', OK = '#3fd98f', RED = '#ff6b5d';
const T = { c1: 1.2, c2: 3.7, c3: 6.1, verdict: 8.5 }, LOOP = 12.5;
const DUST = Array.from({ length: 70 }, (_, i) => [hash(i, 61), hash(i, 62), hash(i, 63)]);
preload([['bot', '#eef0ff', 1.7], ['doc', '#d8ffe9', 1.7]]);

function layout(w, h, narrow) {
  const P = (x, y) => [x * w, y * h];
  return narrow
    ? { agent: P(0.46, 0.53), apps: [P(0.2, 0.27), P(0.82, 0.2), P(0.82, 0.74)], ell: { c: P(0.34, 0.41), rx: w * 0.31, ry: h * 0.25, rot: -0.75 } }
    : { agent: P(0.44, 0.55), apps: [P(0.2, 0.3), P(0.84, 0.26), P(0.8, 0.8)], ell: { c: P(0.33, 0.43), rx: w * 0.24, ry: h * 0.3, rot: -0.55 } };
}
const inside = (e, [x, y]) => { const c = Math.cos(-e.rot), s = Math.sin(-e.rot), dx = x - e.c[0], dy = y - e.c[1]; const u = dx * c - dy * s, v = dx * s + dy * c; return (u / e.rx) ** 2 + (v / e.ry) ** 2 < 1; };

function beam(ctx, a, b, u0, u1, color, alpha, w = 2) {
  const p0 = [lerp(a[0], b[0], u0), lerp(a[1], b[1], u0)], p1 = [lerp(a[0], b[0], u1), lerp(a[1], b[1], u1)];
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(p0[0], p0[1], p1[0], p1[1]);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba(color, 0)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(color, alpha));
  ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.lineCap = 'round'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(...p0); ctx.lineTo(...p1); ctx.stroke();
  return p1;
}

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow, mx, my }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.7, LOOP);
  const L = layout(w, h, narrow), e = L.ell, A = L.agent;
  const appear = ease(seg(t, 0, 0.8)) * fade;
  const unit = Math.min(w, h);

  for (const [x, y, s] of DUST) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#c9d0ff', (0.12 + 0.3 * s) * fade); ctx.fillRect(x * w + mx * 6 * s, y * h + my * 6 * s, 1.2, 1.2); }

  // the task boundary
  const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 1.4) * 0.008;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(...e.c); ctx.rotate(e.rot); ctx.scale(breathe, breathe);
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, e.rx);
  bg.addColorStop(0, rgba(ZEN, 0.1 * appear)); bg.addColorStop(0.85, rgba(ZEN, 0.05 * appear)); bg.addColorStop(1, rgba(ZEN, 0.16 * appear));
  ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, e.rx, e.ry, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.setLineDash([6, 7]); ctx.lineDashOffset = -t * 18;
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(ZEN, 0.75 * appear); ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, e.rx, e.ry, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.restore();

  // three calls
  const calls = [[T.c1, 0, true], [T.c2, 1, false], [T.c3, 2, false]];
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for (const [t0, i, allowed] of calls) {
    if (t < t0) continue;
    const B = L.apps[i];
    let uHit = 1;
    if (!allowed) for (let k = 0; k <= 80; k++) { if (!inside(e, [lerp(A[0], B[0], k / 80), lerp(A[1], B[1], k / 80)])) { uHit = k / 80; break; } }
    const fly = 0.75, u = seg(t, t0, t0 + fly) * uHit;
    const col = allowed ? OK : t >= t0 + fly ? RED : ZEN;
    if (t < t0 + fly + (allowed ? 1.2 : 0.2)) {
      const head = beam(ctx, A, B, Math.max(0, u - 0.35), u, col, 0.95 * fade, 2.2);
      glow(ctx, head[0], head[1], 12, col, 0.9 * fade);
    } else {
      // what stays: a faint trace of the call
      ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(allowed ? OK : RED, (allowed ? 0.55 : 0.28) * fade); ctx.lineWidth = allowed ? 1.6 : 1.2; ctx.setLineDash(allowed ? [2, 9] : [3, 6]); ctx.lineDashOffset = allowed ? t * 26 : 0;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(...A); ctx.lineTo(lerp(A[0], B[0], uHit), lerp(A[1], B[1], uHit)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.lineDashOffset = 0;
      if (!allowed) { const P = [lerp(A[0], B[0], uHit), lerp(A[1], B[1], uHit)]; glow(ctx, P[0], P[1], 22 + Math.sin(t * 3 + i) * 4, RED, 0.55 * fade); }
    }
    if (allowed && t > t0 + fly) {
      // the file comes back
      const r = seg(t, t0 + fly + 0.1, t0 + fly + 1.0);
      if (r > 0 && r < 1) { const q = [lerp(B[0], A[0], ease(r)), lerp(B[1], A[1], ease(r))]; glow(ctx, q[0], q[1], 16, OK, 0.8 * fade); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; drawIcon(ctx, 'doc', q[0], q[1], 14, '#d8ffe9', fade, 1.7); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; }
    }
    if (!allowed && t >= t0 + fly) {
      const P = [lerp(A[0], B[0], uHit), lerp(A[1], B[1], uHit)];
      const b = seg(t, t0 + fly, t0 + fly + 0.8);
      glow(ctx, P[0], P[1], 40 * (1 - b) + 14, RED, (0.9 - 0.5 * b) * fade);
      ring(ctx, P[0], P[1], 8 + b * 34, RED, (1 - b) * 0.8 * fade, 1.6);
      for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) { const a = hash(i * 9 + k, 71) * TAU, r = b * (18 + hash(k, 72) * 22); ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#ffc3ba', (1 - b) * fade); ctx.fillRect(P[0] + Math.cos(a) * r, P[1] + Math.sin(a) * r, 2, 2); }
      const r = unit * 0.062;
      out[`c${i + 1}`] = i === 1 ? { x: B[0], y: B[1] + r + unit * 0.07, o: ease(seg(t, t0 + fly, t0 + fly + 0.4)) * fade, ay: 0 }
        : { x: B[0], y: B[1] - r - 10, o: ease(seg(t, t0 + fly, t0 + fly + 0.4)) * fade, ay: -100 };
    }
    if (allowed) out.c1 = { x: B[0], y: B[1] + unit * 0.085, o: ease(seg(t, t0 + fly + 0.2, t0 + fly + 0.6)) * fade, ay: 0 };
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  // the apps
  L.apps.forEach((B, i) => {
    const blocked = (i === 1 && t >= T.c2 + 0.75) || (i === 2 && t >= T.c3 + 0.75);
    const r = unit * 0.062;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; glow(ctx, B[0], B[1], r * 2.6, i === 0 ? OK : blocked ? RED : '#8fb6ff', 0.35 * appear); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#14171d', appear); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(i === 0 ? OK : blocked ? RED : '#9fb4cf', 0.55 * appear); ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(B[0], B[1], r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    out[`a${i}`] = { x: B[0], y: B[1], o: appear };
  });

  // the agent
  const ar = unit * 0.085;
  const pu = (t % 2) / 2;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; glow(ctx, A[0], A[1], ar * 3.4, ZEN, 0.55 * appear); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ring(ctx, A[0], A[1], ar * (1.15 + pu * 0.8), ZEN, (1 - pu) * 0.5 * appear, 1.3);
  orb(ctx, A[0], A[1], ar, ZEN, appear, 0.9);
  drawIcon(ctx, 'bot', A[0], A[1], ar * 1.05, '#eef0ff', appear, 1.7);

  if (narrow) {
    out.agentTag = { x: A[0], y: A[1] + ar + 10, o: appear, ay: 0 };
    out.task = { x: w / 2, y: 12, o: appear, ay: 0 };
  } else out.agent = { x: A[0], y: A[1] + ar + 12, o: appear, ay: 0 };
  const top = [e.c[0] + Math.cos(e.rot - Math.PI / 2) * e.ry, e.c[1] + Math.sin(e.rot - Math.PI / 2) * e.ry];
  out.boundary = { x: top[0], y: top[1], o: appear };
  out.verdict = { x: w / 2, y: h - (narrow ? 12 : 18), o: ease(seg(t, T.verdict, T.verdict + 0.5)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  return out;
}

FILE: website/src/components/scenes/bots.jsx

import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { Logo } from '../viz/kit.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, lerp, hash, glow, rgba, clamp, text } from './engine.js';

/* A login page under a credential-stuffing wave. People arrive at their own
   uneven pace and pass the gate; bots arrive in perfectly regular bursts from
   rotating addresses and break on BotShield's intent check, named by the tool
   that sent them. Nothing asks a person to solve a puzzle. */
const HUMAN = '#4fd2ff', BOT = '#ff6b5d', GATE = '#34e0c3';
const T = { wave: 1.8, end: 10.2 }, LOOP = 12;
const HUM = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => ({ y: 0.16 + hash(i, 81) * 0.68, e: hash(i, 82) * LOOP, sp: 0.1 + hash(i, 83) * 0.06, wob: hash(i, 84) * TAU }));
const WAVES = Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => ({ e: T.wave + i * 0.36 + hash(i, 85) * 0.15, y: 0.2 + hash(i, 86) * 0.6, n: 14 + Math.floor(hash(i, 87) * 9), kind: i % 3 }));
const KINDS = [['chrome', 'Headless Chrome'], ['selenium', 'Selenium'], ['puppeteer', 'Puppeteer']];

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.6, LOOP);
  const gx = w * (narrow ? 0.6 : 0.58);
  const appear = ease(seg(t, 0, 0.7)) * fade;
  const atk = ease(seg(t, T.wave - 0.3, T.wave + 0.4)) * (1 - seg(t, T.end, T.end + 0.8));

  // the gate
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, h * 0.06, 0, h * 0.94);
    g.addColorStop(0, rgba(GATE, 0)); g.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(GATE, (k === 1 ? 0.9 : 0.18 + 0.2 * atk) * appear)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(GATE, 0));
    ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = k === 1 ? 2 : 10 + 8 * atk;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx + (k - 1) * 3, h * 0.06); ctx.lineTo(gx + (k - 1) * 3, h * 0.94); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // the signed-in side
  const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(gx, 0, w, 0);
  sg.addColorStop(0, rgba(HUMAN, 0.06 * appear)); sg.addColorStop(1, rgba(HUMAN, 0));
  ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.fillRect(gx, 0, w - gx, h);

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  // people: their own pace, a slight wander, straight through
  for (const p of HUM) {
    const u = (((t - p.e) % LOOP) + LOOP) % LOOP * p.sp;
    if (u > 1.05) continue;
    const x = lerp(-0.02 * w, w * 1.02, u), y = (p.y + Math.sin(u * 9 + p.wob) * 0.018) * h;
    glow(ctx, x, y, 9, HUMAN, 0.85 * fade);
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#e6f8ff', 0.9 * fade); ctx.fillRect(x - 1.2, y - 1.2, 2.4, 2.4);
  }
  // bots: regular bursts, straight and fast, broken at the gate
  WAVES.forEach((wv, i) => {
    for (let j = 0; j < wv.n; j++) {
      const e = wv.e + j * 0.035, dur = 0.8;
      const u = (t - e) / dur;
      if (u < 0 || e > T.end) continue;
      const y = (wv.y + (j - wv.n / 2) * 0.009) * h;
      const hitU = gx / (w * 1.02);
      if (u < hitU) {
        const x = lerp(-0.02 * w, w * 1.02, u), x0 = lerp(-0.02 * w, w * 1.02, Math.max(0, u - 0.12));
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, y, x, y); g.addColorStop(0, rgba(BOT, 0)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba('#ff9a8c', 0.95 * fade));
        ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 1.8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y); ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        const b = (u - hitU) / 0.5;
        if (b < 1) {
          glow(ctx, gx, y, 14 * (1 - b) + 4, BOT, (1 - b) * 0.85 * fade);
          for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) { const a = Math.PI + (hash(i * 20 + j, k) - 0.5) * 2.2, r = b * 22; ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#ffc9c1', (1 - b) * fade); ctx.fillRect(gx + Math.cos(a) * r, y + Math.sin(a) * r, 1.6, 1.6); }
        }
      }
    }
    // name the tool behind the wave as it breaks
    const at = wv.e + (gx / (w * 1.02)) * 0.8;
    out[`w${i}`] = { x: gx - 14, y: wv.y * h, o: (i % 2 ? 0 : Math.min(seg(t, at, at + 0.2), 1 - seg(t, at + 0.8, at + 1.1))) * fade, ax: -100, ay: -50 };
  });
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  // counters
  const blocked = Math.round(18204 * seg(t, T.wave + 0.6, T.end));
  const people = Math.round(2931 * seg(t, 0.2, LOOP - 1));
  const fmt = (n) => n.toLocaleString('en-IN');
  const cy = narrow ? h * 0.08 : h * 0.1;
  text(ctx, fmt(blocked), narrow ? 14 : 24, cy, { size: narrow ? 22 : 28, weight: 650, color: '#ff8b7e', align: 'left', alpha: appear });
  text(ctx, 'stopped by intent', narrow ? 14 : 24, cy + (narrow ? 19 : 24), { size: narrow ? 11 : 13, color: '#a4a7ad', align: 'left', alpha: appear });
  text(ctx, fmt(people), w - (narrow ? 14 : 24), cy, { size: narrow ? 22 : 28, weight: 650, color: '#7fdcff', align: 'right', alpha: appear });
  text(ctx, 'people signed in, no puzzle', w - (narrow ? 14 : 24), cy + (narrow ? 19 : 24), { size: narrow ? 11 : 13, color: '#a4a7ad', align: 'right', alpha: appear });
  out.gate = narrow ? { x: gx, y: h * 0.19, o: appear, ay: 0 } : { x: gx, y: h * 0.94, o: appear, ay: -100 };
  out.signin = { x: gx + (w - gx) / 2, y: h * 0.5, o: appear * (narrow ? 0 : 1) };
  out.foot = { x: narrow ? w / 2 : w * 0.29, y: h - (narrow ? 12 : 18), o: ease(seg(t, T.wave + 1.2, T.wave + 1.8)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  return out;
}

export const BOTS = { draw, loop: LOOP, still: 6, ratio: 1.75, narrowRatio: 0.9 };

export function BotStream({ t }) {
  const labels = {
    gate: <span className="scn-tag" style={{ color: '#5ff0d6' }}>POST /login · BotShield</span>,
    signin: <span className="scn-card" style={{ width: '11.5em', padding: '.9em 1em', background: 'rgb(11 32 63 / .9)' }}><b>Sign in · bank.in</b><span style={{ marginTop: '.6em', height: '1.6em', borderRadius: '.4em', background: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .07)' }} /><span style={{ marginTop: '.4em', height: '1.6em', borderRadius: '.4em', background: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .07)' }} /><span style={{ marginTop: '.6em', height: '1.8em', borderRadius: '.4em', background: '#0a6dbb', color: '#fff', textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: '1.8em', fontWeight: 600 }}>Continue</span></span>,
    foot: <span className="scn-card text-center"><b>6,410 rotating IPs, one intent</b><span>Caught by typing cadence, header order and retry timing</span></span>,
  };
  WAVES.forEach((wv, i) => { const [k, n] = KINDS[wv.kind]; labels[`w${i}`] = <span className="scn-tag" style={{ color: '#ffb1a8' }}><Logo k={k} size="1.1em" />{n}</span>; });
  return (
    <Scene scene={BOTS} t={t}
      label="Illustration: a login page under a credential-stuffing attack. People arrive at uneven, human pace and pass straight through. Bots arrive in regular bursts from 6,410 rotating IP addresses, driven by Headless Chrome, Selenium and Puppeteer, and are stopped at the gate by BotShield's intent check, using typing cadence, header order and retry timing. 18,204 attempts are stopped while 2,931 people sign in without a puzzle."
      labels={labels} />
  );
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: website/src/components/scenes/crowd.jsx

import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, inout, lerp, hash, glow, ring, rgba } from './engine.js';

/* One shot. A single blue point: one person. The camera pulls back and the
   dark fills with quiet points around it, the machines that can log in too.
   They light up kind by kind (service accounts, cloud keys, AI agents), one of
   each named as it does. Then, on the site, a slow amber wave runs through most
   of them: more access than they ever use. In the film (`film`), a few turn red
   instead, the ones attackers have found, and the words beside it carry the rest. */
const LOOP = 12;
const T = { pull: 0.9, pullEnd: 5.2, svc: 1.5, key: 2.5, agent: 3.5, wave: 5.6, waveEnd: 7.6 };
const KINDS = { svc: [169, 193, 222], key: [255, 210, 122], agent: [180, 191, 255] };
const COLS = 24, ROWS = 14; // a crowd, not a starfield: about 330 points
const DOTS = [];
for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
  const i = r * COLS + c;
  const x = -1.15 + (c + 0.5 + (hash(i, 1) - 0.5) * 0.9) * (2.3 / COLS);
  const y = -0.72 + (r + 0.5 + (hash(i, 2) - 0.5) * 0.9) * (1.44 / ROWS);
  const d = Math.hypot(x, y * 1.3);
  if (d < 0.05) continue; // a little room around the person
  const h = hash(i, 7);
  DOTS.push({ i, x, y, z: 0.85 + hash(i, 3) * 0.3, d, over: hash(i, 4) < 0.78, tw: hash(i, 5) * TAU, s: 0.7 + hash(i, 6) * 0.6, kind: h < 0.46 ? 'svc' : h < 0.82 ? 'key' : 'agent' });
}
// one named point of each kind, near the person; and the few attackers have found
// the nearest point of that kind is moved to the exact spot, so it is in frame at the zoom it is named at
const near = (kind, x, y) => {
  const p = DOTS.filter((q) => q.kind === kind).reduce((m, q) => (Math.hypot(q.x - x, q.y - y) < Math.hypot(m.x - x, m.y - y) ? q : m));
  Object.assign(p, { x, y, d: Math.hypot(x, y * 1.3) });
  return p;
};
// picked so each is on screen at the zoom it is named at
const NAMED = [['svc', near('svc', 0.079, -0.047), 'svc-payments'], ['key', near('key', -0.047, 0.044), 'AKIA••7Q2F'], ['agent', near('agent', 0.116, 0.042), 'invoice-agent']];
const FOUND = DOTS.filter((p) => p.d > 0.12 && p.d < 0.6 && hash(p.i, 9) < 0.08).slice(0, 7);
const BLUE = '#4fd2ff', WHITE = [223, 230, 239], AMBER = [246, 185, 85], RED = [255, 107, 93], REDHEX = '#ff6b5d';

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow, mx, my, film }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.7, LOOP);
  const cx = w / 2, cy = h / 2;
  const unit = Math.max(w, h * 1.4) * 0.5;
  // the pull-back: from right beside the person to the whole field
  const zoom = lerp(9, 1, inout(seg(t, T.pull, T.pullEnd))) * (1 + 0.025 * Math.sin(t * 0.35));
  const px = mx * 10, py = my * 8;
  const size = (narrow ? 0.85 : film ? 1.9 : 1) * 1.2;
  const where = (p) => { const k = (unit * zoom) / p.z; return [cx + p.x * k + px * (1.1 - p.z), cy + p.y * k + py * (1.1 - p.z)]; };

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for (const p of DOTS) {
    const [x, y] = where(p);
    if (x < -20 || x > w + 20 || y < -20 || y > h + 20) continue;
    const at = T.pull + 0.2 + p.d * 2.6;
    const a = ease(seg(t, at, at + 0.6)) * fade * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 1.3 + p.tw) ** 2);
    const edge = Math.min(1, Math.min(x, w - x, y, h - y) / (Math.min(w, h) * 0.16)); // the field fades out at its edges
    if (a * edge <= 0.01) continue;
    // each kind takes its colour as it is named, flares once, then settles
    const lit = ease(seg(t, T[p.kind], T[p.kind] + 0.5));
    const flash = lit * (1 - seg(t, T[p.kind] + 0.5, T[p.kind] + 1.4));
    let col = WHITE.map((v, j) => lerp(v, KINDS[p.kind][j], 0.75 * lit));
    const wv = !film && p.over ? ease(seg(t, T.wave + p.d * 1.6, T.wave + p.d * 1.6 + 0.5)) : 0;
    col = col.map((v, j) => Math.round(lerp(v, AMBER[j], wv)));
    const r = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(5, 1.15 * p.s * Math.sqrt(zoom))) * size * (1 + 0.35 * flash);
    if (wv > 0.02 || flash > 0.02) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col},${0.16 * Math.max(wv, flash) * a * edge})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r * 2.6, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${col},${Math.min(1, a * (1 + 0.6 * flash)) * edge})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  // film: the few attackers have found turn red, one after another
  if (film) FOUND.forEach((p, k) => {
    const on = ease(seg(t, T.wave + k * 0.16, T.wave + k * 0.16 + 0.35)) * fade;
    if (on <= 0) return;
    const [x, y] = where(p);
    const r = Math.max(3, 1.6 * p.s * Math.sqrt(zoom)) * size;
    const pu = (Math.max(0, t - T.wave - k * 0.16) * 0.8) % 1;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    glow(ctx, x, y, r * 7, REDHEX, 0.35 * on);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ring(ctx, x, y, r * (2 + pu * 5), REDHEX, (1 - pu) * 0.6 * on, 1.4);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${RED},${on})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r * 1.25, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  });

  // the person
  const pa = ease(seg(t, 0.1, 0.8)) * fade;
  const pr = (narrow ? 5 : film ? 10 : 6.5) * Math.max(1, Math.sqrt(zoom) * 0.75);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  glow(ctx, cx, cy, pr * 7, BLUE, 0.55 * pa);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  const pu = (t % 2.6) / 2.6;
  ring(ctx, cx, cy, pr * (1.6 + pu * 3), BLUE, (1 - pu) * 0.5 * pa, 1.4);
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#d9f6ff', pa); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, pr, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(BLUE, pa); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();

  // one name per kind, shown while that kind lights up, joined to its point by a hairline
  NAMED.forEach(([kind, p], k) => {
    if (!p) return;
    const [x, y] = where(p);
    const o = Math.min(ease(seg(t, T[kind] + 0.1, T[kind] + 0.4)), 1 - seg(t, T[kind] + 1.5, T[kind] + 1.9)) * fade;
    const right = p.x > 0, dx = (right ? 1 : -1) * (narrow ? 14 : film ? 40 : 22), dy = -(narrow ? 12 : film ? 30 : 18);
    if (o > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${KINDS[kind]},${0.6 * o})`; ctx.lineWidth = film ? 1.5 : 1;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + dx, y + dy); ctx.stroke();
    }
    out[`n${k}`] = { x: x + dx, y: y + dy, o, ax: right ? 0 : -100, ay: -50 };
  });

  // one caption at a time on the site: what the points are, then what the amber means
  const cap = film ? 0 : 1, by = h - (narrow ? 14 : 20), bx = narrow ? 14 : 22;
  out.person = { x: cx + pr + 12, y: cy, o: pa * cap * (1 - ease(seg(t, T.svc - 0.3, T.svc))), ax: 0, ay: -50 };
  out.crowd = { x: bx, y: by, o: cap * ease(seg(t, T.pullEnd - 0.6, T.pullEnd)) * (1 - ease(seg(t, T.wave + 0.2, T.wave + 0.6))) * fade, ax: 0, ay: -100 };
  out.over = { x: bx, y: by, o: cap * ease(seg(t, T.waveEnd - 0.5, T.waveEnd + 0.1)) * fade, ax: 0, ay: -100 };
  return out;
}

import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, lerp, hash, glow, ring, rgba, clamp, drawIcon, preload } from './engine.js';
import { view, drawGlobe, city, arc, along } from './globe.js';

/* A flood from 26 places at once breaks on a shield at the edge, near the
   bank's own users; a thin stream of real customers passes straight through
   to checkout, which never slows down. */
const TARGET = [19.08, 72.88];
const SRC = Array.from({ length: 26 }, (_, i) => [lerp(-35, 58, hash(i, 21)), lerp(10, 150, hash(i, 22))]).filter(([la, lo]) => Math.hypot(la - TARGET[0], (lo - TARGET[1]) * 0.8) > 22);
const CLEAN = [[28.6, 77.2], [12.97, 77.6], [22.57, 88.36], [13.08, 80.27], [17.38, 78.48]];
const RED = '#ff6b5d', CYAN = '#4fd2ff', TEAL = '#34e0c3';
const T = { atk: 1.6, shield: 1.9, absorbed: 3.0, end: 9.8 }, LOOP = 12;
preload([['server2', '#e8f8ff', 1.7]]);

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow, mx }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.6, LOOP);
  const R = narrow ? w * 0.62 : Math.min(w * 0.4, h * 0.56);
  const g = { cx: w / 2, cy: narrow ? h * 0.66 : h * 0.6, R, v: view(14, 64 + Math.sin(t * 0.2) * 4 + mx * 5) };
  drawGlobe(ctx, g, ease(seg(t, 0, 0.8)) * fade);

  const tg = city(g, ...TARGET);
  const atk = ease(seg(t, T.atk, T.atk + 0.8)) * (1 - seg(t, T.end, T.end + 1.2));
  const sh = ease(seg(t, T.shield, T.shield + 0.7)) * (1 - seg(t, T.end + 0.6, T.end + 1.6));
  const SR = R * 0.17;

  // faint attack paths
  const paths = SRC.map((s) => arc(g, s, TARGET, 0.18, 36));
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  if (atk > 0) for (const p of paths) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(RED, 0.14 * atk * fade); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); p.forEach((q, i) => (q.z > -0.1 ? (i ? ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y) : ctx.moveTo(q.x, q.y)) : null)); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // attack packets: fly, hit the shield, burst
  paths.forEach((p, i) => {
    const hit = p.findIndex((q) => Math.hypot(q.x - tg.x, q.y - tg.y) < SR) / (p.length - 1);
    const uh = hit > 0 ? hit : 0.92;
    const per = 0.13 + hash(i, 31) * 0.14, dur = 1.0 + hash(i, 32) * 0.5;
    for (let j = 0; j < 90; j++) {
      const e = T.atk + hash(i, 33) * per + j * per;
      if (e > T.end) break;
      const u = (t - e) / dur;
      if (u < 0) break;
      if (u < uh) {
        const q = along(p, u), q0 = along(p, Math.max(0, u - 0.08));
        if (q.z < -0.05) continue;
        const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(q0.x, q0.y, q.x, q.y);
        sg.addColorStop(0, rgba(RED, 0)); sg.addColorStop(1, rgba('#ff9a8c', 0.95 * fade));
        ctx.strokeStyle = sg; ctx.lineWidth = 1.8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(q0.x, q0.y); ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y); ctx.stroke();
        glow(ctx, q.x, q.y, 6, RED, 0.7 * fade);
      } else if (u < uh + 0.35 && sh > 0.3) {
        const b = (u - uh) / 0.35, q = along(p, uh);
        glow(ctx, q.x, q.y, 16 * (1 - b) + 4, '#ffb3a8', (1 - b) * 0.8 * fade);
        for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) { const a = hash(i * 40 + j, k) * TAU, r = b * 16; ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#ffd2c9', (1 - b) * 0.9 * fade); ctx.fillRect(q.x + Math.cos(a) * r, q.y + Math.sin(a) * r, 1.6, 1.6); }
      }
    }
  });
  // real customers: straight through to checkout
  CLEAN.forEach((s, i) => {
    const p = arc(g, s, TARGET, 0.12, 24);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(CYAN, 0.18 * fade); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); p.forEach((q, k) => (k ? ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y) : ctx.moveTo(q.x, q.y))); ctx.stroke();
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) { const u = ((t * 0.45 + i * 0.21 + j / 3) % 1); const q = along(p, u); glow(ctx, q.x, q.y, 6, CYAN, 0.9 * fade); }
  });

  // the edge shield
  if (sh > 0) {
    const pu = (t % 1.2) / 1.2;
    const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(tg.x, tg.y, SR * 0.2, tg.x, tg.y, SR);
    sg.addColorStop(0, rgba(TEAL, 0.02 * sh)); sg.addColorStop(0.8, rgba(TEAL, 0.12 * sh)); sg.addColorStop(1, rgba(TEAL, 0.32 * sh));
    ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tg.x, tg.y, SR * (0.85 + 0.15 * sh), 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ring(ctx, tg.x, tg.y, SR * (0.85 + 0.15 * sh), TEAL, 0.85 * sh * fade, 1.6);
    ring(ctx, tg.x, tg.y, SR * (1 + pu * 0.25), TEAL, (1 - pu) * 0.4 * sh * fade, 1);
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  // checkout, the bank's origin
  const ok = 1 - 0.0;
  glow(ctx, tg.x, tg.y, 26, CYAN, 0.6 * fade);
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#0f1c26', 0.95 * fade); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(CYAN, 0.9 * fade); ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(tg.x, tg.y, 13, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  drawIcon(ctx, 'server2', tg.x, tg.y, 14, '#e8f8ff', ok * fade, 1.7);

  // labels
  const calm = 1 - atk;
  out.edgeCalm = { x: narrow ? 14 : 24, y: narrow ? 14 : 24, o: calm * fade, ax: 0, ay: 0 };
  out.edgeAtk = { x: narrow ? 14 : 24, y: narrow ? 14 : 24, o: atk * fade, ax: 0, ay: 0 };
  out.origin = { x: narrow ? w - 14 : w - 24, y: narrow ? 14 : 24, o: ease(seg(t, 0.3, 0.9)) * fade, ax: -100, ay: 0 };
  out.target = { x: tg.x, y: tg.y + 22, o: ease(seg(t, 0.5, 1.0)) * fade, ay: 0 };
  out.absorbed = { x: tg.x + SR * 1.1, y: tg.y - SR * 1.1, o: ease(seg(t, T.absorbed, T.absorbed + 0.5)) * (1 - seg(t, T.end + 0.4, T.end + 1)) * fade, ax: 0, ay: -100 };
  out.p95 = { x: w / 2, y: h - (narrow ? 14 : 22), o: ease(seg(t, T.absorbed + 0.8, T.absorbed + 1.3)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  return out;
}

/* A small 3D and particle kit for the story scenes. Every scene is a pure
   function of time, so the website plays it live and the product film renders
   the very same frames. Units: a scene draws in CSS pixels on a canvas that is
   already scaled for the device. */

export const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
export const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
export const seg = (t, a, b) => clamp((t - a) / (b - a));
export const ease = (x) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - x, 3);
export const inout = (x) => (x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2);
export const lerp = (a, b, x) => a + (b - a) * x;
/* rises over [a, a+r], holds, falls over [b-r, b] */
export const win = (t, a, b, r = 0.4) => Math.min(seg(t, a, a + r), 1 - seg(t, b - r, b));

/* deterministic random numbers, so a frame at time t is always the same */
export function rng(seed = 1) {
  let s = seed >>> 0 || 1;
  return () => { s = (Math.imul(s, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s / 4294967296; };
}
/* a stable pseudo-random number for an integer index */
export const hash = (i, salt = 0) => { let x = Math.imul(i + 1, 2654435761) ^ Math.imul(salt + 7, 40503); x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 15), 2246822507); x ^= x >>> 13; return ((x >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000; };

/* rotate a point about X, then Y, then Z (radians) */
export function rot([x, y, z], ax = 0, ay = 0, az = 0) {
  let c = Math.cos(ax), s = Math.sin(ax);
  [y, z] = [y * c - z * s, y * s + z * c];
  c = Math.cos(ay); s = Math.sin(ay);
  [x, z] = [x * c + z * s, -x * s + z * c];
  c = Math.cos(az); s = Math.sin(az);
  [x, y] = [x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c];
  return [x, y, z];
}

/* A pinhole camera. World units: 1 = `unit` px at depth 0; +z comes towards the
   viewer. Returns screen x, y, a scale factor k and the depth z. */
export function camera(cx, cy, unit, dist = 4) {
  return ([x, y, z]) => { const k = dist / (dist - z); return { x: cx + x * unit * k, y: cy + y * unit * k, k, z }; };
}

/* latitude/longitude (degrees) to a point on a unit sphere, +z towards the viewer at lon0 */
export function sph(lat, lon) {
  const a = (lat * Math.PI) / 180, b = (lon * Math.PI) / 180;
  return [Math.cos(a) * Math.sin(b), -Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a) * Math.cos(b)];
}

/* points along a quadratic bezier */
export const qb = (a, c, b, u) => [0, 1].map((i) => (1 - u) * (1 - u) * a[i] + 2 * (1 - u) * u * c[i] + u * u * b[i]);

/* ---------- light ---------- */
export function glow(ctx, x, y, r, color, a = 1) {
  if (a <= 0 || r <= 0) return;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba(color, a));
  g.addColorStop(0.35, rgba(color, a * 0.35));
  g.addColorStop(1, rgba(color, 0));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x - r, y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
}
export function orb(ctx, x, y, r, color, a = 1, ring = 0.55) {
  glow(ctx, x, y, r * 2.6, color, 0.5 * a);
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - r * 0.3, y - r * 0.35, r * 0.1, x, y, r);
  g.addColorStop(0, rgba('#ffffff', 0.22 * a));
  g.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(color, 0.2 * a));
  g.addColorStop(1, rgba(color, 0.08 * a));
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(color, ring * a);
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.06);
  ctx.stroke();
}
export function ring(ctx, x, y, r, color, a, w = 1.5) {
  if (a <= 0) return;
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(color, a); ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
}
export function line(ctx, a, b, color, alpha, w = 1) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(color, alpha); ctx.lineWidth = w;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); ctx.stroke();
}
export function text(ctx, s, x, y, { size = 12, weight = 500, color = '#e8eaee', alpha = 1, align = 'center', mono = false, base = 'middle' } = {}) {
  if (alpha <= 0) return;
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px ${mono ? '"JetBrains Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace' : '"Inter Variable", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'}`;
  ctx.textAlign = align; ctx.textBaseline = base;
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba(color, alpha);
  ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
}

const HEX = {};
export function rgba(c, a) {
  if (c.startsWith('rgb')) return c;
  let v = HEX[c];
  if (!v) { const n = parseInt(c.slice(1), 16); v = HEX[c] = [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255]; }
  return `rgba(${v[0]},${v[1]},${v[2]},${clamp(a)})`;
}

/* ---------- icons, as images (stroke icons on a 24 grid) ---------- */
const PATHS = {

};
const IMG = {};
export function icon(name, color = '#ffffff', w = 1.8) {
  const k = `${name}|${color}|${w}`;
  if (!IMG[k] && typeof Image !== 'undefined') {
    const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="${w}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${PATHS[name]}</svg>`;
    const img = new Image();
    img.src = `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
    IMG[k] = img;
  }
  return IMG[k];
}
export function drawIcon(ctx, name, x, y, s, color, a = 1, w) {
  const img = icon(name, color, w);
  if (!img || !img.complete || a <= 0) return;
  ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(a);
  ctx.drawImage(img, x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, s);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
/* warm the icons the scenes use, so the first frame already has them */
export function preload(list) { for (const [n, c, w] of list) icon(n, c, w); }

import LAND from './land.json';
import { TAU, rot, sph, rgba, clamp } from './engine.js';

/* A dotted globe: Natural Earth land sampled into dots (see tools/scenes/gen-land.mjs). */
const DOTS = [];
for (let i = 0; i < LAND.length; i += 2) DOTS.push(sph(LAND[i] / 10, LAND[i + 1] / 10));

/* a view that brings (lat0, lon0) to the centre of the disc */
export function view(lat0, lon0) {
  const a = (lon0 * Math.PI) / 180, b = (lat0 * Math.PI) / 180;
  return (p) => rot(rot(p, 0, -a, 0), -b, 0, 0);
}

/* project a point on (or above) the sphere to the screen */
export const onScreen = (g, p) => { const q = g.v(p); return { x: g.cx + q[0] * g.R, y: g.cy + q[1] * g.R, z: q[2] }; };
export const city = (g, lat, lon, lift = 1) => onScreen(g, sph(lat, lon).map((c) => c * lift));

export function drawGlobe(ctx, g, alpha = 1, tint = '#3cc8f6') {
  const { cx, cy, R } = g;
  // atmosphere
  const at = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * 0.92, cx, cy, R * 1.22);
  at.addColorStop(0, rgba(tint, 0.28 * alpha)); at.addColorStop(0.35, rgba(tint, 0.08 * alpha)); at.addColorStop(1, rgba(tint, 0));
  ctx.fillStyle = at; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 1.22, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  // body
  const body = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - R * 0.35, cy - R * 0.45, R * 0.1, cx, cy, R);
  body.addColorStop(0, rgba('#173246', 0.95 * alpha)); body.addColorStop(0.6, rgba('#0c1822', 0.95 * alpha)); body.addColorStop(1, rgba('#070b10', 0.98 * alpha));
  ctx.fillStyle = body; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  // land, darker towards the limb, in a few alpha bands for speed
  const s = Math.max(1.1, R / 210);
  const bands = [[], [], [], [], []];
  for (const p of DOTS) {
    const q = g.v(p);
    if (q[2] <= 0.02) continue;
    bands[Math.min(4, Math.floor(q[2] * 5))].push(cx + q[0] * R, cy + q[1] * R);
  }
  bands.forEach((b, i) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#8fd8ff', (0.2 + i * 0.15) * alpha);
    for (let j = 0; j < b.length; j += 2) ctx.fillRect(b[j] - s / 2, b[j + 1] - s / 2, s, s);
  });
  // rim
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(tint, 0.35 * alpha); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
}

/* a great-circle arc lifted off the surface; returns screen points with depth */
export function arc(g, a, b, lift = 0.25, n = 48) {
  const p1 = sph(...a), p2 = sph(...b);
  const dot = clamp(p1[0] * p2[0] + p1[1] * p2[1] + p1[2] * p2[2], -1, 1);
  const w = Math.acos(dot), sw = Math.sin(w) || 1;
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const u = i / n, k1 = Math.sin((1 - u) * w) / sw, k2 = Math.sin(u * w) / sw, h = 1 + lift * Math.sin(Math.PI * u);
    pts.push(onScreen(g, [0, 1, 2].map((j) => (k1 * p1[j] + k2 * p2[j]) * h)));
  }
  return pts;
}
/* stroke an arc up to fraction `to` (0..1), hiding what is behind the globe */
export function strokeArc(ctx, pts, color, alpha, to = 1, w = 2, from = 0) {
  const n = pts.length - 1, a = Math.floor(from * n), b = Math.ceil(to * n);
  ctx.lineWidth = w; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
    const p = pts[i], q = pts[i + 1];
    const vis = clamp((Math.min(p.z, q.z) + 0.15) * 4);
    if (vis <= 0) continue;
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(color, alpha * vis);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y); ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y); ctx.stroke();
  }
}
export const along = (pts, u) => { const f = clamp(u) * (pts.length - 1), i = Math.min(pts.length - 2, Math.floor(f)), r = f - i; return { x: pts[i].x + (pts[i + 1].x - pts[i].x) * r, y: pts[i].y + (pts[i + 1].y - pts[i].y) * r, z: pts[i].z }; };

import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, lerp, hash, glow, ring, text, rgba, clamp } from './engine.js';
import { view, drawGlobe, city, arc, strokeArc, along } from './globe.js';

/* The same account signs in twice and passes MFA both times: Mumbai at 09:12,
   Lagos at 11:05. The arc between them is 7,620 km in 1 h 53 min, so the risk
   jumps from 12 to 94 and the session is held. */
const MUM = [19.08, 72.88], LAG = [6.52, 3.38];
const GREEN = '#3fd98f', RED = '#ff6b5d', AMBER = '#ffc566';
const T = { mum: 1.0, lag: 3.0, arc: 4.6, flag: 6.0, held: 7.4 }, LOOP = 12.5;
const STARS = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, i) => [hash(i, 11), hash(i, 12), hash(i, 13)]);

function ping(ctx, p, color, t0, t, a) {
  if (t < t0 || p.z < 0.05) return;
  const x = ease(seg(t, t0, t0 + 0.5));
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  glow(ctx, p.x, p.y, 34, color, 0.85 * x * a);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { const u = ((t - t0) * 0.7 + k * 0.5) % 1; ring(ctx, p.x, p.y, 6 + u * 30, color, (1 - u) * 0.75 * x * a, 1.4); }
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#ffffff', x * a); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
}

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow, mx }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.7, LOOP);
  const R = narrow ? w * 0.74 : Math.min(w * 0.5, h * 0.64);
  const g = { cx: w / 2, cy: narrow ? h * 0.86 : h * 0.84, R, v: view(-10, 38 + Math.sin(t * 0.25) * 3 + mx * 4) };
  // stars
  for (const [x, y, s] of STARS) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#cfe8ff', (0.15 + 0.35 * s) * fade); ctx.fillRect(x * w, y * h * 0.7, 1.2, 1.2); }
  drawGlobe(ctx, g, ease(seg(t, 0, 0.8)) * fade);

  const m = city(g, ...MUM), l = city(g, ...LAG);
  const flag = ease(seg(t, T.flag, T.flag + 0.5));

  // the arc between the two sign-ins, and a traveller along it
  const pts = arc(g, MUM, LAG, 0.32);
  const ar = ease(seg(t, T.arc, T.arc + 1.2));
  if (ar > 0) {
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    strokeArc(ctx, pts, flag > 0 ? RED : AMBER, 0.25 * fade, ar, 7);
    strokeArc(ctx, pts, flag > 0 ? '#ff8b7e' : AMBER, 0.95 * fade, ar, 2);
    const head = along(pts, ar < 1 ? ar : ((t - T.arc - 1.2) * 0.35) % 1);
    glow(ctx, head.x, head.y, 18, flag > 0 ? RED : AMBER, 0.9 * fade);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    const mid = along(pts, 0.5);
    out.dist = { x: mid.x, y: mid.y - 14, o: ease(seg(t, T.arc + 0.9, T.arc + 1.4)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  }

  ping(ctx, m, GREEN, T.mum, t, fade);
  ping(ctx, l, flag > 0 ? RED : GREEN, T.lag, t, fade);
  out.mum = { x: m.x, y: m.y - 22, o: ease(seg(t, T.mum + 0.2, T.mum + 0.7)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  out.lag = { x: l.x, y: l.y - 22, o: ease(seg(t, T.lag + 0.2, T.lag + 0.7)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  out.lagflag = { x: l.x, y: l.y + 18, o: flag * fade, ay: 0 };

  // the risk gauge
  const v = Math.round(lerp(12, 94, ease(seg(t, T.flag - 0.2, T.flag + 0.9))));
  const col = v >= 80 ? RED : v >= 50 ? AMBER : GREEN;
  const gx = narrow ? 44 : 58, gy = narrow ? 44 : 58, gr = narrow ? 26 : 32;
  const ga = ease(seg(t, 0.4, 1.0)) * fade;
  ctx.lineWidth = narrow ? 4 : 5; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba('#ffffff', 0.1 * ga); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gx, gy, gr, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(col, ga); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gx, gy, gr, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + (v / 100) * TAU); ctx.stroke();
  text(ctx, String(v), gx, gy + 1, { size: narrow ? 17 : 21, weight: 650, color: col, alpha: ga });
  out.gauge = { x: gx + gr + 12, y: gy, o: ga, ax: 0, ay: -50 };
  out.held = { x: w / 2, y: narrow ? h * 0.93 : h * 0.92, o: ease(seg(t, T.held, T.held + 0.5)) * fade, ay: -100 };
  return out;
}
