import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, lerp, hash, glow, ring, text, rgba, clamp, drawIcon, preload, qb } from './engine.js';

/* The money trail behind one payee. Rupees stream in from strangers and leave
   again within minutes; adapID profiles the account, a wall goes up in front
   of it, and Anita's ₹2,40,000 stops at the wall instead of leaving her bank.
   Positions are in flow space: a runs with the money (left to right on a wide
   screen, top to bottom on a phone), b runs across it. */
const GOLD = '#ffc566', RED = '#ff6b5d', OUT = '#ff9b6b', WALL = '#3fd98f';
const T = { in: 0.6, out: 1.7, scan: 5.8, wall: 7.6, anita: 7.9, held: 9.3 }, LOOP = 14;
const PAYERS = Array.from({ length: 13 }, (_, i) => ({ a: 0.07 + hash(i, 41) * 0.05, b: 0.1 + (i / 12) * 0.8, per: 1.1 + hash(i, 42) * 0.8, off: hash(i, 43) * 1.2, dur: 1.15 + hash(i, 44) * 0.4 }));
const ANITA = 6;
const M = { a: 0.55, b: 0.5 }, WALL_A = 0.37;
const OUTS = [['••2291', 'bank'], ['Wallet', 'phone'], ['••0318', 'bank'], ['ATM · cash', 'cash']].map(([n, g], i) => ({ n, g, a: 0.86, b: 0.18 + i * 0.213 }));
preload([['user', '#9fdcff'], ['user', '#ffffff'], ['bank', GOLD], ['bank', RED], ['bank', '#ffb9a3'], ['phone', '#ffb9a3'], ['cash', '#ffb9a3']]);

const inr = (n) => { const s = String(Math.round(n)); if (s.length <= 3) return s; const last = s.slice(-3); return `${s.slice(0, -3).replace(/\B(?=(\d{2})+(?!\d))/g, ',')},${last}`; };

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.7, LOOP);
  const P = (a, b) => (narrow ? [b * w, a * h] : [a * w, b * h]);
  const unit = narrow ? w : h;
  const m = P(M.a, M.b), mr = unit * 0.075;
  const wallUp = ease(seg(t, T.wall, T.wall + 0.6));
  const red = ease(seg(t, T.wall - 0.2, T.wall + 0.4));
  const appear = ease(seg(t, 0, 0.8)) * fade;

  // curves
  const inC = PAYERS.map((p) => { const a = P(p.a, p.b), b = m, c = P(0.33, lerp(p.b, M.b, 0.55)); return { a, b, c }; });
  const outC = OUTS.map((o) => { const b = P(o.a - 0.035, o.b), c = P(0.74, lerp(M.b, o.b, 0.6)); return { a: m, b, c }; });
  // where each incoming curve crosses the wall
  const uw = inC.map(({ a, b, c }) => { for (let k = 0; k <= 60; k++) { const q = qb(a, c, b, k / 60); if ((narrow ? q[1] : q[0]) >= (narrow ? WALL_A * h : WALL_A * w)) return k / 60; } return 0.5; });

  // faint channels
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (const [i, { a, b, c }] of inC.entries()) { if (narrow && i % 2) continue; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(GOLD, 0.1 * appear); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(...a); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(...c, ...b); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (const { a, b, c } of outC) { ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(OUT, 0.12 * appear * (1 - 0.6 * wallUp)); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(...a); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(...c, ...b); ctx.stroke(); }

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  // money in
  PAYERS.forEach((p, i) => {
    if (narrow && i % 2) return;
    const C = inC[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < 14; j++) {
      const e = T.in + p.off + j * p.per;
      if (i === ANITA) break;
      if (e > T.wall + 3) break;
      const u = (t - e) / p.dur;
      if (u < 0) break;
      const crossAt = e + uw[i] * p.dur;
      const blocked = crossAt >= T.wall + 0.3;
      if (!blocked && u >= 1) continue;
      if (blocked && u >= uw[i]) {
        const b = (t - crossAt) / 0.45;
        if (b < 1) { const q = qb(C.a, C.c, C.b, uw[i]); glow(ctx, q[0], q[1], 14 * (1 - b) + 4, WALL, (1 - b) * 0.9 * fade); }
        continue;
      }
      const q = qb(C.a, C.c, C.b, u), q0 = qb(C.a, C.c, C.b, Math.max(0, u - 0.07));
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(q0[0], q0[1], q[0], q[1]); g.addColorStop(0, rgba(GOLD, 0)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(GOLD, 0.9 * fade));
      ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(q0[0], q0[1]); ctx.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); ctx.stroke();
      glow(ctx, q[0], q[1], 8, GOLD, 0.9 * fade);
    }
  });
  // money out, minutes later
  OUTS.forEach((o, i) => {
    const C = outC[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
      const e = T.out + hash(i, 51) * 0.6 + j * (0.55 + hash(i, 52) * 0.3);
      if (e > T.wall) break;
      const u = (t - e) / 0.9;
      if (u < 0) break;
      if (u >= 1) continue;
      const q = qb(C.a, C.c, C.b, u), q0 = qb(C.a, C.c, C.b, Math.max(0, u - 0.09));
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(q0[0], q0[1], q[0], q[1]); g.addColorStop(0, rgba(OUT, 0)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(OUT, 0.9 * fade));
      ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(q0[0], q0[1]); ctx.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); ctx.stroke();
      glow(ctx, q[0], q[1], 7, OUT, 0.85 * fade);
    }
  });

  // the wall
  if (wallUp > 0) {
    const pu = (t % 1.6) / 1.6;
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const off = (k - 1) * 0.006;
      const [x0, y0] = P(WALL_A + off, 0.5 - 0.46 * wallUp), [x1, y1] = P(WALL_A + off, 0.5 + 0.46 * wallUp);
      const g = narrow ? ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y0) : ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x0, y1);
      g.addColorStop(0, rgba(WALL, 0)); g.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(WALL, (k === 1 ? 0.9 : 0.25) * fade)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(WALL, 0));
      ctx.strokeStyle = g; ctx.lineWidth = k === 1 ? 2 : 8;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(narrow ? x1 : x0, narrow ? y0 : y1); ctx.stroke();
    }
    const [sx, sy] = P(WALL_A, lerp(0.1, 0.9, pu));
    glow(ctx, sx, sy, 22, WALL, 0.5 * wallUp * fade);
  }

  // Anita's payment: the one that matters to her
  const C = inC[ANITA], ae = T.anita, ad = 1.0;
  const au = clamp((t - ae) / ad, 0, uw[ANITA]);
  let ax = null;
  if (t >= ae) {
    const q = qb(C.a, C.c, C.b, au);
    ax = q;
    const stopped = au >= uw[ANITA];
    glow(ctx, q[0], q[1], stopped ? 26 + Math.sin(t * 5) * 3 : 18, stopped ? WALL : GOLD, 0.95 * fade);
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  if (ax) { ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#fff4dc', fade); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax[0], ax[1], 7, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); text(ctx, '₹', ax[0], ax[1] + 0.5, { size: 10, weight: 700, color: '#6b4a00', alpha: fade }); }

  // payers
  PAYERS.forEach((p, i) => {
    if (narrow && i % 2) return;
    const [x, y] = P(p.a, p.b), s = unit * (i === ANITA ? 0.042 : 0.03);
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#141922', appear); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(i === ANITA ? '#ffffff' : '#7fd3ff', (i === ANITA ? 0.8 : 0.4) * appear); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, s, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    drawIcon(ctx, 'user', x, y, s * 1.1, i === ANITA ? '#ffffff' : '#9fdcff', appear);
  });
  // outflow accounts
  OUTS.forEach((o) => {
    const [x, y] = P(o.a, o.b), s = unit * 0.034;
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#1a1414', appear); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba('#ff9b90', 0.45 * appear * (1 - 0.5 * wallUp)); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, s, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    drawIcon(ctx, o.g, x, y, s * 1.1, '#ffb9a3', appear * (1 - 0.4 * wallUp));
    text(ctx, o.n, narrow ? x : x + s + 8, narrow ? y + s + 11 : y, { size: narrow ? 10.5 : 12, align: narrow ? 'center' : 'left', color: '#d9b3ab', alpha: appear * (1 - 0.4 * wallUp), mono: o.n.startsWith('••') });
  });

  // the payee
  const col = red > 0 ? RED : GOLD;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  glow(ctx, m[0], m[1], mr * 3.2, col, (0.45 + 0.25 * red) * appear);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  if (t > T.scan && t < T.wall) { const a0 = (t - T.scan) * 4; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba('#7fd3ff', 0.9 * fade); ctx.lineWidth = 2.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m[0], m[1], mr * 1.35, a0, a0 + 1.3); ctx.stroke(); }
  if (red > 0) { const pu = ((t - T.wall) % 1.3) / 1.3; ring(ctx, m[0], m[1], mr * (1.1 + pu * 1.2), RED, (1 - pu) * 0.6 * red * fade, 1.6); }
  ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#1a1612', appear); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(col, 0.9 * appear); ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m[0], m[1], mr, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  drawIcon(ctx, 'bank', m[0], m[1], mr * 1.05, red > 0 ? RED : GOLD, appear);

  // amount received, ticking up
  const rupees = Math.round((3860000 * seg(t, T.in + 0.9, T.wall)) / 1000) * 1000;
  text(ctx, `₹${inr(rupees)}`, m[0], m[1] - mr - (narrow ? 16 : 22), { size: narrow ? 17 : 21, weight: 650, color: red > 0 ? '#ffb1a8' : '#ffe0a3', alpha: ease(seg(t, T.in + 0.6, T.in + 1.2)) * fade });

        verdict: <span className="scn-card text-center" style={{ borderColor: 'rgb(63 217 143 / .4)' }}><b>Payments to this payee held, for every customer</b><span>Found from the pattern, before the next transfer</span></span>,

FILE: website/src/components/scenes/proof.jsx

import Scene from './Scene.jsx';
import { TAU, seg, ease, inout, lerp, hash, glow, rgba, clamp, rot, camera, drawIcon, preload, text } from './engine.js';

/* A scanner hands over 37 possible findings. BotShield's red-team agent
   replays each one: the beam sweeps the field, what cannot be exploited sinks
   and dims, and six rise. The blue-team agent then puts a virtual patch on
   each of the six and sends the fix to its owner. */
export const PROVEN = [[3, 'OTP endpoint without a rate limit', 'api.bank.in'], [9, 'Session token in a URL', 'm.bank.in'], [16, 'Debug route exposed', 'pay.bank.in'], [22, 'Card BIN check can be skipped', 'pay.bank.in'], [28, 'Weak CORS on the payments API', 'api.bank.in'], [33, 'Old TLS on a partner gateway', 'partners.bank.in']];
const IS = Object.fromEntries(PROVEN.map(([i], k) => [i, k]));
const COLS = 8, N = 37;
const SEV = (i) => (i * 7 + 3) % 5;
const T = { scan: 1.3, scanEnd: 4.1, patch: 4.9, done: 7.4 }, LOOP = 12;
const RED = '#ff6b5d', TEAL = '#34e0c3';
preload([['shieldok', '#0b1f1b', 2.2]]);

function draw(ctx, w, h, t, { narrow, mx, my }) {
  const out = {};
  const fade = 1 - seg(t, LOOP - 0.6, LOOP);
  const unit = narrow ? w * 0.43 : Math.min(w * 0.3, h * 0.62);
  const cx = narrow ? w / 2 : w * 0.33, cy = narrow ? h * 0.3 : h * 0.55;
  const cam = camera(cx, cy, unit, 4.5);
  const ax = -1.0 + my * 0.05, ay = -0.32 + mx * 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.3) * 0.03;
  const P = (p) => cam(rot(p, ax, ay, 0));
  const appear = ease(seg(t, 0, 0.7)) * fade;
  const bx = lerp(-1.25, 1.25, inout(seg(t, T.scan, T.scanEnd)));

  // the field
  const tiles = Array.from({ length: N }, (_, i) => {
    const c = i % COLS, r = Math.floor(i / COLS);
    const x = -1 + (c + 0.5) * (2 / COLS), z = -0.62 + (r + 0.5) * 0.25;
    const scanned = t >= T.scan && bx > x;
    const k = IS[i];
    const up = k !== undefined ? ease(clamp((bx - x) / 0.5)) : 0;
    const patched = k !== undefined && t >= T.patch + k * 0.35;
    return { i, x, z, scanned, k, up, patched };
  });
  const order = tiles.map((d) => ({ ...d, c: P([d.x, 0, d.z]) })).sort((a, b) => a.c.z - b.c.z);

  // grid floor
  ctx.strokeStyle = rgba('#7fb4d8', 0.08 * appear); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let gx = -1.2; gx <= 1.21; gx += 0.25) { const a = P([gx, 0.02, -0.75]), b = P([gx, 0.02, 0.75]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (let gz = -0.75; gz <= 0.76; gz += 0.25) { const a = P([-1.2, 0.02, gz]), b = P([1.2, 0.02, gz]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke(); }

  for (const d of order) {
    const proven = d.k !== undefined;
    const sink = d.scanned && !proven ? ease(clamp((bx - d.x) / 0.4)) : 0;
    const y = proven ? -0.28 * d.up : 0.06 * sink;
    const s = 0.105;
    const q = [[-s, y, -s], [s, y, -s], [s, y, s], [-s, y, s]].map(([a, b, c]) => P([d.x + a, b, d.z + c]));
    const sev = SEV(d.i), sc = sev >= 3 ? '#ff8b7e' : sev >= 1 ? '#f6b955' : '#9aa0a9';
    const col = d.patched ? TEAL : proven && d.scanned ? RED : d.scanned ? '#5b6068' : sc;
    const a = (d.scanned && !proven ? 1 - 0.65 * sink : 1) * appear;
    if (proven && d.up > 0) {
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
      const m = P([d.x, y, d.z]); glow(ctx, m.x, m.y, unit * 0.22, col, 0.55 * d.up * fade);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      // a stem down to the floor
      const f = P([d.x, 0, d.z]); ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(col, 0.5 * d.up * fade); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(f.x, f.y); ctx.lineTo(m.x, m.y); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(d.patched ? '#0f2622' : proven && d.scanned ? '#2a1513' : '#16191e', 0.95 * a);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(col, (proven && d.scanned ? 0.95 : 0.55) * a); ctx.lineWidth = proven && d.scanned ? 1.6 : 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(q[0].x, q[0].y); for (let j = 1; j < 4; j++) ctx.lineTo(q[j].x, q[j].y); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    const m = P([d.x, y, d.z]);
    if (d.patched) {
      const pa = ease(seg(t, T.patch + d.k * 0.35, T.patch + d.k * 0.35 + 0.4));
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(TEAL, pa * fade); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, unit * 0.05 * m.k, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
      drawIcon(ctx, 'shieldok', m.x, m.y, unit * 0.07 * m.k, '#0b1f1b', pa * fade, 2.2);
    } else {
      text(ctx, `F-${String(d.i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`, m.x, m.y, { size: Math.max(8, unit * 0.045 * m.k), weight: proven && d.scanned ? 650 : 500, color: proven && d.scanned ? '#ffd9d3' : '#c3c7cd', alpha: a, mono: true });
    }
    if (proven) {
      const lx = narrow ? null : w * 0.69, ly = narrow ? null : h * (0.17 + d.k * 0.125);
      out[`p${d.k}`] = narrow
        ? { x: d.k % 2 ? w * 0.52 : w * 0.04, y: h * (0.6 + Math.floor(d.k / 2) * 0.115), o: ease(seg(t, T.patch + d.k * 0.35, T.patch + d.k * 0.35 + 0.4)) * fade, ax: 0, ay: 0 }
        : { x: lx, y: ly, o: ease(seg(t, T.patch + d.k * 0.35, T.patch + d.k * 0.35 + 0.4)) * fade, ax: 0, ay: -50 };
      if (!narrow && d.patched) {
        const pa = ease(seg(t, T.patch + d.k * 0.35, T.patch + d.k * 0.35 + 0.5));
        ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(TEAL, 0.35 * pa * fade); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.setLineDash([2, 4]);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.x, m.y); ctx.bezierCurveTo(m.x + 60, m.y, lx - 60, ly, lx - 6, ly); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
      }
    }
  }

  // the red-team beam
  if (t > T.scan - 0.2 && t < T.scanEnd + 0.4) {
    const ba = Math.min(seg(t, T.scan - 0.2, T.scan + 0.2), 1 - seg(t, T.scanEnd, T.scanEnd + 0.4)) * fade;
    const a = P([bx, -0.35, -0.85]), b = P([bx, -0.35, 0.85]), c2 = P([bx, 0.05, 0.85]), d2 = P([bx, 0.05, -0.85]);
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(a.x, a.y, d2.x, d2.y);
    g.addColorStop(0, rgba(RED, 0)); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(RED, 0.28 * ba));
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.lineTo(c2.x, c2.y); ctx.lineTo(d2.x, d2.y); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba('#ffb1a8', 0.9 * ba); ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(d2.x, d2.y); ctx.lineTo(c2.x, c2.y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  }

  out.before = { x: narrow ? 12 : 22, y: narrow ? 12 : 20, o: appear * (1 - seg(t, T.scanEnd - 0.2, T.scanEnd + 0.3)), ax: 0, ay: 0 };
  out.after = { x: narrow ? 12 : 22, y: narrow ? 12 : 20, o: ease(seg(t, T.scanEnd - 0.2, T.scanEnd + 0.3)) * fade, ax: 0, ay: 0 };
  out.beam = { x: narrow ? w - 12 : w * 0.62, y: narrow ? 12 : 20, o: Math.min(seg(t, T.scan, T.scan + 0.3), 1 - seg(t, T.scanEnd, T.scanEnd + 0.3)) * fade, ax: -100, ay: 0 };
  return out;
}

export const PROOF = { draw, loop: LOOP, still: 9, ratio: 1.75, narrowRatio: 0.66 };

const Big = ({ k, v, c, sub }) => <span className="scn-card"><span style={{ textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '.08em', fontSize: '.74em', fontWeight: 600 }}>{k}</span><b style={{ fontSize: '1.5em', color: c, letterSpacing: '-.02em' }}>{v}</b><span>{sub}</span></span>;

    beam: <span className="scn-tag" style={{ color: '#ffb1a8' }}>Red-team agent replaying each finding</span>,

        <span style={{ display: 'inline' }}><b style={{ display: 'inline', fontSize: '.95em' }}>{name}</b><span className="pf-sub">{host} · virtual patch live · fix sent to owner</span></span>
      </span>
    );
  });
  return (
    <Scene scene={PROOF} t={t}
      label="Illustration: 37 possible findings from a scan lie on a field. BotShield's red-team agent replays each one; the 31 that cannot be exploited sink and dim, and six rise as proven exploitable: an OTP endpoint without a rate limit, a session token in a URL, an exposed debug route, a skippable card BIN check, weak CORS on the payments API and old TLS on a partner gateway. The blue-team agent puts a virtual patch on each and sends the fix to its owner."

/* A1b. One person's score, climbing with each reason, until the policy acts. */
const REASONS = [['okta', 'Signed in from Lagos, 2 h after Mumbai', 46], ['outlook', 'Mail forwarding rule to a Gmail address', 23], ['salesforce', '3,200 customer records exported', 13]];
export function RiskScoreCard({ k: fk } = {}) {
  return (
    <Viz k={fk} steps={[500, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1100]} hold={4200} label="Illustration: Kavya Reddy's risk score climbs from 12 to 94 as three unusual actions are added, each with its points; above 80 the policy holds and contains the identity in 1.4 seconds.">
      {(k) => {
        const v = 12 + REASONS.slice(0, Math.min(k, 3)).reduce((a, r) => a + r[2], 0);
        const col = v >= 80 ? '#ff7d70' : v >= 50 ? '#ffc566' : '#4be29a';
        return (
          <Win title="adapID AI · Identity risk" right={k >= 4 ? <Chip tone="ok">Contained · 1.4 s</Chip> : <Chip tone="info">Live</Chip>} glow="rgb(60 200 246 / .4)">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-[1em]">
              <Ring v={v} color={col} size="4.6em" />
              <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block vz-t" style={{ fontSize: '1.15em' }}>Kavya Reddy</span><span className="block vz-m">Treasury · baseline from day one</span></span>
              <span className="vz-wide ml-auto text-right"><span className="block vz-m">Policy</span><span className="block vz-t">Above 80 → hold</span></span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-[.9em] space-y-[.5em]">
              {REASONS.map(([app, t, pts], i) => (
                <div key={t} className={cx(`s${i + 1}`, 'flex items-center gap-[.7em] rounded-[.7em] px-[.8em] py-[.6em]')} style={{ background: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .035)', border: '1px solid rgb(160 190 230 / .09)' }}>
                  <Logo k={app} size="1.2em" /><span className="truncate vz-t" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .92em)' }}>{t}</span><span className="ml-auto font-semibold num" style={{ color: i ? 'var(--vz-red)' : 'var(--vz-amber)' }}>+{pts}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Win>
        );
      }}
    </Viz>
  );
}

/* A7. Active Directory: the path to Domain Admins, and the one change that cuts it. */
/* A5. Active Directory: the path an attacker would take to Tier 0, hop by hop
   with the technique on each edge; the one fix that cuts it; and live
   detection when someone tries anyway. Node positions are in % of the graph. */
const NODES = [
  { id: 'u', l: 'r.kapoor', s: 'User · phished', g: 'user', x: 9, y: 30 },
  { id: 'w', l: 'WKS-2140', s: 'Workstation', g: 'laptop', x: 30, y: 70 },
  { id: 's', l: 'svc-sql-report', s: 'Service account', g: 'key', x: 51, y: 30 },
  { id: 'g', l: 'Server Admins', s: 'Group · 3 levels deep', g: 'tree', x: 72, y: 70 },
  { id: 'd', l: 'Domain Admins', s: 'Tier 0', g: 'dc', x: 91, y: 30 },
];
const EDGES = [['u', 'w', 'Logs on as local admin'], ['w', 's', 'Kerberoasting'], ['s', 'g', 'GenericAll on group'], ['g', 'd', 'DCSync rights']];
const at = (id) => NODES.find((n) => n.id === id);
export function AdPath({ k: fk } = {}) {
  return (
    <Viz k={fk} steps={[500, 800, 800, 800, 800, 1200, 1000, 1000]} hold={4400} label="Illustration: an attacker moves from a phished user to a workstation, Kerberoasts a service account, abuses its GenericAll right on Server Admins and reaches Domain Admins; removing that one right cuts 41 of 57 paths, and a later DCSync attempt is blocked and the host isolated.">
      {(k) => {
        const hop = Math.min(k, 4), cut = k >= 5;
        const tok = cut ? at('s') : at(EDGES[Math.max(0, hop - 1)][hop ? 1 : 0]);
        return (
          <Win title={<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-[.5em]"><Logo k="windows" size="1em" />Attack paths · corp.local</span>} right={cut ? <Chip tone="ok">16 paths left · was 57</Chip> : <Chip tone="crit">{hop} of 4 hops to Tier 0</Chip>} glow="rgb(0 174 239 / .4)">
            <div className="relative" style={{ height: '19em' }}>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" aria-hidden="true">
                {EDGES.map(([a, b], i) => {
                  const A = at(a), B = at(b), live = hop > i, dead = cut && i >= 2;
                  return <line key={a + b} x1={A.x} y1={A.y} x2={B.x} y2={B.y} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" strokeWidth={live ? 2 : 1.2}
                    stroke={dead ? 'rgb(140 160 190 / .22)' : live ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .85)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .28)'} strokeDasharray={live && !dead ? undefined : '3 4'} className={live && !dead && !cut ? 'flowline' : undefined} />;
                })}
              </svg>
              {EDGES.map(([a, b, t], i) => {
                const A = at(a), B = at(b), live = hop > i, dead = cut && i >= 2;
                return (
                  <span key={t} className="absolute -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-[.55em] py-[.15em]" style={{ left: `${(A.x + B.x) / 2}%`, top: `${(A.y + B.y) / 2}%`, fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .72em)', fontWeight: 600, transition: 'all .5s', opacity: live || cut ? 1 : 0.35, background: dead ? 'var(--vz-solid)' : live ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .16)' : 'var(--vz-solid)', color: dead ? '#7a7c80' : live ? 'var(--vz-red)' : '#94969a', border: `1px solid ${live && !dead ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .4)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .14)'}`, textDecoration: dead ? 'line-through' : 'none' }}>{t}</span>
                );
              })}
              {cut && <span className="absolute -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 vz-chip c-ok" style={{ left: '61.5%', top: '50%', marginTop: '1.7em' }}>Right removed</span>}
              {NODES.map((n, i) => {
                const reached = !cut ? hop >= i : i <= 2, tier0 = n.id === 'd', top = n.y < 50;
                // names sit on the outer side of each node, so edges never cross them
                const name = <><span className="block w-full truncate vz-t" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .82em)' }}>{n.l}</span><span className="block w-full truncate vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .7em)' }}>{n.s}</span></>;
                return (
                  <span key={n.id} className="absolute flex w-[8.6em] flex-col items-center text-center" style={{ left: `${n.x}%`, top: `${n.y}%`, transform: `translate(-50%, ${top ? 'calc(-100% + 1.25em)' : '-1.25em'})` }}>
                    {top && <span className="mb-[.35em] block w-full">{name}</span>}
                    <span className="vz-ic" style={{ width: '2.5em', height: '2.5em', borderRadius: '.75em', background: 'var(--vz-solid)', transition: 'all .5s', color: tier0 ? (cut ? '#4be29a' : '#ff8b7e') : reached ? '#ffb3aa' : '#dddfe3', borderColor: tier0 && !cut ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .7)' : reached && !cut ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .4)' : undefined, boxShadow: tier0 && !cut && hop >= 4 ? '0 0 1.6em rgb(255 107 93 / .5)' : 'none' }}>
                      {n.g === 'dc' ? <Logo k="dc" size="1.5em" /> : <Gl g={n.g} />}
                    </span>
                    {!top && <span className="mt-[.35em] block w-full">{name}</span>}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
              {k >= 1 && <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute h-[.9em] w-[.9em] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full" style={{ left: `calc(${tok.x}% + 1.6em)`, top: `calc(${tok.y}% - 1.75em)`, background: cut ? '#8a8c90' : '#ff6b5d', boxShadow: cut ? 'none' : '0 0 0 .35em rgb(255 107 93 / .2), 0 0 1.2em #ff6b5d', transition: 'left .75s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), top .75s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), background .4s' }} />}
            </div>
            <div className="s5 mt-[.6em] flex items-center gap-[.8em] rounded-[.8em] px-[.9em] py-[.65em]" style={{ background: 'rgb(63 217 143 / .08)', border: '1px solid rgb(63 217 143 / .3)' }}>
              <Gl g="check" className="h-[1.3em] w-[1.3em] shrink-0" style={{ color: '#4be29a' }} />
              <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block vz-t">Remove GenericAll from svc-sql-report</span><span className="block truncate vz-m">The one change that closes 41 of 57 paths · no business impact found</span></span>
            </div>
            <div className="s7 mt-[.6em] flex items-center gap-[.8em] rounded-[.8em] px-[.9em] py-[.6em]" style={{ background: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .03)', border: '1px solid rgb(160 190 230 / .1)' }}>
              <span className="vz-mono shrink-0" style={{ color: '#94969a' }}>14:22:07</span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate vz-t" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .9em)' }}>DCSync attempt from WKS-2140</span>

/* A7. Identity graph and blast radius (CIRM). One person at the centre, the
   systems their identity opens on the first ring, what each system holds on
   the second. When the identity is compromised the blast radius spreads out
   along every edge; containment closes it again, one system at a time.
   Geometry is in a 1000 × 620 space; HTML labels sit on the same points. */
const IG_APPS = [
  { k: 'okta', n: 'Okta', a: -90, res: [['Admin console', 1], ['SSO to 42 apps', 0]] },
  { k: 'm365', n: 'Microsoft 365', a: -30, res: [['Mailbox · 3 years', 0], ['SharePoint · Finance', 0]] },
  { k: 'salesforce', n: 'Salesforce', a: 30, res: [['41,200 customers', 0], ['Report export', 0]] },
  { k: 'aws', n: 'AWS', a: 90, res: [['prod-admin role', 1], ['s3://kyc-docs', 0]] },
  { k: 'github', n: 'GitHub', a: 150, res: [['payments-service', 0], ['Actions secrets', 1]] },
  { k: 'slack', n: 'Slack', a: 210, res: [['#treasury', 0], ['Shared files', 0]] },
];
const IG_C = [500, 310];
const igPt = (deg, rx, ry) => [IG_C[0] + Math.cos((deg * Math.PI) / 180) * rx, IG_C[1] + Math.sin((deg * Math.PI) / 180) * ry];
const igCurve = ([x1, y1], [x2, y2], bend = 0.18) => {
  const mx = (x1 + x2) / 2, my = (y1 + y2) / 2, dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
  return `M${x1.toFixed(1)} ${y1.toFixed(1)} Q${(mx - dy * bend).toFixed(1)} ${(my + dx * bend).toFixed(1)} ${x2.toFixed(1)} ${y2.toFixed(1)}`;
};
const pct = ([x, y]) => ({ left: `${x / 10}%`, top: `${(y / 620) * 100}%` });

export function IdentityGraph({ k: fk } = {}) {
  const apps = IG_APPS.map((a) => ({ ...a, p: igPt(a.a, 235, 168), res: a.res.map(([n, crit], j) => ({ n, crit, p: igPt(a.a + (j ? 13 : -13), 420, 262) })) }));
  return (
    <Viz k={fk} className="vz-exact" steps={[600, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1500, 1500]} hold={4600} label="Illustration: Kavya Reddy's identity opens Okta, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, AWS, GitHub and Slack and, through them, twelve sensitive resources. After a suspicious sign-in her risk rises to 94, the blast radius spreads to every one of them, the two paths to admin access are highlighted, and containment closes each system until the blast radius is zero.">
      {(k) => {
        const hot = k >= 3, spread = k >= 4, crit = k >= 5, held = k >= 6;
        const reach = held ? 0 : spread ? 12 : 0;
        return (
          <Win title={<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-[.5em]">Identity graph · blast radius</span>}
            right={held ? <Chip tone="ok">Contained · 0 systems exposed</Chip> : spread ? <Chip tone="crit">6 systems · 12 resources exposed</Chip> : <Chip tone="info">Mapped</Chip>} glow="rgb(0 174 239 / .45)">
            <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[.9em]" style={{ aspectRatio: '1000 / 620', background: 'radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 50%, rgb(0 174 239 / .08), transparent 70%), #061833' }}>
              <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundImage: 'radial-gradient(rgb(160 190 230 / .12) 1px, transparent 1px)', backgroundSize: '2.2em 2.2em', maskImage: 'radial-gradient(closest-side, #000, transparent)', WebkitMaskImage: 'radial-gradient(closest-side, #000, transparent)' }} />
              <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 620" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" aria-hidden="true">
                <defs>
                  <radialGradient id="ig-blast"><stop offset="0" stopColor="#ff6b5d" stopOpacity=".26" /><stop offset=".7" stopColor="#ff6b5d" stopOpacity=".08" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#ff6b5d" stopOpacity="0" /></radialGradient>
                  <linearGradient id="ig-edge" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stopColor="#3cc8f6" stopOpacity=".55" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#3cc8f6" stopOpacity=".18" /></linearGradient>
                </defs>
                {/* orbits */}
                <ellipse cx="500" cy="310" rx="235" ry="168" fill="none" stroke="rgb(160 190 230 / .1)" strokeDasharray="3 7" />
                <ellipse cx="500" cy="310" rx="420" ry="262" fill="none" stroke="rgb(160 190 230 / .07)" />
                {/* blast radius: a red field that grows with the spread, and waves while it is live */}
                <ellipse cx="500" cy="310" rx={spread && !held ? 470 : hot && !held ? 120 : 0} ry={spread && !held ? 300 : hot && !held ? 86 : 0} fill="url(#ig-blast)" style={{ transition: 'rx 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), ry 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)' }} />
                {spread && !held && [0, 1, 2].map((i) => <ellipse key={i} className="ig-wave" cx="500" cy="310" rx="470" ry="300" fill="none" stroke="rgb(255 107 93 / .45)" style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 1.1}s` }} />)}
                {/* edges: identity → system → resource */}
                {apps.map((a, i) => {
                  const d1 = igCurve(IG_C, a.p, 0.12), live = spread && !held;
                  return (
                    <g key={a.k}>
                      <path d={d1} fill="none" stroke={held ? 'rgb(63 217 143 / .35)' : live ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .75)' : 'url(#ig-edge)'} strokeWidth={live ? 2.2 : 1.4} style={{ transition: `stroke .6s ${i * 0.12}s`, strokeDasharray: held ? '4 6' : undefined, animationDelay: `${i * 90}ms` }} className="ig-draw" />
                      {a.res.map((r) => {
                        const d2 = igCurve(a.p, r.p, 0.1), hi = crit && !held && r.crit;
                        return (
                          <g key={r.n}>
                            <path d={d2} fill="none" stroke={held ? 'rgb(140 160 190 / .18)' : hi ? '#ff6b5d' : live ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .45)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .2)'} strokeWidth={hi ? 3 : 1.2} style={{ transition: 'stroke .6s, stroke-width .6s', filter: hi ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ff6b5d)' : undefined }} />
                            {hi && <circle r="4" fill="#ffd0ca"><animateMotion dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" path={`${d1} ${d2.replace('M', 'L')}`} /></circle>}
                          </g>
                        );
                      })}
                      {live && <circle r="3.2" fill="#ff8b7e"><animateMotion dur={`${1.6 + i * 0.15}s`} repeatCount="indefinite" path={d1} /></circle>}
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
              </svg>

              {/* the identity */}
              <span className="absolute flex -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex-col items-center" style={pct(IG_C)}>
                <span className="relative flex h-[4.6em] w-[4.6em] items-center justify-center rounded-full" style={{ background: 'var(--vz-solid)', boxShadow: hot && !held ? '0 0 0 .3em rgb(255 107 93 / .25), 0 0 2.4em rgb(255 107 93 / .55)' : '0 0 0 .3em rgb(60 200 246 / .18), 0 0 2em rgb(60 200 246 / .35)', transition: 'box-shadow .8s' }}>
                  <Ring v={hot ? (held ? 94 : 94) : 18} color={held ? '#3fd98f' : hot ? '#ff6b5d' : '#3cc8f6'} size="4.6em" label={false} />
                  <span className="absolute"><Av name="Kavya Reddy" i={3} /></span>
                </span>
                <span className="mt-[.45em] whitespace-nowrap text-[.95em] font-semibold">Kavya Reddy</span>
                <span className="whitespace-nowrap vz-m" style={{ color: held ? 'var(--vz-green)' : hot ? 'var(--vz-red)' : undefined }}>{held ? 'Held · step-up sent' : hot ? 'Risk 94 · sign-in from Lagos' : 'Risk 18 · normal'}</span>
              </span>

              {/* systems */}
              {apps.map((a, i) => (
                <span key={a.k} className="s1 absolute -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" style={{ ...pct(a.p), transitionDelay: `${i * 70}ms` }}>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-[.45em] rounded-full py-[.3em] pl-[.3em] pr-[.75em]" style={{ background: 'var(--vz-solid)', border: `1px solid ${held ? 'rgb(63 217 143 / .45)' : spread ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .5)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .2)'}`, boxShadow: '0 .6em 1.4em -.6em rgb(0 0 0 / .8)', transition: 'border-color .6s' }}>
                    <App k={a.k} />
                    <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[max(var(--vz-min),.88em)] font-semibold">{a.n}</span>
                    {held && <Gl g="lock" className="h-[1em] w-[1em]" style={{ color: '#4be29a' }} />}
                  </span>
                </span>
              ))}

              {/* resources */}
              {apps.flatMap((a) => a.res).map((r, i) => (
                <span key={r.n} className="s2 absolute -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-[.6em] py-[.18em] text-[max(var(--vz-min),.74em)] font-medium" style={{ ...pct(r.p), transitionDelay: `${i * 40}ms`, background: '#0b203f', color: held ? '#7a7c80' : crit && r.crit ? '#ffd0ca' : spread ? 'var(--vz-red)' : '#b2b4b8', border: `1px solid ${crit && r.crit && !held ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .7)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .14)'}`, boxShadow: crit && r.crit && !held ? '0 0 1.2em rgb(255 107 93 / .45)' : 'none', transition: 'all .6s' }}>{r.n}</span>
              ))}

              {/* reach counter */}
              <span className="s3 absolute left-[2.5%] top-[4%] rounded-[.7em] px-[.8em] py-[.5em]" style={{ background: 'rgb(11 32 63 / .9)', border: '1px solid rgb(160 190 230 / .14)' }}>
                <span className="block vz-h">Blast radius</span>
                <span className="block text-[1.6em] font-semibold tracking-[-0.03em] num" style={{ color: held ? '#4be29a' : spread ? '#ff7d70' : '#edeff3' }}>{reach}<span className="vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .5em)' }}> of 12 resources</span></span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-[.7em] grid grid-cols-3 gap-[.5em]">
              {[['okta', 'Okta', 'Sessions revoked', 'Admin console'], ['aws', 'AWS', 'prod-admin suspended', 'prod-admin role'], ['github', 'GitHub', 'Token rotated', 'Actions secrets']].map(([app, n, done, risk]) => (
                <span key={n} className="s3 flex items-center gap-[.55em] rounded-[.7em] px-[.6em] py-[.5em]" style={{ background: held ? 'rgb(63 217 143 / .08)' : crit ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .09)' : 'rgb(255 255 255 / .03)', border: `1px solid ${held ? 'rgb(63 217 143 / .3)' : crit ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .3)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .1)'}`, transition: 'all .6s' }}>
                  <App k={app} />
                  <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block truncate vz-t" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .85em)' }}>{n}</span><span className="block truncate vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .74em)', color: held ? 'var(--vz-green)' : crit ? 'var(--vz-red)' : undefined }}>{held ? done : crit ? `Path to admin · ${risk}` : 'Watching'}</span></span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Win>
        );
      }}
    </Viz>
  );
}

/* A8. Active Directory tiers: every path from ordinary users to Tier 0, the
   attacker's shortest route traced across the tiers, the chokepoint most
   paths cross, and the one change that closes them. 1000 × 640 space. */
const TIERS = [
  { y: 40, h: 132, l: 'Tier 0', s: 'Domain control', c: '255 210 122' },
  { y: 238, h: 132, l: 'Tier 1', s: 'Servers, service accounts', c: '60 200 246' },
  { y: 436, h: 160, l: 'Tier 2', s: 'Users and workstations', c: '160 190 230' },
];
const TN = {
  dc: { l: 'DC01', g: 'dc', x: 430, y: 112 }, da: { l: 'Domain Admins', g: 'shield', x: 640, y: 112 }, ea: { l: 'Enterprise Admins', g: 'shield', x: 860, y: 112 },
  s1: { l: 'svc-sql-report', g: 'key', x: 305, y: 282 }, s2: { l: 'SRV-APP-04', g: 'server', x: 400, y: 340 }, s4: { l: 'Server Admins', g: 'tree', x: 520, y: 282 },
  s3: { l: 'svc-backup', g: 'key', x: 640, y: 340 }, s5: { l: 'SRV-FILE-01', g: 'server', x: 760, y: 282 }, s6: { l: 'GPO · Servers', g: 'doc', x: 885, y: 340 },
  u1: { l: 'r.kapoor', g: 'user', x: 270, y: 482 }, w1: { l: 'WKS-2140', g: 'laptop', x: 340, y: 556 }, u2: { l: 'a.iyer', g: 'user', x: 430, y: 482 }, w2: { l: 'WKS-0388', g: 'laptop', x: 510, y: 556 },
  u3: { l: 'helpdesk-07', g: 'user', x: 600, y: 482 }, w3: { l: 'WKS-1177', g: 'laptop', x: 680, y: 556 }, u4: { l: 'contractor-12', g: 'user', x: 780, y: 482 }, w4: { l: 'LAPTOP-HR3', g: 'laptop', x: 875, y: 556 },
};
// [from, to, through the chokepoint?, technique on the traced path]
const TE = [
  ['u1', 'w1', 1, 'Phished login'], ['u2', 'w2', 1], ['u3', 'w3', 1], ['u4', 'w4', 0],
  ['w1', 's1', 1, 'Kerberoasting'], ['w2', 's1', 1], ['w2', 's2', 1], ['w3', 's2', 1], ['w3', 's3', 0], ['w4', 's5', 0], ['u3', 's6', 0],
  ['s1', 's4', 1, 'GenericAll'], ['s2', 's4', 1], ['s6', 's5', 0],
  ['s4', 'dc', 1, 'Admin on DC01'], ['s3', 'dc', 0], ['s5', 'dc', 0],
  ['dc', 'da', 1, 'DCSync'], ['dc', 'ea', 0],
];
const TPATH = ['u1', 'w1', 's1', 's4', 'dc', 'da'];
const tCurve = (a, b) => {
  const A = TN[a], B = TN[b];
  if (Math.abs(A.y - B.y) < 80) return `M${A.x} ${A.y} C${(A.x + B.x) / 2} ${A.y}, ${(A.x + B.x) / 2} ${B.y}, ${B.x} ${B.y}`;
  const my = (A.y + B.y) / 2;
  return `M${A.x} ${A.y} C${A.x} ${my}, ${B.x} ${my}, ${B.x} ${B.y}`;
};
const onPath = (a, b) => TPATH.some((n, i) => (n === a && TPATH[i + 1] === b));
const tp = (x, y) => ({ left: `${x / 10}%`, top: `${(y / 640) * 100}%` });

export function AdTierGraph({ k: fk } = {}) {
  return (
    <Viz k={fk} className="vz-exact" steps={[600, 1100, 1500, 1500, 1500, 1300, 1200]} hold={4800} label="Illustration: an Active Directory map in three tiers. 57 paths lead from users and workstations to Tier 0; the shortest runs from a phished user through Kerberoasting, GenericAll on Server Admins and admin rights on the domain controller to DCSync. 41 of the 57 paths cross Server Admins; removing its admin rights on DC01 closes them, leaving 16.">
      {(k) => {

        const paths = cut ? 16 : 57;
        const tracePath = TPATH.slice(1).map((n, i) => tCurve(TPATH[i], n)).map((d, i) => (i ? d.replace('M', 'L') : d)).join(' ');

                </defs>

                {TE.map(([a, b, cp], i) => {

                  const stroke = isCut ? 'rgb(63 217 143 / .9)' : dead ? 'rgb(140 160 190 / .14)' : traced ? '#ff6b5d' : choke && cp ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .5)' : next && !cp ? 'rgb(246 185 85 / .7)' : all ? 'rgb(160 190 230 / .32)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / 0)';
                  return <path key={i} d={tCurve(a, b)} fill="none" stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={traced ? 3 : isCut ? 2.4 : 1.3} strokeDasharray={dead || isCut ?                 })}
                {trace && !cut && <circle r="6" fill="#ffe1dc" style={{ filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ff6b5d)' }}><animateMotion dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" path={tracePath} /></circle>}
                {choke && !cut && <circle className="ig-wave" cx={TN.s4.x} cy={TN.s4.y} r="60" fill="none" stroke="rgb(255 107 93 / .7)" />}
              </svg>

              {TIERS.map((t, i) => (
                <span key={t.l} className="s1 absolute" style={{ ...tp(30, t.y + 14) }}>
                  <span className="block text-[max(var(--vz-min),.72em)] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.12em]" style={{ color: `rgb(${t.c})` }}>{t.l}</span>
                  <span className="block whitespace-nowrap vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .7em)' }}>{t.s}</span>
                </span>
              ))}

              {Object.entries(TN).map(([id, n]) => {

'rgb(255 107 93 / .9)' : hotNode ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .6)' : tier0 ? 'rgb(255 210 122 / .45)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .18)'}`, boxShadow: chokeNode && !cut ? '0 0 1.4em rgb(255 107 93 / .6)' : hotNode ? /* the evidence that adds up, step by step (sample session) */
const EVIDENCE = [
  [2, 'She is on a phone call while paying', 'Seen on her phone', 9, 'phone'],
  [3, 'The account number was pasted, not typed', 'Seen on her phone', 8, 'copy'],
  [3, 'A new payee, added 2 minutes ago', 'Her account history', 7, 'user'],
  [4, '9 times more than she usually sends', 'Her account history', 14, 'chart'],

];
const BASE = 12;

/* Hero: a scam caught mid-payment. The customer is real and logged in normally;
   she is being coached on a call. Evidence adds points until the score is
   Critical, and the app holds the payment with a calm question. */
export function ScamCatch({ k: fk, time = '9:41' } = {}) {
  return (
    <Viz k={fk} steps={[900, 1200, 1100, 1100, 1300, 1300]} hold={5200} label="Illustration: Anita logs in to her bank app normally, so she is the real customer. While on a phone call she pastes an account number for a new payee and enters 2,40,000 rupees with the remark KYC update. The bank sees each reason in plain words; when the payee turns out to be on a mule account list the risk is Critical, the app pauses the payment and asks whether someone is asking her to pay, and an analyst calls her.">
      {(k) => {
        const v = BASE + EVIDENCE.filter(([s]) => k >= s).reduce((a, [, , , p]) => a + p, 0);
        const qs = [k >= 1 ? 'ok' : null, k >= 3 ? 'crit' : null, k >= 5 ? 'crit' : null];
        const call = k >= 2 ? `04:${10 + k * 7}` : null; // she has been on the call for four minutes
        return (

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useInView, useReducedMotion, cx } from '../../lib/motion.js';
import { Icon } from '../ui.jsx';

/* The fraud hero, in one glance: the three frauds a bank loses money to, each
   as it arrives, what gave it away, and what happened, in milliseconds. The
   full story of one of them (Anita) is told further down the page. Values are
   illustrative. */

const ROWS = [
  { icon: 'UserCircle', kind: 'Account takeover', what: 'Right password, new phone, typing unlike the customer', act: 'Stepped up', tone: 'warn', ms: 41 },
  { icon: 'Phone', kind: 'Payment scam', what: '₹2,40,000 to a new payee, customer on a call', act: 'Paused', tone: 'hold', ms: 63 },
  { icon: 'Bank', kind: 'Mule account', what: 'Payee account flagged in shared fraud intelligence', act: 'Blocked', tone: 'crit', ms: 38 },
];
const TONE = {
  warn: 'bg-[#f6b955]/15 text-[#f6c776]',
  hold: 'bg-[#ff9a5c]/15 text-[#ffb27f]',
  crit: 'bg-[#ff6b5d]/15 text-[#ff8a7e]',
};

export function FraudDecisions() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [k, setK] = useState(ROWS.length * 2); // without scripts, every row with its outcome
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !seen) { setK(ROWS.length * 2); return undefined; }
    // row i arrives at step 2i, its outcome at 2i+1; then hold, and again
    let i = 0, t;
    const next = () => { setK(i); t = setTimeout(() => { i = i >= ROWS.length * 2 ? 0 : i + 1; next(); }, i >= ROWS.length * 2 ? 4200 : i % 2 ? 700 : 900); };
    next();
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [seen, reduce]);
  return (
    <figure ref={ref} className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[540px] lg:mr-0" aria-label="Illustration: three sessions in a bank's app. An account takeover, with the right password but a new phone and typing unlike the customer, is stepped up in 41 ms. A payment scam, 2,40,000 rupees to a new payee while the customer is on a call, is paused in 63 ms. A payment to a mule account flagged in shared fraud intelligence is blocked in 38 ms.">
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-white/12 bg-[#071733]/85 shadow-[0_40px_90px_-40px_rgba(0,0,0,.9)] backdrop-blur">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-3.5">
          <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2"><span className="absolute inset-0 animate-ping rounded-full bg-[#3fd98f] opacity-60" /><span className="relative h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#3fd98f]" /></span>
          <span className="text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-white">Live decisions</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-[12.5px] text-white/55">Mobile banking · Internet banking · UPI</span>
        </div>
        <ul>
          {ROWS.map((r, i) => {
            const shown = k >= i * 2, done = k >= i * 2 + 1;
            return (
              <li key={r.kind} className={cx('flex items-center gap-3.5 border-b border-white/[.07] px-5 py-4 transition-all duration-500 last:border-0', shown ? 'opacity-100' : 'translate-y-1 opacity-0')}>
                <span className="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[12px] bg-white/[.07] text-[#9fd3ff]"><Icon name={r.icon} size={20} /></span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block text-[14.5px] font-semibold text-white">{r.kind}</span>
                  <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[12.5px] leading-snug text-white/60">{r.what}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="w-[92px] shrink-0 text-right">
                  <span className={cx('inline-block rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold transition-all duration-300', done ? TONE[r.tone] : 'bg-white/[.06] text-white/45')}>{done ? r.act : 'Scoring…'}</span>
                  <span className={cx('mt-1 block text-[11.5px] tabular-nums text-white/45 transition-opacity duration-300', done ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}>{r.ms} ms</span>
                </span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-white/10 bg-white/[.03] px-5 py-3 text-[12.5px] text-white/70">
          <Icon name="ChatCircleText" size={15} className="text-[#9fd3ff]" />Every decision comes with its reason, for the analyst and the auditor.
        </div>

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useInView, useReducedMotion, cx } from '../../lib/motion.js';

/* Three checks, one decision, as a single dial. Each ring is one check and
   sweeps as it reads its signals: a clean check closes its ring, a check that
   finds something stops where it found it. The middle holds the decision. Four
   real sessions take turns and can be picked. Values are illustrative; the
   times match the live decisions in the hero. */

const RINGS = [
  { k: 'id', name: 'Identity', asks: 'Is this the real customer?' },
  { k: 'pr', name: 'Protection', asks: 'Is the customer safe and acting freely?' },
  { k: 'pay', name: 'Payment', asks: 'Is this payment normal?' },
];

// per session, per ring: [state, what the check found, how far round it got]
const SESSIONS = [
  {
    k: 'genuine', tab: 'Genuine customer', who: 'Anita', ctx: 'Mobile banking · ₹3,200',
    reads: [['ok', 'Her typing, her phone', 1], ['ok', 'No call, no remote access', 1], ['ok', 'A payee she pays often', 1]],
    verdict: 'Allow', tone: 'ok', ms: 34, why: 'Everything matches how Anita normally pays. No OTP, no step-up, no friction.',
  },
  {
    k: 'ato', tab: 'Account takeover', who: 'Rohan', ctx: 'Internet banking · login',
    reads: [['crit', 'Right password, wrong hands', 0.42], ['idle', 'Not reached', 0], ['idle', 'Not reached', 0]],
    verdict: 'Step up', tone: 'warn', ms: 41, why: 'The password is correct, but the typing and the device are not his. A face check before anything moves.',
  },
  {
    k: 'scam', tab: 'Payment scam', who: 'Anita', ctx: 'Mobile banking · ₹2,40,000',
    reads: [['ok', 'Her typing, her phone', 1], ['crit', 'On a call for six minutes', 0.55], ['warn', 'New payee, 18× her usual', 0.78]],
    verdict: 'Hold', tone: 'hold', ms: 63, why: 'It is really her, and that is the point: she is being talked through it. An analyst calls her before the money moves.',
  },
  {
    k: 'mule', tab: 'Mule payment', who: 'Imran', ctx: 'UPI · ₹45,000',
    reads: [['ok', 'His typing, his phone', 1], ['ok', 'No call, no remote access', 1], ['crit', 'Payee is a known mule account', 0.88]],
    verdict: 'Block', tone: 'crit', ms: 38, why: 'The payee is flagged as a mule in shared fraud intelligence. The money never leaves the account.',
  },
];

const TONE = { ok: 'var(--color-ok)', warn: 'var(--color-warn)', hold: 'var(--color-hold)', crit: 'var(--color-crit)', idle: 'var(--color-line-2)' };
const R = [168, 132, 96];
const C = R.map((r) => 2 * Math.PI * r);
const SWEEP = 1150; // one ring, ms
const STEP = 820; // one ring starts after the one outside it, ms

export function FraudGate() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [s, setS] = useState(2); // without scripts, the payment scam, decided
  const [k, setK] = useState(9);
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !seen || held) return undefined;
    setK(0);
    const at = [60, STEP, STEP * 2, STEP * 3, STEP * 3 + SWEEP, STEP * 3 + SWEEP + 4200];
    const ids = at.map((ms, i) => setTimeout(() => (i === 5 ? (setS((v) => (v + 1) % SESSIONS.length), setK(0)) : setK(i + 1)), ms));
    return () => ids.forEach(clearTimeout);
  }, [seen, reduce, held, s]);
  const pick = (i) => { setHeld(true); setS(i); setK(9); };
  const S = SESSIONS[s];
  const decided = k >= 5;

  return (
    <figure ref={ref} className="fg" aria-label={`Illustration: three checks on one dial. ${SESSIONS.map((x) => `${x.tab}: ${x.reads.map((r, i) => `${RINGS[i].name}, ${r[1]}`).join('; ')}. ${x.verdict} in ${x.ms} milliseconds. ${x.why}`).join(' ')}`}>
      {/* the sessions, as words rather than buttons in boxes */}
      <div className="fg-pick" role="tablist" aria-label="Example sessions">
        {SESSIONS.map((x, i) => (
          <button key={x.k} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={i === s} onClick={() => pick(i)} className={cx('fg-tab', i === s && 'on')}>{x.tab}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="fg-stage" key={S.k}>
        <div className="fg-left">
        <div className="fg-dial" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 440 440">
            <defs>
              <filter id="fg-soft" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6" /></filter>
            </defs>
            {RINGS.map((ring, i) => {
              const [state, , frac] = S.reads[i];
              const live = k >= i + 1;
              const go = live ? frac : 0;
              const col = state === 'idle' ? TONE.idle : TONE[state];
              return (
                <g key={ring.k}>
                  <circle className="fg-track" cx="220" cy="220" r={R[i]} />
                  <circle className="fg-arc" cx="220" cy="220" r={R[i]} stroke={col}
                    strokeDasharray={C[i]} strokeDashoffset={C[i] * (1 - go)}
                    style={{ transitionDuration: `${SWEEP}ms`, opacity: live ? 1 : 0.0001 }} />
                  {/* the reading head: it rides the end of the arc */}
                  <g className="fg-head" style={{ transitionDuration: `${SWEEP}ms`, transform: `rotate(${go * 360}deg)`, opacity: live && go > 0 && go < 1 ? 1 : 0 }}>
                    <circle cx="220" cy={220 - R[i]} r="9" fill={col} filter="url(#fg-soft)" opacity=".5" />
                    <circle cx="220" cy={220 - R[i]} r="4.5" fill={col} />
                  </g>
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </svg>
          <div className={cx('fg-mid', decided && 'on')}>
            <span className="fg-who">{S.who}</span>
            {decided
              ? <strong className="fg-verdict" style={{ color: TONE[S.tone] }}>{S.verdict}</strong>
              : <span className="fg-wait"><i /><i /><i /></span>}
            <span className="fg-ms">{decided ? `${S.ms} ms` : 'reading'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="fg-ctx">{S.ctx}</p>
        </div>

        {/* what each check found: three lines, no boxes */}
        <ol className="fg-reads">
          {RINGS.map((ring, i) => {
            const [state, read] = S.reads[i];
            const on = k >= i + 2 || decided;
            return (
              <li key={ring.k} className={cx('fg-read', on && 'on', state === 'idle' && 'idle')} style={{ '--c': TONE[state] }}>
                <span className="fg-dot" />
                <span className="fg-name">{ring.name}</span>
                <span className="fg-ask">{ring.asks}</span>
                <span className="fg-found">{read}</span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      </div>

      <p className={cx('fg-why', decided && 'on')}>{S.why}</p>
    </figure>
  );
}

export function Ring({ v, color = '#27b8f2', size = '3.4em', label = true, k: fk }) {
  const r = 15.9, c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  return (
    <span className="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" className="absolute inset-0 -rotate-90"><circle cx="18" cy="18" r={r} fill="none" stroke="rgb(255 255 255 / .1)" strokeWidth="3" /><circle cx="18" cy="18" r={r} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={`${(v / 100) * c} ${c}`} style={{ transition: 'stroke-dasharray 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), stroke .4s' }} /></svg>
      {label && <span className="relative text-[1.05em] font-bold num" style={{ color }}>{v}</span>}
    </span>
  );
}

import { useRef } from 'react';
import {
  siOkta, siGithub, siGithubcopilot, siClaude, siGooglegemini, siKubernetes, siTerraform, siN8n, siZapier,
  siLanggraph, siGooglecloud, siCursor, siJira, siGitlab, siModelcontextprotocol, siCloudflare, siDatabricks, siSnowflake,
  siAtlassian, siGoogle, siPostgresql, siStripe, siHubspot, siZendesk, siGmail, siGoogledrive, siPaytm, siPhonepe, siGooglepay,
  siVisa, siMastercard, siRazorpay, siGooglechrome, siSelenium, siPuppeteer, siAndroid, siApple, siMongodb, siMysql, siApachekafka,
  siDocker, siSplunk, siAnthropic, siKeycloak, siAuth0, siDropbox, siWhatsapp, siLinux, siKalilinux, siConfluence, siBitbucket,
  siNotion, siGithubactions, siVault, siLangchain, siHuggingface, siSap, siElasticsearch, siRedis, siPagerduty, siAirtel, siJio,
  siHdfcbank, siIcicibank, siMetasploit, siNginx,
} from 'simple-icons';
import { cx, useSteps } from '../../lib/motion.js';

export { cx };

/* `k` classes for the cumulative step engine: k(3) -> "k0 k1 k2 k3" */
export const kc = (k) => Array.from({ length: k + 1 }, (_, i) => `k${i}`).join(' ');

/* A picture wrapper: container-sized, plays its steps while on screen. */
export function Viz({ steps, loop = true, hold, speed, className, label, children, style, k: forced }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const auto = useSteps(ref, steps || [], { loop, hold, speed });
  const k = forced ?? auto; // the product film drives steps from its own clock
  return (
    <figure ref={ref} className={cx('vzw', className)} aria-label={label} role={label ? 'img' : undefined} style={style}>
      <div className={cx('vz', kc(k))} aria-hidden={label ? 'true' : undefined}>{typeof children === 'function' ? children(k) : children}</div>
    </figure>
  );
}

export function Win({ title, right, className, children, glow, style, bodyClass = 'vz-body' }) {
  return (
    <div className={cx('vz-win', className)} style={{ ...(glow ? { '--glow': glow } : null), ...style }}>
      <div className="vz-bar"><i /><i /><i /><b>{title}</b>{right && <span>{right}</span>}</div>
      <div className={bodyClass}>{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export const Chip = ({ tone = 'mute', plain, children, className }) => <span className={cx('vz-chip', `c-${tone}`, plain && 'plain', className)}>{children}</span>;

const AV = ['#7fd3ff', '#9fb0ff', '#7ef0c9', '#ffd27a', '#ffa3c4', '#b6f07f'];
export function Av({ name, i = 0 }) {
  const ini = name.split(/\s+/).map((w) => w[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase();
  return <span className="vz-av" style={{ background: AV[i % AV.length] }}>{ini}</span>;
}

export function Spark({ data, color = '#27b8f2', w = 120, h = 32, fill = true, className, domain }) {
  const [min, max] = domain || [Math.min(...data), Math.max(...data)];
  const pts = data.map((v, i) => [(i / (data.length - 1)) * w, h - 3 - ((v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (h - 6)]);
  const d = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" className={className} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
      {fill && <path d={`${d} L${w} ${h} L0 ${h} Z`} fill={color} opacity=".12" />}
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="1.6" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* A product pointer that glides between targets given in % of the picture. */
export function Cursor({ x, y, click, hidden }) {
  if (hidden) return null;
  return (
    <svg className={cx('vz-cursor', click && 'click')} style={{ left: `${x}%`, top: `${y}%` }} viewBox="0 0 22 24" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M2 2 L20 9.5 L11.5 12 L8 21 Z" fill="#fff" stroke="#081c39" strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* near-black brand colours (GitHub, Cursor, Notion…) take the text colour, so
   they read on a dark window and on a light page alike */
const brandFill = (hex) => {
  const n = parseInt(hex, 16), r = n >> 16, g = (n >> 8) & 255, b = n & 255;
  return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b < 60 ? 'currentColor' : `#${hex}`;
};

/* an app icon: the brand mark on a small rounded tile */
export function App({ k, className, style }) {
  return <span className={cx('vz-app', className)} style={style} title={logoTitle(k)}><Logo k={k} size="1.15em" /></span>;
}
export function Logo({ k, size = '1.25em', color, className }) {
  if (DRAWN[k] && !(color && (k === 'm365' || k === 'microsoft'))) {
    const [title, draw] = DRAWN[k];
    return <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} className={className} role="img" aria-label={title}>{draw()}</svg>;
  }
  if (k === 'aws') {
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} className={className} role="img" aria-label="AWS">
        <text x="12" y="13.2" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="9.6" fontWeight="800" fontFamily="Inter Variable, Arial, sans-serif" fill={color || 'currentColor'}>aws</text>
        <path d="M5 16.6c4.2 2.4 9.6 2.4 13.6 0" fill="none" stroke="#ff9900" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  const s = SI[k] || CUSTOM[k];
  if (!s) return null;
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} className={className} role="img" aria-label={s.title}>
      <path d={s.path} fill={color || (SI[k] ? brandFill(SI[k].hex) : 'currentColor')} />
    </svg>
  );
}
export const logoTitle = (k) => (k === 'aws' ? 'AWS' : DRAWN[k]?.[0] || (SI[k] || CUSTOM[k])?.title || k);

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useInView, useReducedMotion, cx } from '../../lib/motion.js';
import { Logo } from './kit.jsx';

/* NHI Security for AWS, at a glance: one AWS account, the services its
   machine identities reach, and the one finding that matters. The lines draw,
   a key travels along each, the over-privileged role is flagged with what to
   do, the fix is applied and the card turns green. Then it plays again.
   Names and numbers are illustrative. */

const TILES = [
  { k: 'lambda', x: 16, y: 20, label: 'Lambda' },
  { k: 's3', x: 82, y: 17, label: 'S3' },
  { k: 'github', x: 86, y: 47, label: 'GitHub' },
  { k: 'rds', x: 15, y: 79, label: 'RDS' },
];
const C = { x: 46, y: 50 }; // the AWS account, in % of the picture
const W = 500, H = 400;
const px = (p) => [(p.x / 100) * W, (p.y / 100) * H];
const curve = (a, b) => { const [x1, y1] = px(a), [x2, y2] = px(b); return `M${x1} ${y1} C${x1} ${y2}, ${x1} ${y2}, ${x2} ${y2}`; };
const STEPS = [700, 900, 900, 1300, 900, 3200];

export function NhiMap() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [k, setK] = useState(5);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !seen) { setK(5); return undefined; }
    let i = 0, t;
    const next = () => { setK(i); t = setTimeout(() => { i = (i + 1) % STEPS.length; next(); }, STEPS[i]); };
    next();
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [seen, reduce]);
  const fixed = k >= 5;
  return (
    <figure ref={ref} className="nm relative mx-auto aspect-[5/4] w-full max-w-[560px]" aria-label="Illustration: an AWS account in the centre, with lines to Lambda, S3, RDS and GitHub. One IAM role, ecs-notify-svc, is flagged: it can use 214 permissions but has used 9 in 90 days. Remove unused access is pressed and 205 permissions are removed.">
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full overflow-visible" aria-hidden="true">
        {TILES.map((t, i) => (
          <g key={t.k}>
            <path id={`nm-p${i}`} d={curve(C, t)} pathLength="1" fill="none" stroke="rgb(190 215 255 / .55)" strokeWidth="1.6" className={cx('nm-line', k >= 1 && 'on')} style={{ transitionDelay: `${i * 120}ms` }} />
            {k >= 2 && !reduce && <circle r="4" fill="#7fdcff"><animateMotion dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin={`${i * 0.3}s`}><mpath href={`#nm-p${i}`} /></animateMotion></circle>}
          </g>
        ))}
        {/* the line to the finding */}
        <path d={`M${(C.x / 100) * W} ${(C.y / 100) * H} V ${0.66 * H} Q ${(C.x / 100) * W} ${0.7 * H} ${(C.x / 100) * W + 20} ${0.7 * H} H ${0.56 * W}`} fill="none" stroke={fixed ? '#4be29a' : '#ff8b7e'} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeDasharray="5 4" className={cx('nm-dash', k >= 3 && 'on')} />
      </svg>

      {/* key glyphs on the lines, as access the identities hold */}
      {[[31, 24], [64, 18], [70, 47], [30, 76]].map(([x, y], i) => (
        <span key={i} aria-hidden="true" className={cx('nm-key absolute grid h-7 w-7 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full border border-white/25 bg-[#0b2a5c] text-[#bfe6ff]', k >= 1 && 'on')} style={{ left: `${x}%`, top: `${y}%`, transitionDelay: `${300 + i * 120}ms` }}>
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round"><circle cx="5" cy="8" r="2.6" /><path d="M7.6 8H14M12 8v2.2M14 8v1.6" /></svg>
        </span>
      ))}

      {TILES.map((t, i) => (
        <span key={t.k} className={cx('nm-tile absolute flex -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex-col items-center', k >= 0 && 'on')} style={{ left: `${t.x}%`, top: `${t.y}%`, transitionDelay: `${i * 90}ms` }}>
          <span className="grid h-[52px] w-[52px] place-items-center rounded-[14px] bg-white text-[#081c39] shadow-[0_14px_30px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,.6)] max-sm:h-11 max-sm:w-11"><Logo k={t.k} size="58%" /></span>
          <span className="mt-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-white/80">{t.label}</span>
        </span>
      ))}

      <span className="absolute grid h-[84px] w-[84px] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-[22px] bg-white text-[#081c39] shadow-[0_22px_50px_-16px_rgba(0,0,0,.7)] max-sm:h-16 max-sm:w-16" style={{ left: `${C.x}%`, top: `${C.y}%` }}>
        <Logo k="aws" size="62%" />
      </span>

      {/* the finding, then the fix */}
      <div className={cx('nm-card absolute bottom-[3%] right-0 w-[48%] min-w-[220px] rounded-[16px] p-4 text-white shadow-[0_24px_50px_-18px_rgba(0,0,0,.75)] transition-colors duration-500', k >= 3 && 'on', fixed ? 'bg-[#14a06a]' : 'bg-[#f0644d]')}>
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[15px] font-semibold">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">{fixed ? <path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" strokeLinecap="round" /> : <><path d="M10 3 18 17H2L10 3z" /><path d="M10 8.5v3.5M10 14.6v.1" strokeLinecap="round" /></>}</svg>
          {fixed ? 'Unused access removed' : 'IAM role · ecs-notify-svc'}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-white/90">{fixed ? '205 permissions it never used are gone. Nothing it needs was touched.' : 'Can use 214 permissions. Used 9 in the last 90 days.'}</p>
        <span className={cx('mt-3 block rounded-[9px] bg-white px-3 py-2 text-center text-[13.5px] font-semibold transition-transform', fixed ? 'text-[#14a06a]' : 'text-[#d9442c]', k === 4 && 'scale-95')}>{fixed ? 'Evidence saved from CloudTrail' : 'Remove 205 unused permissions'}</span>
      </div>
    </figure>
  );
}

/* Product UI pictures. Everything inside .vz is sized in em, and .vz's font
   size follows its container's width, so a picture keeps its proportions from
   a phone to a 4K screen. Steps: the root carries k0..kN (cumulative); an
   element with .sN appears at step N. Server HTML carries every step. */
.vzw { container-type: inline-size; width: 100%; }
/* the smallest text in a picture: 10px, so labels stay readable on a phone */
.vz { --vz-min: 10px; }
.vz { --vz-red: #ffaaa1; --vz-coral: #ff8b7e; --vz-amber: #ffd28a; --vz-green: #7fe3b2; --vz-blue: #6fd4ff; --vz-solid: #10274a; --u: calc(100cqw / 52); font-size: max(10.5px, var(--u)); position: relative; color: #e4e6ea; line-height: 1.35; font-family: var(--font-sans); }

/* a node on the graph: a small card with a label on its top edge */
function Node({ x, y, w = 21, tag, tagTone = 'info', logo, title, sub, risk, alert, hot, ok, gone, show = true, children }) {
  return (
    <div className={cx('wb-node absolute', show && 'on', gone && 'gone')} style={{ left: `${x}%`, top: `${y}%`, width: `${w}%` }}>
      {tag && <span className={cx('vz-chip plain absolute -top-[1.05em] left-[.6em]', `c-${tagTone}`)} style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .62em)', height: '1.55em', borderRadius: '.35em' }}>{tag}</span>}
      <div className={cx('vz-panel relative flex items-center gap-[.5em] px-[.6em] py-[.55em] transition-colors duration-500', hot && 'wb-hot')} style={ok ? { borderColor: 'rgb(17 134 82 / .55)', background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--vz-solid) 92%, #1f9d63)' } : hot ? { borderColor: 'rgb(217 68 44 / .55)', background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--vz-solid) 93%, #d9442c)' } : { background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--vz-solid) 96%, #3f6ea8)' }}>
        {alert && <span className="absolute -left-[.55em] -top-[.55em] grid h-[1.2em] w-[1.2em] place-items-center rounded-full text-[max(var(--vz-min),.72em)] font-bold text-white" style={{ background: '#e5484d' }}>!</span>}
        {logo && <span className="grid h-[1.9em] w-[1.9em] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[.45em] bg-white" style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgb(16 40 80 / .1)' }}><Logo k={logo} size="1.2em" /></span>}
        <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
          <span className={cx('block truncate vz-t', gone && 'line-through')} style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .8em)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{title}</span>
          {sub && <span className="block truncate vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .66em)' }}>{sub}</span>}
          {risk && <span className="mt-[.25em] block"><Risk v={risk} /></span>}
          {children}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* elbow connectors between node centres, in % of the graph */
function Links({ links, t = 9, cut = [] }) {
  return (
    <svg className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full overflow-visible" viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      {links.map(([a, b, hot, at = 0], i) => {
        const mx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2;
        const d = `M${a[0]} ${a[1]}H${mx}V${b[1]}H${b[0]}`;
        const isCut = cut.includes(i);
        const live = t >= at;
        return (
          <g key={i} style={{ opacity: live ? 1 : 0, transition: 'opacity .5s' }}>
            <path d={d} fill="none" stroke={isCut ? 'rgb(120 140 170 / .5)' : hot ? '#e0604a' : 'rgb(120 140 170 / .55)'} strokeWidth={hot ? 1.8 : 1.2} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" strokeDasharray={isCut ? '4 4' : undefined} />
            {hot && !isCut && live && <path className="wb-flow" d={d} fill="none" stroke="#ff9d8a" strokeWidth="2.4" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" strokeDasharray="6 26" strokeLinecap="round" />}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}
/* where a link is cut: a red cross badge on the link */

    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width=".8em" height=".8em" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3l6 6M9 3l-6 6" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>

/* the same path for a narrow screen: one node under the other, each link
   marked hot or cut; items are [node props, link-below props] */
function Chain({ items, t, fix }) {
  return (
    <div className="wb-chain">
      {items.map(([n, l = {}], i) => (
        <div key={n.title}>
          <div className={cx('wb-row', (fix || t >= (n.at ?? i)) && 'on')}>
            <div className={cx('vz-panel relative flex items-center gap-[.6em] px-[.7em] py-[.55em] transition-colors duration-500', n.hot && 'wb-hot')} style={n.ok ? { borderColor: 'rgb(17 134 82 / .55)', background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--vz-solid) 92%, #1f9d63)' } : n.hot ? { borderColor: 'rgb(217 68 44 / .55)', background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--vz-solid) 93%, #d9442c)' } : { background: 'color-mix(in oklab, var(--vz-solid) 96%, #3f6ea8)' }}>
              <span className="grid h-[2em] w-[2em] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-[.45em] bg-white" style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgb(16 40 80 / .1)' }}>{n.logo ? <Logo k={n.logo} size="1.25em" /> : <span className="vz-t" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .8em)', fontWeight: 700, color: '#24456f' }}>{n.title.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>}</span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight">
                <span className={cx('block truncate vz-t', n.gone && 'line-through opacity-60')} style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{n.title}</span>
                {n.sub && <span className="block truncate vz-m">{n.sub}</span>}
              </span>
              {n.tag && <span className={cx('vz-chip plain shrink-0', `c-${n.tagTone || 'info'}`)} style={{ borderRadius: '.35em' }}>{n.tag}</span>}
            </div>

            <div className={cx('wb-link', l.cut ? 'cut' : l.hot && 'hot')} style={{ opacity: fix || t >= (items[i + 1][0].at ?? i + 1) ? 1 : 0 }}>

/* a counter that runs from one value to another once shown */
function Count({ from, to, run }) {
  const [v, setV] = useState(run ? to : from);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!run) { setV(from); return undefined; }
    let raf, t0;
    const step = (n) => { t0 ??= n; const k = Math.min(1, (n - t0) / 1100); setV(Math.round(from + (to - from) * (1 - (1 - k) ** 3))); if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [run, from, to]);
  return <span className="num">{v}</span>;
}

        <span><span className="block vz-t" style={{ fontWeight: 650 }}>Summary</span><span className="mt-[.2em] block vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .86em)' }}>{summary}</span></span>

'#11804f' : '#2f6fe4', borderColor: done ? 'rgb(17 134 82 / .4)' : 'rgb(47 111 228 / .55)', background: fixed ? 'rgb(47 111 228 / .1)' : 'transparent', transition: 'all .3s' }}>{done ? /* the shared frame: who, risk, tabs, view; the tabs turn on their own */
function Bench({ label, head, tabs, render, dwell = 5700 }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const tabRefs = useRef([]);
  const panel = useRef(null);
  const [cur, setCur] = useState(null); // the guide's pointer: where it is, and whether it is clicking
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.25 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(0);
  const [t, setT] = useState(9); // time within the tab, in steps; the server shows each view complete
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false);
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(false); // a phone, or a small card: the graph becomes a chain
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current; if (!el) return undefined;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setNarrow(e.contentRect.width < 600));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !seen || held) return undefined;
    setT(0);
    let n = 0;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      n += 1; setT(n);
      if (n * 300 >= dwell) { n = 0; setT(0); setTab((v) => (v + 1) % tabs.length); }
    }, 300);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [seen, reduce, held, tabs.length, dwell, tab]);
  const pick = (i) => { setHeld(true); setTab(i); setT(9); setCur(null); };
  // the pointer: it moves to what is about to be pressed, and presses it
  const D = Math.round(dwell / 300);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !seen || held || !ref.current) return;
    const box = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const at = (el, click) => {
      if (!el) return;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      setCur({ x: r.left + r.width * 0.55 - box.left, y: r.top + r.height * 0.6 - box.top, click });
    };
    const target = panel.current?.querySelector('[data-cursor-target]');
    if (t >= D - 4) at(tabRefs.current[(tab + 1) % tabs.length], t === D - 1);
    else if (target && t >= 4) at(target, t === 8);
    else if (t === 1) at(tabRefs.current[tab], false);
  }, [t, tab, seen, held, reduce]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return (
    <figure ref={ref} className="vzw" aria-label={label}>
      <div className="vz relative">
        <div className="vz-win">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-[.8em] px-[1.1em] pb-[.7em] pt-[1em]">
            <span className="grid h-[2.6em] w-[2.6em] place-items-center rounded-[.7em] bg-white" style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgb(16 40 80 / .1)' }}><Logo k={head.logo} size="1.6em" /></span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block vz-t" style={{ fontWeight: 650, fontSize: '1.05em' }}>{head.name}</span>
              <span className="mt-[.3em] flex flex-wrap gap-[.35em]">{(narrow ? head.chips.slice(0, 1) : head.chips).map((c) => <span key={c} className="vz-chip plain c-mute" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .7em)', borderRadius: '.4em' }}>{c}</span>)}</span>
            </span>
            <span className={cx('vz-chip plain', head.done && tab === tabs.length - 1 ? 'c-ok' : 'c-warn')} style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .72em)', borderRadius: '.4em' }}>{head.done && tab === tabs.length - 1 ? 'Resolved' : 'Pending review'}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-[1em] px-[1.1em] pb-[.8em]">
            <Risk v={head.done && tab === tabs.length - 1 ? 'Low' : head.risk} /><span className="flex items-center gap-[.5em] vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .74em)', letterSpacing: '.06em' }}>USAGE <Usage n={head.usage} /></span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-[.4em] px-[1.1em] pb-[.8em]" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${tabs.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }} role="tablist" aria-label="Views">
            {tabs.map((x, i) => (
              <button key={x} ref={(el) => { tabRefs.current[i] = el; }} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={i === tab} onClick={() => pick(i)}
                className="truncate rounded-[.5em] px-[.4em] py-[.5em] transition-colors" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .76em)', background: i === tab ? '#0b2a57' : 'rgb(120 140 170 / .12)', color: i === tab ? '#fff' : undefined }}>
                <span className={i === tab ? '' : 'vz-m'}>{x}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="mx-[.8em] mb-[.8em] rounded-[.8em] p-[.9em]" style={{ background: 'var(--vz-solid)', boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px rgb(120 140 170 / .18)' }}>
            <div key={tab} ref={panel} className="fadein">{render(tab, t, narrow)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        {cur && !held && (
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="wb-cursor pointer-events-none absolute z-10" style={{ left: cur.x, top: cur.y }}>
            {cur.click && <span className="wb-ripple absolute -left-[.9em] -top-[.9em] h-[1.8em] w-[1.8em] rounded-full" />}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 22" width="1.5em" height="1.65em"><path d="M2 2l15 7-6.2 2.1L8 18Z" fill="#e5484d" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </figure>
  );
}

/* the fix, as it happens: what it changes, the number it brings down, the
   steps ticking off; the graph above it shows the same change */
function Remedy({ label, from, to, t, start, items, children }) {
  const run = t >= start;
  const done = t >= start + items.length + 1;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-[.8em] flex items-center gap-[.8em] rounded-[.7em] px-[.9em] py-[.6em] transition-colors duration-500" style={{ background: done ? 'rgb(17 134 82 / .09)' : 'rgb(47 111 228 / .07)' }}>
        <span className={cx('grid h-[1.7em] w-[1.7em] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-white transition-colors duration-500', !done && run && 'wb-spin')} style={{ background: done ? '#1f9d63' : '#2f6fe4' }}>
          {done
            ? <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width=".8em" height=".8em" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m2.5 6.3 2.3 2.2L9.5 3.8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>
            : <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width=".8em" height=".8em" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 1.5a4.5 4.5 0 1 0 4.5 4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>}
        </span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight">
          <span className="block vz-t" style={{ fontWeight: 650, fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .92em)' }}>{done ? 'Remediated, and checked again' : 'Remediating, with approval'}</span>
          <span className="block vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .74em)' }}>{label}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="vz-t text-right" style={{ fontWeight: 750, fontSize: '1.45em', lineHeight: 1 }}>
          <span style={{ color: done ? '#11804f' : undefined }}><Count from={from} to={to} run={run} /></span>
          <span className="vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .5em)', fontWeight: 500 }}> / {from}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      {children}
      <div className="mt-[.8em] flex flex-wrap gap-[.45em]">
        {items.map((x, i) => {
          const on = t >= start + i + 1;
          return (
            <span key={x} className="inline-flex items-center gap-[.4em] rounded-full border px-[.6em] py-[.2em] transition-all duration-500" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .72em)', opacity: on ? 1 : 0.35, borderColor: on ? 'rgb(17 134 82 / .4)' : 'rgb(120 140 170 / .3)', background: on ? 'rgb(17 134 82 / .07)' : 'transparent' }}>
              <span className="grid h-[1.2em] w-[1.2em] place-items-center rounded-full text-white transition-colors duration-500" style={{ background: on ? '#1f9d63' : 'rgb(120 140 170 / .45)' }}><svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width=".7em" height=".7em" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m2.5 6.3 2.3 2.2L9.5 3.8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg></span>
              <span className="vz-t" style={{ fontWeight: 550 }}>{x}</span>
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
