import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useInView, useReducedMotion, cx } from '../../lib/motion.js';

/* "Someone has to decide first", the picture from the Zenstra AI site: three
   agents each send an action; every action stops at Zenstra's line before it
   reaches a system; one is blocked, one is held for a person, one is allowed;
   each decision lands on the record. Then it plays again. Illustrative. */

const ROWS = [
  { agent: 'support-agent', act: 'export all members', sys: 'Member records', verdict: 'BLOCKED', tone: '#ff8a7e', why: 'outside its task' },
  { agent: 'payments-agent', act: 'pay invoice', sys: 'Payments', verdict: 'HELD → APPROVED', tone: '#ffc56b', why: '₹18,40,000, approved by Ravi Shah' },
  { agent: 'code-agent', act: 'push commit', sys: 'Secrets store', verdict: 'ALLOWED', tone: '#6fe0a8', why: 'within its task' },
];
const LINE = 58; // where Zenstra stands, % across

export function ZenDecideFirst() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [k, setK] = useState(9); // the server and reduced motion show every decision made
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce || !seen) { setK(9); return undefined; }
    let i = 0, t;
    const next = () => { setK(i); t = setTimeout(() => { i = i >= 9 ? 0 : i + 1; next(); }, i >= 9 ? 3400 : 750); };
    next();
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [seen, reduce]);
  // row r: the action leaves at 3r, reaches the line at 3r+1, its verdict at 3r+2
  const at = (r) => (k >= r * 3 + 1 ? 'line' : k >= r * 3 ? 'go' : 'wait');
  const decided = (r) => k >= r * 3 + 2;
  return (
    <figure ref={ref} className="mono px-5 pb-6 pt-4 text-white xl:px-7" aria-label="Illustration: three AI agents act on their own. Each action stops at Zenstra before it reaches a system. The support agent's export of all members is blocked as outside its task; the payments agent's invoice is held and approved by Ravi Shah; the code agent's commit is allowed. Each decision is written to the record.">
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="relative" style={{ aspectRatio: '1.55 / 1' }}>
        {/* Zenstra's line */}
        <div className="absolute bottom-[4%] top-[2%] w-px" style={{ left: `${LINE}%`, background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgb(124 196 255 / .8) 12%, rgb(124 196 255 / .8) 88%, transparent)' }} />
        <span className="absolute -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10.5px] tracking-[.12em] text-[#8cc4ff]" style={{ left: `${LINE}%`, top: '-2%' }}>✦ ZENSTRA DECIDES FIRST</span>
        {ROWS.map((r, i) => {
          const y = 18 + i * 32;
          const where = at(i);
          const d = decided(i);
          const pass = d && r.verdict !== 'BLOCKED';
          const left = where === 'wait' ? 16 : where === 'go' ? 28 : pass ? LINE + 3 : LINE - 27;
          return (
            <div key={r.agent}>
              <div className="absolute flex -translate-y-1/2 flex-col items-center" style={{ left: '2%', top: `${y}%`, width: '15%' }}>
                <span className="grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-full border border-[#8cc4ff]/60 text-[#cfe6ff]">✦</span>
                <span className="mt-1 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10.5px] text-white/75">{r.agent}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="absolute h-px" style={{ left: '15%', right: '13%', top: `${y}%`, backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(124 196 255 / .35) 50%, transparent 0)', backgroundSize: '6px 1px' }} />
              <span className="absolute -translate-y-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] transition-all duration-700"
                style={{ left: `${left}%`, top: `${y}%`, opacity: where === 'wait' ? 0 : 1, background: '#0a1a3a', borderColor: d ? r.tone : 'rgb(255 255 255 / .7)', color: d ? r.tone : '#fff' }}>{r.act}</span>
              <span className="absolute grid h-3 w-3 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full border transition-colors duration-300" style={{ left: `${LINE}%`, top: `${y}%`, background: d ? r.tone : '#0a1a3a', borderColor: d ? r.tone : '#8cc4ff' }} />
              <span className={cx('absolute -translate-y-1/2 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[.06em] transition-opacity duration-300', d ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')} style={{ left: `${LINE + 2}%`, top: `${y - 9}%`, color: r.tone }}>{r.verdict}</span>
              <div className="absolute flex -translate-y-1/2 flex-col items-center" style={{ right: '0%', top: `${y}%`, width: '14%' }}>
                <span className="grid h-9 w-11 place-items-center rounded-[9px] border transition-colors duration-500" style={{ borderColor: d && r.verdict === 'BLOCKED' ? '#ff8a7e' : 'rgb(124 196 255 / .45)', background: '#0b1f45' }}>
                  <span className="block h-[2px] w-5 rounded bg-white/50 shadow-[0_5px_0_rgb(255_255_255/.5),0_-5px_0_rgb(255_255_255/.5)]" />
                </span>
                <span className="mt-1 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] text-white/70">{r.sys}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {/* the record */}
      <div className="mt-3 border-t border-white/15 pt-3 font-mono text-[11px]">
        <p className="mb-1.5 tracking-[.1em] text-white/55">DECISION RECORD</p>
        {ROWS.map((r, i) => (
          <p key={r.agent} className={cx('grid grid-cols-[1.1fr_1.4fr_1fr] items-center gap-3 py-0.5 transition-opacity duration-500', decided(i) ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')}>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white/90"><span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#8cc4ff]" />{r.agent}</span>
            <span className="truncate text-white/60">{r.why}</span>
            <span className="text-right font-semibold" style={{ color: r.tone }}>{r.verdict}</span>
          </p>
        ))}
      </div>
    </figure>
  );
}

/* Z6. The decision record, and why an auditor can trust it: every decision is
   chained to the one before, so when someone quietly edits a Block into an
   Allow, the chain breaks at exactly that line. */
const REC = [
  ['#48231', 'payments-agent', 'langgraph', 'payments.transfer', 'Hold', 'warn', 'a91f…3c', 'Ravi Shah approved'],
  ['#48232', 'invoice-agent', 'copilotstudio', 'salesforce.export', 'Block', 'crit', '7be0…d4', 'Outside its task'],
  ['#48233', 'support-triage', 'claude', 'jira.update_issue', 'Allow', 'ok', 'f02c…9a', 'Matches task'],
];
export function ZenRecord({ k: fk } = {}) {
  return (
    <Viz k={fk} steps={[500, 700, 700, 700, 1300, 1500]} hold={4600} label="Illustration: three agent decisions are written to a hash-chained record and verified.       {(k) => {
        const tampered = k >= 6;
        return (
          <Win title="Decision record · Q3" right={tampered ? <Chip tone="crit">Edit detected · #48232</Chip> : k >= 4 ? <Chip tone="ok">Chain verified · 3 of 3</Chip> : <Chip tone="mute">Writing…</Chip>} glow={tampered ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .4)' : 'rgb(120 135 255 / .45)'}>
            <div className="grid items-center gap-[.6em] px-[.2em] pl-[3em]" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '.7fr 1.6fr .75fr .9fr' }}>
              <span className="vz-h">Entry</span><span className="vz-h">Agent and call</span><span className="vz-h">Decision</span><span className="vz-h text-right">Hash</span>
            </div>
            <div className="relative mt-[.5em] space-y-[.7em]">
              {REC.map((r, i) => {
                const bad = tampered && i === 1, broken = tampered && i === 2;
                const ok = k >= 4 && !bad && !broken;
                return (
                  <div key={r[0]} className={cx(`s${i + 1}`, 'relative flex items-center gap-[.8em]')}>
                    {i > 0 && <span className="absolute left-[1.05em] w-px" style={{ top: '-.75em', height: '.8em', background: broken ? 'repeating-linear-gradient(#ff6b5d 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px)' : 'rgb(147 162 255 / .55)' }} />}
                    <span className="relative z-[1] inline-flex h-[2.1em] w-[2.1em] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full" style={{ background: 'var(--vz-solid)', border: `1px solid ${bad || broken ? 'check' : 'lock'} className="h-[1em] w-[1em]" /></span>
                    <span className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-[.6em] rounded-[.7em] px-[.8em] py-[.55em]" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '.7fr 1.6fr .75fr .9fr', background: bad ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .09)' : 'rgb(255 255 255 / .03)', border: `1px solid ${bad ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .4)' : 'rgb(160 190 230 / .09)'}` }}>
                      <span className="vz-mono">{r[0]}</span>
                      <span className="min-w-0"><span className="flex items-center gap-[.4em]"><Logo k={r[2]} size="1.05em" /><span className="truncate vz-t" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .92em)' }}>{r[1]}</span></span><span className="block truncate vz-mono" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .74em)', color: '#c9d6ff' }}>{r[3]}<span className="vz-wide">()</span></span></span>
                      <span>{bad ? <span className="flex flex-col items-start gap-[.2em]"><span className="vz-m line-through" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .72em)' }}>Block</span><Chip tone="ok">Allow</Chip></span> : <Chip tone={r[5]}>{r[4]}</Chip>}</span>
                      <span className="truncate text-right vz-mono" style={{ color: bad ? 'var(--vz-red)' : undefined }}>{bad ? '19c2…e0' : r[6]}</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="s4 mt-[1em] grid grid-cols-3 gap-[.5em] vz-m" style={{ fontSize: 'max(var(--vz-min), .8em)' }}>
              {['Agent and task', 'Policy version 14', 'Outcome and approver'].map((t) => <span key={t} className="rounded-[.6em] px-[.6em] py-[.45em] text-center" style={{ background: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .04)' }}>{t}</span>)}

              <span className="min-w-0"><span className="block vz-t">Evidence pack · Q3 agent activity</span><span className="block truncate vz-m">For SOC 2, ISO/IEC 42001 and DPDPA reviews</span></span><span className="flex shrink-0 gap-[.4em]"><Chip tone="zen" plain>PDF</Chip><Chip tone="zen" plain>CSV</Chip></span>

Most already have more telemetry than they can realistically process. The greater need is for better interpretation. Context has become more valuable than volume because context explains relationships, while raw events rarely do."}, {"type": "h2", "text": "The Next Identity Challenge Has Already Arrived"}, {"type": "p", "text": "The conversation around enterprise identity often focuses on what comes next. AI agents, autonomous workflows and machine identities are frequently described as future challenges, as though organizations still have time to prepare before these technologies become part of everyday operations."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Looking across today's enterprise, that future has largely arrived."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Most organizations already depend on automated processes that operate without direct human involvement. APIs exchange information between applications, cloud services synchronize customer data, service accounts execute privileged tasks, and intelligent assistants retrieve information on behalf of employees. None of these systems were introduced as security risks. They were introduced to remove friction from the business. Their success comes from being trusted enough to operate without constant interruption."}, {"type": "p", "text": "That shift changes the scale of identity management. Human users are no longer the only accounts interacting with sensitive information. Machine identities, automation platforms and AI-driven services now participate in business processes that once depended entirely on people. Many of these identities operate continuously, exchange large volumes of information and perform actions across multiple systems without generating behavior that appears unusual in isolation."}, {"type": "p", "text": "This is why the broader lesson from the Aflac Japan incident extends beyond one organization or one industry. The publicly available information does not suggest that digital transformation created the incident. It does, however, remind us that highly connected environments behave differently from the enterprise architectures security teams were protecting a decade ago. As organizations become more interconnected, understanding how trust moves between people, applications and automated systems becomes just as important as protecting each individual component."}, {"type": "p", "text": "The next phase of identity security is therefore unlikely to be defined by another authentication technology or another access policy. Most enterprises already have mature controls in those areas."}, {"type": "p", "text": "The greater opportunity lies in understanding how behavior changes after access has been granted, particularly in environments where business activity is increasingly distributed across cloud services, third-party platforms and automated workloads."}, {"type": "p", "text": "One conclusion continued to surface throughout this research."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Security teams are no longer protecting isolated systems. They are protecting relationships."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Those relationships now connect employees, customers, applications, automation platforms and AI systems in ways that were almost impossible to imagine only a few years ago. The stronger those connections become, the more valuable continuous visibility becomes not because trust has become less important, but because business depends on it more than ever."}, {"type": "p", "text": "The organizations that adapt successfully will not necessarily be those deploying the largest number of security products. They will be the ones that understand how trust moves across their digital estate, recognize when established patterns begin to change and respond before those changes become business incidents."}, {"type": "p", "text": "By the end of this review, the Aflac Japan breach no longer looked like a report about customer records."}, {"type": "p", "text": "It became a report about assumptions."}, {"type": "p", "text": "For years, enterprise security assumed that authentication represented the most important identity decision. That assumption made sense when business applications were largely independent and digital interactions were relatively limited. Today's operating environment is fundamentally different. Trust no longer remains inside one application, one platform or one business process. It travels with work itself."}, {"type": "p", "text": "That is why this incident deserves attention."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Not because it introduced a new attack technique."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Not because it affected millions of customers."}, {"type": "p", "text": "But because it reminds us that the way organizations evaluate trusted activity has not evolved as quickly as the environments in which that activity now operates."}, {"type": "p", "text": "The next chapter of enterprise identity security is unlikely to be written around stronger authentication alone."}, {"type": "p", "text": "It will be written around a better understanding of how trust changes after authentication have already succeeded."}, {"type": "p", "text": "At Deep Algorithms, this question sits at the center of our research."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Identity has become more than a login event. It represents an ongoing relationship between people, systems, applications and automated services operating across an increasingly connected digital environment. Understanding that relationship requires more than confirming who signed in. It requires continuously evaluating whether behavior, context and access patterns remain consistent with the purpose for which trust was originally established."}, {"type": "p", "text": "This thinking is reflected in our approach to Continuous Identity Risk Management (CIRM). Rather than viewing authentication as the final security decision, CIRM focuses on how risk evolves throughout the lifetime of an identity."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Behavioral intelligence, contextual analysis and continuous risk evaluation help security teams identify subtle changes that may never appear unusual when viewed as isolated events."}, {"type": "p", "text": "As enterprises continue expanding their use of cloud platforms, automation and AI-driven services, continuously understanding trust will become just as important as establishing it."}, {"type": "p", "text": "Because the next generation of identity security will not be defined by who logged in."}, {"type": "p", "text": "It will be defined by who still deserves to be trusted."}]

const MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];
export function formatDate(p) {
  const [y, m, d] = p.date.split('-').map(Number);
  return p.monthOnly ? `${MONTHS[m - 1]} ${y}` : `${d} ${MONTHS[m - 1].slice(0, 3)} ${y}`;
}

FILE: website/src/dev/film/Film.jsx
====================================================================================================
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import TIM from '../../../tools/film/timings.json';
import FOOTAGE from '../../../tools/film/footage.json';
import { ZenGateway } from '../../components/viz/zenstra.jsx';
import { AdapRiskTimeline } from '../../components/viz/adapid.jsx';
import { CtemLoop } from '../../components/viz/botshield.jsx';
import { IcmsEvidence } from '../../components/viz/icms.jsx';
import { ScamCatch } from '../../components/viz/fraud.jsx';
import ProductMark from '../../components/ProductMark.jsx';
import { CUSTOMERS, CERTS } from '../../data/site.js';

/* The product film. Live-action shots (tools/film/footage.json, graded and cut to
   frames by footage.py) carry the world and the threat; the site's own product
   pictures carry the answer. Every frame is a pure function of time `t` (seconds):
   tools/film/render.mjs sets t, waits for the frame's images and captures 1920x1080.

   Structure, after the enterprise brand films it is measured against: the stakes
   in the real world, the threat in one line, the brand, then four times over a
   worst case on screen in silence followed by the product stopping it, proof, call
   to action. Hard cuts on the words; type is large, left-aligned and few. */

export const W = 1920, H = 1080, FPS = 30;
const C = Object.fromEntries(TIM.lines.map((l) => [l.id, l]));
export const LENGTH = Math.ceil((TIM.duration + 0.1) * 10) / 10;
const FRAMES = Object.fromEntries(FOOTAGE.clips.map((c) => [c.id, Math.floor(c.dur * FPS) - 1]));

const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
const seg = (t, a, b) => clamp((t - a) / (b - a));
const ease = (x) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - x, 3);
const inout = (x) => (x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 3) / 2);
const lerp = (a, b, x) => a + (b - a) * x;
const wordAt = (line, i) => line.start + (i / line.text.split(' ').length) * (line.end - line.start) * 0.92;
const MONO = 'JetBrains Mono Variable, ui-monospace, monospace';

/* ---------- footage ---------- */

/* one shot: the frame for time t, with a slow camera move (scale and drift) */
function Shot({ id, t, a, b, kb = [1.02, 1.1], pan = [0, 0, 0, 0], blur = 0, dim = 0, speed = 1, offset = 0, origin = '50% 50%' }) {
  const n = FRAMES[id];
  const f = clamp(Math.floor((t - a) * FPS * speed) + 1 + offset, 1, n);
  const x = (t - a) / Math.max(0.01, b - a);
  const s = lerp(kb[0], kb[1], x);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, overflow: 'hidden', background: '#05070a' }}>
      <img src={`/clips/${id}/${String(f).padStart(4, '0')}.jpg`} alt="" style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', transformOrigin: origin, transform: `translate(${lerp(pan[0], pan[2], x)}px, ${lerp(pan[1], pan[3], x)}px) scale(${s + blur * 0.004})`, filter: blur ? `blur(${blur}px)` : undefined }} />
      {dim > 0 && <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: `rgb(4 6 9 / ${dim})` }} />}
    </div>
  );
}

/* film grain and lens falloff over everything, so stock from many cameras reads as one film */
function useGrain() {
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return [];
    let seed = 7;
    const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);
    return Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 384;
      const g = c.getContext('2d'), im = g.createImageData(384, 384);
      for (let i = 0; i < im.data.length; i += 4) { const v = 128 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 120; im.data[i] = im.data[i + 1] = im.data[i + 2] = v; im.data[i + 3] = 255; }
      g.putImageData(im, 0, 0);
      return c.toDataURL('image/png');
    });
  }, []);
}
function Finish({ t }) {
  const grain = useGrain();
  const g = grain[Math.floor(t * FPS) % (grain.length || 1)];
  return (
    <>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'radial-gradient(120% 95% at 50% 45%, transparent 60%, rgb(0 0 0 / .38) 100%)' }} />
      {g && <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, backgroundImage: `url(${g})`, backgroundSize: '384px 384px', mixBlendMode: 'overlay', opacity: 0.11 }} />}
    </>
  );
}

/* ---------- type ---------- */

/* words light up as they are spoken */
function Spoken({ line, t, size = 84, color = '#fff', dim = 0.22, width = 1400, align = 'left', weight = 600, words: override, part = [0, 1], style }) {
  const words = (override || line.text).split(' ');
  const span = (line.end - line.start) * (part[1] - part[0]);
  const t0 = line.start + (line.end - line.start) * part[0];
  return (
    <p style={{ fontSize: size, fontWeight: weight, letterSpacing: '-0.045em', lineHeight: 1.04, maxWidth: width, textAlign: align, color, margin: align === 'center' ? '0 auto' : 0, textShadow: '0 4px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / .45)', ...style }}>
      {words.map((w, i) => {
        const at = t0 + (i / words.length) * span * 0.92;
        const on = ease(seg(t, at - 0.05, at + 0.25));
        return <span key={i} style={{ opacity: dim + (1 - dim) * on, filter: `blur(${(1 - on) * 3}px)` }}>{w}{i < words.length - 1 ? ' ' : ''}</span>;
      })}
    </p>
  );
}

/* bottom-left scrim so type always sits on dark, whatever the shot */
const Scrim = ({ side = 'bl', o = 0.72 }) => (
  <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: side === 'bl'
    ? `linear-gradient(20deg, rgb(3 5 8 / ${o}) 0%, rgb(3 5 8 / ${o * 0.55}) 35%, transparent 65%)`
    : side === 'l' ? `linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(3 5 8 / ${o}) 0%, rgb(3 5 8 / ${o * 0.5}) 40%, transparent 70%)`
    : `linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(3 5 8 / ${o}) 0%, transparent 45%)` }} />
);

/* a machine identity named on screen: a glass tag pinned into the shot */
function Tag({ t, at, x, y, kind, name, color }) {
  const e = ease(seg(t, at, at + 0.45));
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: x, top: y, opacity: e, transform: `translateY(${(1 - e) * 16}px)` }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16, padding: '16px 24px 16px 18px', borderRadius: 18, background: 'rgb(10 14 20 / .62)', border: `1px solid ${color}55`, backdropFilter: 'blur(14px)', boxShadow: `0 0 60px -20px ${color}` }}>
        <span style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 14, background: color, boxShadow: `0 0 18px ${color}` }} />
        <span>
          <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 19, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '.12em', textTransform: 'uppercase', color }}>{kind}</span>
          <span style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 4, fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 27, color: '#f2f4f7' }}>{name}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 25, top: '100%', width: 1, height: 90 * e, background: `linear-gradient(${color}, transparent)` }} />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- the four worst cases, in silence ---------- */

/* a worst case: the shot, a live clock and one line; red edge light, nothing else */
function Incident({ t, a, b, clip, kb, pan, clock, where, line, sub, counter, ch }) {
  const e = ease(seg(t, a + 0.1, a + 0.5));
  const blink = Math.floor(t * 2.4) % 2 === 0;
  const k = seg(t, a + 0.15, b - 0.2);
  return (
    <>
      <Shot id={clip} t={t} a={a} b={b} kb={kb} pan={pan} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: 'linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(3 5 8 / .82) 0%, rgb(3 5 8 / .12) 50%, rgb(3 5 8 / .3) 100%)' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, boxShadow: `inset 0 0 ${180 + 60 * Math.sin(t * 7)}px rgb(255 60 50 / ${0.22 * e})` }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 120, top: 96, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 18, opacity: e, fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: '.06em', color: '#ffb3ab' }}>
        <span style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 14, background: '#ff4d40', opacity: blink ? 1 : 0.25, boxShadow: '0 0 20px #ff4d40' }} />
        <span style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{clock}</span><span style={{ opacity: 0.7 }}>· {where}</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 120, bottom: 120, width: 1640, opacity: e, transform: `translateY(${(1 - e) * 24}px)` }}>
        {counter && <p style={{ fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 132, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '-0.04em', color: '#ff6b5d', lineHeight: 1, marginBottom: 18, textShadow: '0 0 60px rgb(255 80 60 / .45)' }}>{counter(k)}</p>}
        <p style={{ fontSize: 78, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '-0.045em', lineHeight: 1.05, color: '#fff' }}>{line}</p>
        {sub && <p style={{ marginTop: 18, fontSize: 32, color: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .62)', letterSpacing: '-0.01em' }}>{sub}</p>}
      </div>
      {ch && <Chapter t={t} a={a} {...ch} />}
    </>
  );
}

/* where we are in the night: attack n of 5, and the surface it hits */
function Chapter({ t, a, n, what, acc = '#ff8b7e', side = 'r' }) {
  const e = ease(seg(t, a + 0.1, a + 0.5));
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', zIndex: 4, ...(side === 'r' ? { right: 120 } : { left: 110 }), top: 88, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, opacity: e, padding: '12px 20px', borderRadius: 99, background: 'rgb(8 11 16 / .55)', border: '1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .14)', backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)' }}>
      <span style={{ fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 22, color: '#fff' }}>{String(n).padStart(2, '0')}<span style={{ color: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .4)' }}> / 05</span></span>
      <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 5 }}>{[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => <i key={i} style={{ width: 20, height: 4, borderRadius: 4, background: i <= n ? acc : 'rgb(255 255 255 / .18)' }} />)}</span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 21, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '.08em', textTransform: 'uppercase', color: acc }}>{what}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- the products ---------- */

function Stage({ lt, d, children, from = [6, -6, -90], to = [2, -2, 0], width = 1440 }) {
  const x = inout(seg(lt, 0, d));
  return (
    <div style={{ perspective: 2600, perspectiveOrigin: '50% 40%' }}>
      <div style={{ width, transformStyle: 'preserve-3d', transform: `translateZ(${lerp(from[2], to[2], x)}px) rotateX(${lerp(from[0], to[0], x)}deg) rotateY(${lerp(from[1], to[1], x)}deg)` }}>{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
const stepAt = (t, steps) => steps.filter((s) => t >= s).length;

function Pop({ t, at, style, children }) {
  const x = ease(seg(t, at, at + 0.6));
  return <div style={{ position: 'absolute', transform: `translateZ(${110 * x}px) translateY(${(1 - x) * 30}px) scale(${0.9 + 0.1 * x})`, opacity: x, ...style }}>{children}</div>;
}
const Verdict = ({ tone = 'bad', head, body, sub }) => (
  <div className="vz-pop" style={{ padding: '20px 26px', '--glow': tone === 'bad' ? 'rgb(255 107 93 / .55)' : 'rgb(63 217 143 / .5)' }}>
    <p style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.1em', color: tone === 'bad' ? '#ff7d70' : '#3fd98f' }}>{head}</p>
    <p style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 23, fontWeight: 600 }}>{body}</p>
    {sub && <p style={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#9ea0a4' }}>{sub}</p>}
  </div>
);

/* frosted glass: the one surface every caption sits on */
const glass = (acc) => ({ background: 'rgb(9 12 18 / .72)', border: '1px solid rgb(190 210 240 / .16)', backdropFilter: 'blur(22px) saturate(1.2)', boxShadow: `0 40px 90px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / .85), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .06)${acc ? `, 0 0 80px -40px ${acc}` : ''}` });

/* a product answering its worst case. The product is the hero: large, centred, true to
   the real app. The world sits behind it, out of focus. The name, the promise and the
   result float on glass beside it, never inside it. */
function Product({ t, a, b, bg, bgOffset = 0, acc, mark, name, role, head, steps, Pic, pic, pop, focus, outcome, ch, width = 1440, top = 152 }) {
  const lt = t - a, d = b - a;
  const e = ease(seg(t, a + 0.15, a + 0.75));
  const u = ease(seg(t, a, a + 0.7));
  return (
    <>
      <Shot id={bg} t={t} a={a} b={b} kb={[1.12, 1.18]} blur={14} dim={0.38} offset={bgOffset} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, background: `radial-gradient(70% 70% at 50% 45%, ${acc}26, transparent 72%)` }} />
      <div className="film-light" style={{ position: 'absolute', left: (W - width) / 2, top, opacity: u, transform: `translateY(${(1 - u) * 60}px)` }}>
        <Stage lt={lt} d={d} width={width}>
          <Focus t={t} b={b} f={focus} acc={acc}>
            <Pic k={stepAt(t, steps)} {...pic} />
            {pop && <Pop t={t} at={pop.at} style={pop.style}>{pop.el}</Pop>}
          </Focus>
        </Stage>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', zIndex: 3, left: 90, top: 56, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16, padding: '12px 22px 12px 12px', borderRadius: 22, opacity: e, ...glass(acc) }}>
        <span style={{ width: 58, height: 58, borderRadius: 16, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', background: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .08)' }}><ProductMark p={mark} size={44} loading="eager" /></span>
        <span><span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: 27, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '-0.02em' }}>{name}</span><span style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 2, fontSize: 18, color: '#b9bcc2' }}>{role}</span></span>
      </div>
      {ch && <Chapter t={t} a={a} acc={acc} {...ch} />}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', zIndex: 3, left: 90, bottom: 52, maxWidth: 900, padding: '24px 34px', borderRadius: 28, opacity: e, transform: `translateY(${(1 - e) * 30}px)`, ...glass(acc) }}>
        <h2 style={{ fontSize: 50, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '-0.04em', lineHeight: 1.06 }}>{head}</h2>
      </div>
      {outcome && <Outcome t={t} acc={acc} {...outcome} />}
    </>
  );
}

/* the camera leans into the one row that matters and the rest of the screen dims.
   f = { at, x, y, s, ring: [left, top, width, height] in % of the picture, measured from the DOM } */
function Focus({ t, b, f, acc, children }) {
  const z = f ? inout(seg(t, f.at, f.at + 0.9)) * (1 - inout(seg(t, b - 0.55, b))) : 0;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'relative', transformOrigin: f ? `${f.x}% ${f.y}%` : undefined, transform: `scale(${1 + ((f?.s || 1) - 1) * z})` }}>
      {children}
      {f && z > 0 && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: `${f.ring[0]}%`, top: `${f.ring[1]}%`, width: `${f.ring[2]}%`, height: `${f.ring[3]}%`, borderRadius: 14, border: `2.5px solid ${acc}`, boxShadow: `0 0 0 4000px rgb(4 6 10 / ${0.55 * z}), 0 0 40px ${acc}`, opacity: z, pointerEvents: 'none' }} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* the result, as one number, on glass, bottom right */
function Outcome({ t, at, value, label, acc }) {
  const e = ease(seg(t, at, at + 0.6));
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', zIndex: 3, right: 90, bottom: 52, width: 500, padding: '22px 30px', borderRadius: 28, opacity: e, transform: `translateY(${(1 - e) * 30}px) scale(${0.96 + 0.04 * e})`, ...glass(acc), border: `1px solid ${acc}66` }}>
      <p style={{ fontSize: 80, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '-0.05em', lineHeight: 1, color: acc, textShadow: `0 0 50px ${acc}55` }}>{value}</p>
      <p style={{ marginTop: 10, fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 1.3, color: 'rgb(255 255 255 / .82)' }}>{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* cold open: one bank, one night, everything green. The story the four attacks happen in. */
function ColdOpen({ t, b }) {
  const e = ease(seg(t, 0.5, 1.1)), e2 = ease(seg(t, 1.1, 1.7)), e3 = ease(seg(t, 2.0, 2.4));
  const out = 1 - seg(t, b - 0.25, b);
  const sec = Math.floor(t);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, opacity: out }}>
      <Shot id="nightroad" t={t} a={0} b={b} kb={[1.18, 1.1]} offset={260} />
      <Scrim o={0.6} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 120, bottom: 130 }}>
        <p style={{ fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 30, letterSpacing: '.06em', color: '#cfe9ff', opacity: e }}>21:38:{String(40 + sec * 7).padStart(2, '0')} IST · MUMBAI</p>
        <p style={{ marginTop: 18, fontSize: 92, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: '-0.045em', lineHeight: 1.03, opacity: e, transform: `translateY(${(1 - e) * 20}px)` }}>A private bank, tonight.</p>
        <div style={{ marginTop: 26, display: 'flex', gap: 14, opacity: e2 }}>
          {['Payments', 'Mobile banking', 'Login API', 'Customer data'].map((s) => (
            <span key={s} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '10px 18px', borderRadius: 99, background: 'rgb(8 12 18 / .55)', border: '1px solid rgb(63 217 143 / .35)', fontSize: 22, color: '#d9f7e8' }}><i style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: 10, background: '#3fd98f', boxShadow: '0 0 12px #3fd98f' }} />{s}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p style={{ marginTop: 30, fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: 28, letterSpacing: '.04em', color: '#ff8b7e', opacity: e3, transform: `translateX(${(1 - e3) * -16}px)` }}>● Before morning, five attacks will begin.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* window.__film(t): render the frame at t seconds, wait for its footage frames and
   settle CSS animations to the same clock. */
const root = createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
const born = new WeakMap();
window.__LENGTH = LENGTH; window.__FPS = FPS;
window.__film = async (t) => {
  flushSync(() => root.render(<Film t={t} />));
  await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => r()));
  for (const a of document.getAnimations()) {
    if (!born.has(a)) born.set(a, t);
    a.pause();
    a.currentTime = Math.max(0, (t - born.get(a)) * 1000);
  }
  await document.fonts.ready;
  await Promise.all([...document.images].map((im) => (im.complete && im.naturalWidth ? null : im.decode().catch(() => null))));
  return true;
};

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import { SITE } from '../data/site.js';

/* Per-page <head>. During prerender values go into a context object that
   scripts/prerender.mjs writes into the HTML; in the browser they update
   document.head on navigation. */
export const HeadContext = createContext(null);

const ORG = {
  '@type': 'Organization', '@id': `${SITE.url}/#org`, name: SITE.name, legalName: SITE.legalName, url: SITE.url,
  logo: `${SITE.url}/icon-512.png`, foundingDate: String(SITE.founded), email: SITE.email, telephone: SITE.phone,
  sameAs: [SITE.linkedin],
  address: { '@type': 'PostalAddress', streetAddress: 'Shanta Sriram Tech Park, Gachibowli', addressLocality: 'Hyderabad', addressRegion: 'Telangana', postalCode: '500032', addressCountry: 'IN' },
};

export function buildHead({ title, description, path = '/', image, type = 'website', schema = [], crumbs, noindex }) {
  const fullTitle = title ? `${title} | ${SITE.name}` : `${SITE.name} | Identity Security for the AI Era`;
  const desc = description || SITE.description;
  const url = SITE.url + path;
  const graph = [ORG, ...schema];
  if (crumbs?.length) {
    graph.push({
      '@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
      itemListElement: [{ name: 'Home', path: '/' }, ...crumbs].map((c, i) => ({ '@type': 'ListItem', position: i + 1, name: c.name, item: SITE.url + c.path })),
    });
  }
  return { fullTitle, desc, url, img: SITE.url + (image || '/og/default.png'), type, noindex, jsonLd: { '@context': 'https://schema.org', '@graph': graph } };
}

const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;');

export function headToHtml(h) {
  return [
    `<title>${esc(h.fullTitle)}</title>`,
    `<meta name="description" content="${esc(h.desc)}" />`,
    h.noindex ? '<meta name="robots" content="noindex" />' : '<meta name="robots" content="index, follow" />',
    `<link rel="canonical" href="${esc(h.url)}" />`,
    `<meta property="og:type" content="${h.type}" />`,
    `<meta property="og:site_name" content="${SITE.name}" />`,
    `<meta property="og:title" content="${esc(h.fullTitle)}" />`,
    `<meta property="og:description" content="${esc(h.desc)}" />`,
    `<meta property="og:url" content="${esc(h.url)}" />`,
    `<meta property="og:image" content="${esc(h.img)}" />`,
    '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" />',
    '<meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />',
    '<meta property="og:locale" content="en_IN" />',
    '<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />',
    `<meta name="twitter:title" content="${esc(h.fullTitle)}" />`,
    `<meta name="twitter:description" content="${esc(h.desc)}" />`,
    `<meta name="twitter:image" content="${esc(h.img)}" />`,
    `<script type="application/ld+json">${JSON.stringify(h.jsonLd).replace(/</g, '\\u003c')}</script>`,
  ].filter(Boolean).join('\n    ');
}

function setMeta(attr, key, value) {
  let el = document.head.querySelector(`meta[${attr}="${key}"]`);
  if (!el) { el = document.createElement('meta'); el.setAttribute(attr, key); document.head.appendChild(el); }
  el.setAttribute('content', value);
}

export function Seo(props) {
  const ctx = useContext(HeadContext);
  const h = buildHead(props);
  if (ctx && typeof window === 'undefined') Object.assign(ctx, h);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = h.fullTitle;
    setMeta('name', 'description', h.desc);
    setMeta('name', 'robots', h.noindex ? 'noindex' : 'index, follow');
    for (const [k, v] of [['og:title', h.fullTitle], ['og:description', h.desc], ['og:url', h.url], ['og:image', h.img], ['og:type', h.type]]) setMeta('property', k, v);
    setMeta('name', 'twitter:title', h.fullTitle);
    setMeta('name', 'twitter:description', h.desc);
    let link = document.head.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]');
    if (!link) { link = document.createElement('link'); link.rel = 'canonical'; document.head.appendChild(link); }
    link.href = h.url;
    let ld = document.head.querySelector('script[type="application/ld+json"]');
    if (!ld) { ld = document.createElement('script'); ld.type = 'application/ld+json'; document.head.appendChild(ld); }
    ld.textContent = JSON.stringify(h.jsonLd);
  }, [h.fullTitle, h.desc, h.url]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return null;
}

FILE: website/src/lib/motion.js

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const cx = (...a) => a.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
export const useIsoLayoutEffect = typeof window === 'undefined' ? useEffect : useLayoutEffect;

export function useReducedMotion() {
  const [r, setR] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const m = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const on = () => setR(m.matches);
    on();
    m.addEventListener('change', on);
    return () => m.removeEventListener('change', on);
  }, []);
  return r;
}

export function useInView(ref, { margin = '0px', threshold = 0.2, once = false } = {}) {
  const [v, setV] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return undefined;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
      setV(e.isIntersecting);
      if (once && e.isIntersecting) io.disconnect();
    }, { rootMargin: margin, threshold });
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, [ref, margin, threshold, once]);
  return v;
}

/* Plays a picture as a sequence of steps while it is on screen.
   The prerendered HTML (and reduced motion) shows the last step, so nothing
   is hidden without JavaScript. When the picture enters the view it rewinds
   to step 0 and advances through `durations` (ms per step), then holds the
   last step for `hold` ms and starts again if `loop` is set. */
export function useSteps(ref, durations, { loop = true, hold = 2600, speed = 1 } = {}) {
  const last = durations.length;
  const [k, setK] = useState(last);
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const inView = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const started = useRef(false);
  // callers pass the durations inline; key on their values so a parent re-render never restarts a step
  const times = durations.join(',');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce) { setK(last); return undefined; }
    if (!inView) { started.current = false; return undefined; }
    if (!started.current) {
      started.current = true;
      // rewind; if already at step 0 (the picture left and came straight back), carry on from here,
      // since setting the same step would not re-render and the sequence would never start again
      if (k !== 0) { setK(0); return undefined; }
    }
    if (k < last) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => setK((n) => n + 1), +times.split(',')[k] / speed);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
    if (!loop) return undefined;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setK(0), hold);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [k, inView, reduce, last, loop, hold, speed, times]);
  return k;
}

/* Gentle pointer tilt for a 3D stage (desktop pointers only). Writes --rx/--ry. */
export function useTilt(ref, { base = [6, -14], range = [5, 7] } = {}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return undefined;
    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const set = (x, y) => { el.style.setProperty('--rx', `${(base[0] - y * range[0]).toFixed(2)}deg`); el.style.setProperty('--ry', `${(base[1] + x * range[1]).toFixed(2)}deg`); };
    set(0, 0);
    if (!fine || reduce) return undefined;
    let raf = 0;
    const move = (e) => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        set(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * 2)), Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5) * 2)));
      });
    };
    const leave = () => set(0, 0);
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);
    return () => { el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move); el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, [ref, base[0], base[1], range[0], range[1]]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
}

/* Scroll progress (0 to 1) of a tall element through the viewport, for pinned scenes. */
export function useScrollProgress(ref) {
  const [p, setP] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return undefined;
    let raf = 0;
    const on = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const total = r.height - window.innerHeight;
        setP(total > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, -r.top / total)) : 0);
      });
    };
    on();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', on, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', on);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('scroll', on); window.removeEventListener('resize', on); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); };
  }, [ref]);
  return p;
}

export const clamp01 = (v) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v));
/* maps p from [a, b] to [0, 1] */
export const seg = (p, a, b) => clamp01((p - a) / (b - a));
export const ease = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
export const easeInOut = (t) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2);
export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

/* The language menu. English is the source; any other choice is translated in
   the browser by Google's page translator, which reads the `googtrans` cookie.
   Nothing loads from Google until a visitor picks a language, and the choice
   is kept for the next page and the next visit. */

export const LANGS = [
  ['en', 'English', 'English'],
  ['es', 'Español', 'Spanish'],
  ['fr', 'Français', 'French'],
  ['de', 'Deutsch', 'German'],
  ['pt', 'Português', 'Portuguese'],
  ['ja', '日本語', 'Japanese'],
  ['zh-CN', '简体中文', 'Chinese (Simplified)'],
];

export function getLang() {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return 'en';
  const m = /(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=\/en\/([a-zA-Z-]+)/.exec(document.cookie);
  return m && LANGS.some(([c]) => c === m[1]) ? m[1] : 'en';
}

function writeCookie(value, maxAge) {
  const base = `googtrans=${value}; path=/; max-age=${maxAge}; SameSite=Lax`;
  document.cookie = base;
  // the translator may also have set it on the parent domain
  const host = location.hostname;
  if (host.includes('.') && !/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(host)) document.cookie = `${base}; domain=.${host.split('.').slice(-2).join('.')}`;
}

export function setLang(code) {
  if (code === getLang()) return;
  if (code === 'en') writeCookie('', 0);
  else writeCookie(`/en/${code}`, 60 * 60 * 24 * 365);
  location.reload();
}

/* React and the translator both edit the same text nodes. When the translator
   has replaced a node React later removes, the browser would throw; these two
   guards make that a no-op, as React's own maintainers suggest. Installed only
   while a translation is on. */
function guardDom() {
  const remove = Node.prototype.removeChild;
  Node.prototype.removeChild = function guardedRemove(child) {
    if (child.parentNode !== this) return child;
    return remove.call(this, child);
  };
  const insert = Node.prototype.insertBefore;
  Node.prototype.insertBefore = function guardedInsert(node, ref) {
    if (ref && ref.parentNode !== this) return node;
    return insert.call(this, node, ref);
  };
}

export function bootTranslate() {
  const lang = getLang();
  if (lang === 'en' || window.__gtBooted) return;
  window.__gtBooted = true;
  guardDom();
  document.documentElement.classList.add('is-translated');
  const host = document.createElement('div');
  host.id = 'gt-host';
  host.hidden = true;
  document.body.appendChild(host);
  window.__gtInit = () => {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-new
    new window.google.translate.TranslateElement({ pageLanguage: 'en', includedLanguages: LANGS.map(([c]) => c).join(','), autoDisplay: false }, 'gt-host');
  };
  const s = document.createElement('script');
  s.src = 'https://translate.google.com/translate_a/element.js?cb=__gtInit';
  s.async = true;
  document.head.appendChild(s);
}

function Body({ slug, post, onToc }) {

  const midIdx = midH2 ? blocks.indexOf(midH2) : blocks.findIndex((b, i) => i >= Math.floor(blocks.length * 0.5) && b.type === 'p');

  // a short "Key takeaways / Key findings" section becomes a summary card
  const kt = blocks.findIndex((b) => b.type === 'h2' && /^key (takeaways|findings)$/i.test(b.text));
  let ktEnd = kt;
  while (kt >= 0 && blocks[ktEnd + 1] && blocks[ktEnd + 1].type !== 'h2') ktEnd += 1;
  const summary = kt >= 0 && ktEnd - kt >= 2 && ktEnd - kt <= 10 && blocks.slice(kt + 1, ktEnd + 1).every((b) => b.type === 'p');
  const h = hueOf(post.category);

  const out = blocks.map((b, i) => {
    if (summary && i > kt && i <= ktEnd) return null;
    if (summary && i === kt) {
      return (
        <section key={i} id={slugify(b.text)} data-sec className="scroll-mt-28 rounded-[22px] border border-line p-7 md:p-9" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(${h} 80% 50% / .08), color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fg) 2%, transparent))` }}>
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[22px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em] md:text-[26px]"><Icon name="ListChecks" size={24} style={{ color: `hsl(${h} 100% var(--hl))` }} />{b.text}</h2>
          <ul className="mt-6 space-y-4">
            {blocks.slice(kt + 1, ktEnd + 1).map((x, k) => (
              <li key={k} className="flex gap-4 text-[17px] leading-[1.65] text-ink">
                <span className="mt-[2px] inline-flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[12px] font-bold text-on-acc num" style={{ background: `hsl(${h} 100% var(--hl))` }}>{k + 1}</span>{x.text}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      );
    }
    const prev = blocks[i - 1];
    const card = i === midIdx ? <ProductCallout key={`c${i}`} post={post} /> : null;
    let el;
    if (b.type === 'h2') {
      el = <h2 key={i} id={slugify(b.text)} data-sec className="group scroll-mt-28 pt-8 text-[27px] font-semibold leading-[1.18] tracking-[-0.028em] text-ink md:text-[33px]">{b.text}<HeadingLink id={slugify(b.text)} /></h2>;
    } else if (b.type === 'h3') {
      el = <h3 key={i} className="pt-2 text-[21px] font-semibold leading-snug tracking-[-0.018em] text-ink">{b.text}</h3>;
    } else if (i === 0 && b.type === 'p') {
      el = <p key={i} className="text-[21px] leading-[1.65] text-ink md:text-[23px]">{b.text}</p>;
    } else if (isPunch(b, prev)) {
      el = <p key={i} className="my-1 text-[23px] font-semibold leading-snug tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink md:text-[26px]">{b.text}</p>;
    } else if (b.type === 'quote') {
      el = (
        <figure key={i} className="my-8 border-l-[3px] pl-6 md:pl-8" style={{ borderColor: `hsl(${h} 100% var(--hl))` }}>
          <blockquote className="text-[23px] font-medium leading-[1.45] tracking-[-0.018em] text-ink md:text-[28px]">{b.text}</blockquote>
        </figure>
      );
    } else if (b.type === 'p') {
      el = <p key={i} className="text-[18.5px] leading-[1.8] text-ink-2">{b.text}</p>;
    } else if (b.type === 'list') {
      el = <ul key={i} className="space-y-3">{b.items.map((t, k) => <li key={k} className="flex gap-3 text-[18px] leading-[1.7] text-ink-2"><span className="mt-[12px] h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: `hsl(${h} 100% var(--hl))` }} />{t}</li>)}</ul>;
    } else {
      el = <Prose key={i} blocks={[b]} />;
    }
    return card ? [card, el] : el;
  });
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">{out}</div>;
}

function Toc({ toc }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    const els = toc.map((t) => document.getElementById(t.id)).filter(Boolean);
    if (!els.length) return undefined;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((es) => es.forEach((e) => { if (e.isIntersecting) setActive(e.target.id); }), { rootMargin: '-20% 0px -70% 0px' });
    els.forEach((e) => io.observe(e));
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, [toc]);
  if (toc.length < 3) return null;
  return (
    <nav aria-label="On this page">
      <p className="flex items-center justify-between text-[12.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.1em] text-ink-3">In this report<ReadPct /></p>
      <ul className="mt-4 space-y-0.5 border-l border-line text-[14px]">
        {toc.map((t) => {
          const on = active === t.id;
          return <li key={t.id}><a href={`#${t.id}`} aria-current={on ? 'true' : undefined} className={cx('-ml-px block border-l-2 py-1.5 pl-4 leading-snug transition-colors', on ? 'border-cyan font-medium text-ink' : 'border-transparent text-ink-3 hover:text-ink')}>{t.text}</a></li>;
        })}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}

function Share({ post, path }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const url = SITE.url + path;
  const copy = () => { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).then(() => { setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000); }).catch(() => {}); };
  const btn = 'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-line-2 px-4 text-[14px] text-ink-2 transition-colors hover:border-fg/30 hover:text-ink';
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button type="button" onClick={copy} className={btn}><Icon name="LinkSimple" size={16} />{copied ? 'Link copied' : 'Copy link'}</button>
      <a href={`https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className={btn}><Icon name="LinkedinLogo" size={16} />LinkedIn</a>
      <a href={`mailto:?subject=${encodeURIComponent(post.title)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`} className={btn}><Icon name="EnvelopeSimple" size={16} />Email</a>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Article() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const post = POSTS.find((p) => p.slug === slug);

  const path = `/blogs/${slug}`;
  const idx = POSTS.indexOf(post);
  const newer = POSTS[idx - 1], older = POSTS[idx + 1];
  const related = POSTS.filter((p) => p.slug !== slug && p.category === post.category).concat(POSTS.filter((p) => p.slug !== slug && p.category !== post.category)).slice(0, 3);
  const h = hueOf(post.category);
  const schema = [{
    '@type': 'BlogPosting', headline: post.title, description: post.excerpt, datePublished: post.date, url: SITE.url + path,
    image: `${SITE.url}/og/default.png`, articleSection: post.category,
    author: post.author ? { '@type': 'Person', name: post.author } : { '@type': 'Organization', name: authorOf(post) },
    publisher: { '@id': `${SITE.url}/#org` },
  }];

  return (
    <>
      <Seo title={post.title} description={post.excerpt} path={path} type="article" schema={schema} crumbs={[{ name: 'Blogs', path: '/blogs' }, { name: post.title, path }]} />

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { TOPIC } from '../components/Cover.jsx';
import FlowRibbons from '../components/FlowRibbons.jsx';
import { topicSlug } from '../components/Header.jsx';

const TOPICS = [...new Set(POSTS.map((p) => p.category))];
const PRODUCTS = [...new Set(POSTS.map((p) => p.product.name.split(' ')[0]))];
const hueOf = (c) => `hsl(${(TOPIC[c] || { hue: 200 }).hue} 100% var(--hl))`;

export default function Blog() {
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const topic = params.get('topic') || '';
  const product = params.get('product') || '';
  const q = params.get('q') || '';
  const set = (k, v) => { const n = new URLSearchParams(params); if (v) n.set(k, v); else n.delete(k); setParams(n, { replace: true, preventScrollReset: true }); };

  const list = useMemo(() => POSTS.filter((p) => (!topic || topicSlug(p.category) === topic)
    && (!product || p.product.name.startsWith(product))
    && (!q || `${p.title} ${p.excerpt} ${p.category}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))), [topic, product, q]);
  const filtering = topic || product || q;

  return (
    <>
      <Seo title="Blogs: Identity, AI Agent, Fraud and Bot Security" path="/blogs" description="Field notes and analysis from Deep Algorithms on identity attacks, AI agent security, financial crime, bot defence, DDoS and DPDPA compliance." crumbs={[{ name: 'Research', path: '/blogs' }]} />

      <section className="stage band-brand hero-under relative overflow-hidden">
        <FlowRibbons preset="band" intensity={0.55} />

              <h1 className="t-h1 rise mt-6" style={{ '--d': '80ms' }}>How identities get attacked, and how to stop it.</h1>
              <p className="t-lead rise mt-6 max-w-[620px]" style={{ '--d': '160ms' }}>Field notes and analysis on identity attacks, AI agents, financial crime, bots and the regulation that shapes them. {POSTS.length} posts across {TOPICS.length} topics.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rise" style={{ '--d': '240ms' }}>
              <label htmlFor="rs" className="mb-2 block text-[14px] text-ink-3">Search the blogs</label>
              <div className="flex h-14 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-line-2 bg-[#090b0f]/80 px-5 backdrop-blur focus-within:border-cyan/60">
                <Icon name="MagnifyingGlass" size={20} className="text-ink-3" />
                <input id="rs" type="search" value={q} onChange={(e) => set('q', e.target.value)} placeholder="Mule accounts, MCP, DDoS…" className="h-full w-full bg-transparent text-[16px] text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-3" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="sec pt-12 md:pt-14" aria-labelledby="all-h">
        <div className="wrap">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-line pb-6">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
              <h2 id="all-h" className="text-[24px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em]">{filtering ? `${list.length} ${list.length === 1 ? 'result' : 'results'}` : 'All blogs'}</h2>
              {filtering && <button type="button" onClick={() => setParams(new URLSearchParams(), { replace: true, preventScrollReset: true })} className="text-[14px] text-cyan-2 hover:text-fg">Clear filters</button>}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2" role="group" aria-label="Filter by topic">
              <span className="mr-1 text-[13px] text-ink-3">Topic</span>
              {[['', 'All'], ...TOPICS.map((t) => [topicSlug(t), t])].map(([v, label]) => (
                <button key={label} type="button" aria-pressed={topic === v} onClick={() => set('topic', v)}

                  {label}{v && <span className="ml-1.5 text-[12px] opacity-60 num">{POSTS.filter((p) => p.category === label).length}</span>}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2" role="group" aria-label="Filter by product">
              <span className="mr-1 text-[13px] text-ink-3">Product</span>
              {['', ...PRODUCTS].map((v) => (
                <button key={v || 'all'} type="button" aria-pressed={product === v} onClick={() => set('product', v)}
                  className={cx('h-9 rounded-full border px-3.5 text-[14px] transition-colors', product === v ? 'border-transparent bg-fg font-medium text-bg' : 'border-line-2 text-ink-2 hover:text-ink')}>{v || 'All'}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">{list.length} articles shown</p>
          {list.length ? (
            <div className="mt-12 grid gap-x-8 gap-y-14 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
              {list.map((p) => <div key={p.slug} className="fadein"><PostCard post={p} /></div>)}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-16 rounded-[22px] border border-dashed border-line-2 p-12 text-center">
              <p className="text-[20px] font-semibold">Nothing matches that yet.</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-ink-2">Try another word, or clear the filters to see all {POSTS.length} reports.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="sec-tight" aria-labelledby="topics-h">
        <div className="wrap">
          <h2 id="topics-h" className="kicker mb-6">Browse by topic</h2>
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {TOPICS.map((t) => (
              <button key={t} type="button" onClick={() => { set('topic', topicSlug(t)); document.getElementById('all-h')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }} className="card card-hover flex items-center justify-between p-5 text-left">
                <span><span className="block text-[16px] font-semibold" style={{ color: hueOf(t) }}>{t}</span><span className="mt-1 block text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">{POSTS.filter((p) => p.category === t).length} {POSTS.filter((p) => p.category === t).length === 1 ? 'report' : 'reports'}</span></span>
                <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={16} className="text-ink-3" />
              </button>
            ))}
            <a href={SITE.linkedin} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="card card-hover flex items-center justify-between p-5">
              <span><span className="block text-[16px] font-semibold">New blogs first</span><span className="mt-1 block text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">Follow us on LinkedIn</span></span>
              <Icon name="LinkedinLogo" size={20} className="text-ink-3" />
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <CtaBand title="Put what you read to work." body="See how what we write about looks in your own environment, with a Deep Algorithms engineer." />
    </>
  );
}

function PlatformExplorer() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(0);
  const L = PRODUCT_MENU[on];
  const dep = DEPLOY.find(([n]) => n === L.name)?.[2];
  const key = (e) => {
    const d = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 0;
    if (!d) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const from = PRODUCT_MENU.findIndex((l) => `px-${l.key}` === e.target.id); // move from the tab that has focus
    const n = ((from < 0 ? on : from) + d + PRODUCT_MENU.length) % PRODUCT_MENU.length;
    setOn(n);
    document.getElementById(`px-${PRODUCT_MENU[n].key}`)?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <div className="mt-12 grid gap-5 max-md:hidden lg:grid-cols-[340px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Products" aria-orientation="vertical" onKeyDown={key} className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-1">
        {PRODUCT_MENU.map((l, i) => (
          <button key={l.key} id={`px-${l.key}`} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={i === on} aria-controls="px-panel" tabIndex={i === on ? 0 : -1} onClick={() => setOn(i)}
            className={cx('relative flex items-center gap-4 rounded-[16px] border p-4 text-left transition-all duration-300', i === on ? 'border-line-2 bg-bg-1 shadow-[0_18px_40px_-28px_rgba(6,25,55,.45)]' : 'border-transparent hover:bg-fg/[.03]')}
            style={{ '--acc': l.acc }}>
            <span aria-hidden="true" className={cx('absolute bottom-4 left-0 top-4 w-[3px] rounded-full transition-opacity', i === on ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0')} style={{ background: l.acc }} />
            <ProductMark p={l.key} size={40} />
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block text-[16.5px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.01em]">{l.name}</span>
              <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-ink-3">{l.blurb.replace(/, in one platform$/, '')}</span>
            </span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div id="px-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby={`px-${L.key}`} key={L.key} className="fadein card relative overflow-hidden p-8 xl:p-10" style={{ '--acc': L.acc }}>
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-24 -top-24 h-72 w-72 rounded-full opacity-[.14] blur-3xl" style={{ background: L.acc }} />
        <div className="relative grid gap-10 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.15fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router';
import { Seo } from '../lib/head.jsx';
import { Button, Icon } from '../components/ui.jsx';
import FlowRibbons from '../components/FlowRibbons.jsx';

const POPULAR = [
  ['Zenstra AI', '/agentic-ai/agentic-identity'], ['adapID AI', '/adapid-ai'], ['NHI Security for AWS', '/adapid-ai/nhi-security'],
  ['BotShield AI', '/botshield-ai'], ['ICMS Compliance Suite', '/dpdpa-compliance'], ['Blogs', '/blogs'],
];

export default function NotFound() {
  // the request line names the address the visitor typed (known only in the browser)
  const [path, setPath] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => { setPath(location.pathname); }, []);
  return (
    <>
      <Seo title="Page not found" path="/404" noindex description="The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved." />
      <section className="stage band-brand hero-under relative overflow-hidden">

        <div className="wrap relative py-28 text-center md:py-40">
          <p className="eyebrow mx-auto">Error 404</p>
          <h1 className="t-h1 mx-auto mt-6 max-w-[760px]">This page does not exist.</h1>
          <p className="t-lead mx-auto mt-5 max-w-[560px]">It may have moved when we rebuilt the site. Try one of these, search, or head back home.</p>
          <p className="mono mx-auto mt-6 inline-flex max-w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-2 rounded-full border border-line px-4 py-1.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-3">
            <span>GET <span className="break-all text-ink-2">{path || '/…'}</span></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>404</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>risk 3/100</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span className="text-[#6be3a4]">lost, not malicious</span>
          </p>
          <ul className="mx-auto mt-10 flex max-w-[760px] flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
            {POPULAR.map(([n, to]) => (
              <li key={to}><Link to={to} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-line-2 px-4 py-2 text-[15px] text-ink hover:border-fg/40">{n}<Icon name="CaretRight" size={12} weight="bold" /></Link></li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <div className="mt-10 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
            <Button to="/" size="lg">Back to home</Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="lg" type="button" onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('da:command', { detail: 'search' }))}><Icon name="MagnifyingGlass" size={16} />Search the site</Button>
          </div>

const img = (k) => `/img/events/${k}.webp`;
const clamp = (x, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, x));

/* how far the reader is through an element, 0 at its top entering the lower
   part of the screen, 1 at its bottom leaving the upper part */
function useScrollProgress(ref, { start = 0.85, end = 0.25 } = {}) {
  const [p, setP] = useState(1);
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduce) { setP(1); return undefined; }
    let raf = 0;
    const read = () => {
      raf = 0;
      const el = ref.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), vh = window.innerHeight;
      setP(clamp((vh * start - r.top) / (r.height + vh * (start - end))));
    };
    const on = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(read); };
    read();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', on, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', on);
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); window.removeEventListener('scroll', on); window.removeEventListener('resize', on); };
  }, [ref, reduce, start, end]);
  return p;
}

function ProductPanel() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const seen = useInView(ref, { threshold: 0.3 });
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [on, setOn] = useState(0);
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!seen || reduce || held) return undefined;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setOn((n) => (n + 1) % LINEUP.length), HOLD);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [seen, reduce, held, on]);
  const P = LINEUP[on];
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative mx-auto grid w-full max-w-[540px] place-items-center py-6 text-center">
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute left-1/2 top-[99px] h-[360px] w-[360px] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full blur-2xl transition-[background] duration-1000 max-sm:top-[82px] max-sm:h-[260px] max-sm:w-[260px]" style={{ background: `radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in oklab, ${P[3]} 38%, transparent), transparent 72%)` }} />
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="ps-ring absolute left-1/2 top-[99px] h-[250px] w-[250px] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full max-sm:top-[82px] max-sm:h-[190px] max-sm:w-[190px]" style={{ background: `conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0 62%, color-mix(in oklab, ${P[3]} 80%, transparent) 78%, transparent 92%)`, WebkitMask: 'radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 96%, #000 97%)', mask: 'radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 96%, #000 97%)', transition: 'background 1s' }} />

        <span className="ps-bob grid h-[150px] w-[150px] place-items-center max-sm:h-[116px] max-sm:w-[116px]"><ProductMark p={P[0]} size={128} className="max-sm:!h-[98px] max-sm:!w-[98px]" style={{ filter: `drop-shadow(0 18px 40px color-mix(in oklab, ${P[3]} 55%, transparent))` }} /></span>

        {LINEUP.map(([k, name], i) => (
          <button key={k} type="button" onClick={() => { setHeld(true); setOn(i); }} aria-label={name} aria-current={i === on || undefined} className="group py-2">

/* The team, rolling past: two rows in opposite directions, paused on hover. */
function TeamRoll() {
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const rowA = TEAM_PHOTOS.concat(RECOGNITION.slice(4).map((r) => ({ title: `${r.title}, ${r.where}`, img: r.img })));
  const rowB = [...rowA.slice(3), ...rowA.slice(0, 3)];
  // each row is its photos twice over, moved by exactly one set, so the loop has no seam
  const Row = ({ items, reverse }) => (
    <ul className={cx('marquee roll-team flex w-max', reverse && 'rev')}>
      {[...items, ...items].map((t, i) => {
        const copy = i >= items.length;
        return (
          <li key={t.img + i} className="w-[316px] shrink-0 pr-4 md:w-[396px]" aria-hidden={copy || undefined}>
            <figure>
              <img src={img(t.img)} alt={copy ? '' : t.title} className="aspect-[4/3] w-full rounded-[18px] border border-line object-cover" loading="lazy" decoding="async" />
              <figcaption className="mt-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">{t.title}</figcaption>
            </figure>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
  return (
    <div className={cx('marquee-wrap relative mt-12 space-y-6 overflow-hidden', paused && 'paused')} onFocus={() => setPaused(true)} onBlur={() => setPaused(false)}>
      <Row items={rowA} />
      <Row items={rowB} reverse />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setPaused(!paused)} aria-pressed={paused} className="absolute bottom-0 right-5 inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-line-2 bg-bg/80 px-3.5 text-[13px] text-ink-2 backdrop-blur md:right-10">
        <Icon name={paused ? 'Play' : 'Pause'} size={13} weight="fill" />{paused ? 'Play' : 'Pause'}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Link } from 'react-router';
import { Seo } from '../../lib/head.jsx';
import { PRODUCTS } from '../../data/products.js';
import { Icon, Reveal, SectionHead } from '../../components/ui.jsx';
import { CtaBand, ResearchRow } from '../../components/blocks.jsx';
import Stage3D from '../../components/Stage3D.jsx';
import { Hero, Stats, Faq, Related, Points, LINKS, ACC } from '../../components/ProductKit.jsx';
import { EdgeShield } from '../../components/scenes/ddos.jsx';
import { Gl } from '../../components/viz/kit.jsx';
import { STORIES } from '../../data/stories.js';

const p = PRODUCTS.ddos;
const A = ACC.bot;

/* The five 2026 patterns, from our research article on DDoS strategy. */
const PATTERNS = [
  { icon: 'Hourglass', h: 'Low-and-slow connections', p: 'A trickle, not a flood: connections held open with requests that never finish, until the server has no threads left.' },
  { icon: 'Code', h: 'Expensive API endpoints', p: 'A few thousand requests a minute to search or pricing APIs, each costing the server a hundred times a static page.' },
  { icon: 'Lock', h: 'TLS handshake exhaustion', p: 'Thousands of handshakes a second, before any application code runs, so application monitoring sees nothing.' },
  { icon: 'Globe', h: 'Residential-proxy floods', p: 'Hundreds of thousands of real home addresses making one or two requests each. Geo-blocks and IP lists catch nothing.' },
  { icon: 'Users', h: 'Fraud that doubles as DDoS', p: 'Paced credential stuffing that locks out real customers, drains the login service and commits fraud at the same time.' },
];

function Lanes() {
  const lane = (title, steps, bad) => (
    <div className="card p-6 md:p-8" style={bad ? undefined : { borderColor: 'rgb(52 224 195 / .4)' }}>
      <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[.08em]" style={{ color: bad ? 'var(--color-ink-3)' : A }}>{title}</p>
      <div tabIndex={0} role="group" aria-label="The five patterns" className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
        {steps.map(([g, t], i) => (
          <span key={t} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex min-w-[92px] flex-col items-center rounded-[14px] border border-line bg-fg/[.03] px-3 py-3 text-center">
              <Gl g={g} className="h-5 w-5" style={{ color: bad && t.includes('Scrubbing') ? 'var(--color-warn)' : bad ? 'var(--color-ink-3)' : A }} />
              <span className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] leading-tight text-ink-2">{t}</span>
            </span>
            {i < steps.length - 1 && <Icon name="ArrowRight" size={14} className="shrink-0 text-ink-3" />}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <ul className="mt-6 space-y-2 text-[14.5px] text-ink-2">
        {(bad ? ['Extra round trip while you are under attack', 'Diversion has to be detected and switched on', 'Built for volume, blind to floods that look human'] : ['No diversion, no extra hops', 'Always on, adapts without manual tuning', 'Behavioural detection for floods that look like users']).map((t) => (
          <li key={t} className="flex gap-2"><Icon name={bad ? 'X' : 'Check'} size={16} weight="bold" className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" style={{ color: bad ? 'var(--color-crit)' : A }} />{t}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
      {lane('Scrubbing centre', [['globe', 'Users'], ['cloud', 'Divert'], ['shield', 'Scrubbing centre'], ['cloud', 'Return'], ['server', 'Origin']], true)}
      {lane('BotShield at the edge', [['globe', 'Users'], ['shield', 'Edge, near users'], ['server', 'Origin']], false)}
    </div>
  );
}

    const errors = watch(page);

    await hydrated(page);
    await page.keyboard.press('Control+k');

  });

FILE: website/tests/helpers.js

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

/* Every public route, read from the sitemap the build writes. */
export const ROUTES = readFileSync(new URL('../dist/sitemap.xml', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
  .match(/<loc>[^<]+<\/loc>/g).map((l) => new URL(l.slice(5, -6)).pathname);

export const PRODUCT_PAGES = ['/agentic-ai/agentic-identity', '/adapid-ai', '/adapid-ai/nhi-security', '/adapid-ai/fraud-prevention', '/ad-security', '/botshield-ai', '/botshield-ai/ddos-protection', '/dpdpa-compliance'];

/* Record console and page errors for a test. */
export function watch(page) {
  const errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(`pageerror: ${e.message}`));
  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error' && !/status of 404/.test(m.text())) errors.push(`console: ${m.text()}`); });
  return errors;
}

/* Scroll through the page so every reveal, picture and lazy image gets its turn. */
export async function scrollThrough(page) {
  const h = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 700) { await page.evaluate((v) => window.scrollTo(0, v), y); await page.waitForTimeout(60); }
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
}

/* Wait until React has hydrated the page (Reveal marks <html> with .io on mount),
   so key presses reach the app rather than the prerendered HTML. */
export const hydrated = (page) => page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.classList.contains('io'));

test('product pictures keep their smallest text readable, phone or desktop', async ({ page }) => {
  for (const path of ['/adapid-ai', '/ad-security', '/dpdpa-compliance']) {
    await page.goto(path);
    await hydrated(page);
    const smallest = await page.evaluate(() => {
      let min = 99;
      for (const v of document.querySelectorAll('.vz')) for (const e of v.querySelectorAll('*')) {
        if (!e.getBoundingClientRect().width || ![...e.childNodes].some((c) => c.nodeType === 3 && c.textContent.trim().length > 1)) continue;
        min = Math.min(min, parseFloat(getComputedStyle(e).fontSize));
      }
      return min;
    });
    expect(smallest, path).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(9.5);
  }
});

  for (const route of ['/', '/adapid-ai', '/blogs/identity-security', '/why-deep-algorithms']) {

    const families = await page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, p, a, button, li')]
      .filter((e) => !e.closest('.vz, .mono, pre, code')).map((e) => getComputedStyle(e).fontFamily.split(',')[0].replace(/"/g, '')));
    expect(new Set(families), route).toEqual(new Set(['Inter Variable']));
  }
});

    shapes.add(shape);

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { ROUTES } from './helpers.js';

for (const route of ROUTES) {
  test(`${route} never scrolls sideways`, async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto(route);
    for (let y = 0; y < 30000; y += 900) {
      const done = await page.evaluate((v) => { window.scrollTo(0, v); return v > document.documentElement.scrollHeight; }, y);
      if (done) break;
    }
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);
  });
}
